# dsh-mcp-skills-board

[English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板。页面参考 Codex 的 MCP 设置：搜索框、技能和 MCP 服务两个分页、状态灯、每行一个开关、可展开详情，以及按 `[mcp_servers.*]` 字段做的添加服务器表单。

![技能分页](assets/screenshot-skills-view.png)

截图为示例数据。

## 入口

- 侧栏「MCP 与技能」。
- 插件 → 已安装插件 → dsh-mcp-skills-board，里面的配置区。

![插件页配置区](assets/screenshot-plugin-view.png)

## 功能

| 区域 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 技能 | 扫描 `.dsh/skills`、`.agents/skills` 和自定义根，按来源目录分组，当前项目排在前面。每个技能可在启用、仅手动、仅模型、停用之间切换 |
| 预设技能 | Agent 预设自带的技能以只读方式列出，文件在安装包内 |
| MCP 服务器 | 列出组合里所有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 行，显示状态灯、工具数和工具名。每行一个启停开关 |
| 添加与编辑 | stdio 填命令、参数、环境变量、工作目录；Streamable HTTP 填 URL、请求头。另有工具超时和创建后启用 |
| 删除 | 只删本页添加的服务器，点两次确认 |

技能开关改写 `SKILL.md` 的两个 frontmatter 键，文件监视器会在下一步重新发布目录。MCP 的改动写进 profile 的 patch 文件，`patchReload: live` 的 profile 就地生效。

## 安装

要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0`，范围写在 `peerDependencies` 里，插件管理器的兼容性检查会拦住版本不匹配。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mcp-skills-board
```

也可以在「插件 → 添加插件」里填包名。

本地开发用 link 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-mcp-skills-board
```

装完刷新一次 Web 页面，之后不需要重启。

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-mcp-skills-board
```

## 数据位置

- `$DSH_HOME/mcp-skills.json`，默认 `~/.dsh/mcp-skills.json`，权限 0600。本页添加的服务器定义都在这里。
- `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 里的一个带围栏的块：

```yaml
# >>> dsh-mcp-skills-board (managed — edit MCP servers from Settings → MCP & Skills)
- insert:
    - id: "mcp-github"
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: "github"
        transport: "stdio"
        command: "npx"
        args:
          - "-y"
          - "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: "..."
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
        failOnStartupError: false
      disabled: false
# <<< dsh-mcp-skills-board
```

块外的内容保持原样。别处声明的 MCP 行不会被改写，启停只追加一条按 id 定向的 `disabled:` 覆盖。

## 与 Codex 的对应

| Codex | 本插件 |
| --- | --- |
| `config.toml` 的 `[mcp_servers.*]` | `mcp-skills.json` 加生成的 patch 块 |
| Settings → MCP servers | MCP 服务分页 |
| Add server 表单 | 添加服务器表单 |
| `/mcp` | 行状态灯、工具数、详情 |
| `enabled = false` | 行开关，定义保留 |
| `startup_timeout_sec`、`tool_timeout_sec` | `toolCallTimeoutMs`；启动超时由 MCP SDK 控制 |
| `bearer_token_env_var`、`env_http_headers` | 不支持；env 和 headers 明文写入 patch 文件，权限 0600 |
| `codex mcp login` | 不支持，DSH 的 MCP 客户端没有 OAuth |
| `[[skills.config]] enabled = false` | 四态选择器，改写两个 frontmatter 键 |
| 技能位置 | 磁盘扫描根加预设作用域，预设部分只读 |

## 限制

- 没有 OAuth 登录。需要 OAuth 的服务器会被 DSH 的 MCP 桥拒绝，错误显示在行详情里。
- 密钥明文保存在 `cordis.patch.yml`，权限 0600。如果不希望明文，可以在 shell 里导出环境变量，把该行改成 `!!js process.env.X`，页面会把它当外部行，只保留启停。
- 预设技能只读。
- profile 没有 `patchReload: live` 时，改动下次启动生效，页面会提示。
- 删除只针对本页添加的服务器。

## 目录

```
package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch、dsh.client.platform、icon 和 exports
cordis.patch.yml      # 插入 id=mcp-skills 行
lib/index.js          # 宿主：state 和 action 路由、技能扫描、frontmatter 写入、patch 块
lib/client.js         # 浏览器：侧栏面板和插件页配置区
locale/zh.json        # 插件页展示信息，meta.title 和 meta.description
locale/en.json        # 英文回退
assets/icon.svg       # 插件列表和详情页图标
test/                 # 宿主集成测试
```

插件页的标题和描述由 `readPluginMeta` 读取：先找包导出的 `locale/en.json` 和同目录下的
`<lang>.json`，缺字段时回退到 `package.json`。图标取清单的 `icon` 字段。这些子路径要写进
`exports`，否则 Node 解析不到。

## 开发

```bash
npm test
```

覆盖 state 和 action 路由、服务器增删改、启停、技能策略写入、认证栅栏。

## 社区

本项目在 [LINUX DO](https://linux.do) 社区推广。

## 许可证

MIT。侧栏图标复用了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（MIT）中 `IconSkillOutlineRegular` 的路径数据，以便和 DSH 自身的图标粗细一致。

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：注册 workbuddy_checkin 工具，读取本机 WorkBuddy 加密登录态并完成每日积分签到
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workbuddy-checkin

**DeepSeek Harness 插件**：给 DSH 注册一个 `workbuddy_checkin` 工具，读取**本机** WorkBuddy 桌面端的加密登录态（只在内存中解密），查询并领取每日签到积分。

不是 WorkBuddy 插件，是 **DSH 插件** —— 一个 npm 包，通过 Cordis 挂进 DSH 的插件树。

当前版本 **0.1.1**（更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)）。

仓库：<https://github.com/leoc114119/dsh-workbuddy-checkin>

一行装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:leoc114119/dsh-workbuddy-checkin
```

---

## 它解决什么

WorkBuddy 桌面端每天签到 +100 积分，但：

- 签到入口在客户端里，得手动点；
- 多账号（`WorkBuddy` / `WorkBuddy AI`）要分别点；
- 登录态是**加密落盘**的（`$wbEncrypted` 信封 + 两层密钥），直接读文件拿不到令牌。

这个插件把这三件事包成一个工具，于是 DSH 里既能手动问一句，也能挂排程每天自动跑。

## 安装

### 方式一：从本地目录装（开发 / 自用）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-workbuddy-checkin
```

> ⚠️ **路径前必须带 `file:`。** 裸路径会被 pnpm 装成 `link:` 符号链接，而 Node 解析依赖走 realpath
> —— 符号链接会让插件的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖从**你的源码目录**往上找（那里没有），于是 DSH 只打一行
> `workbuddy-checkin (dsh-workbuddy-checkin): failed to import`，插件静默不生效。
> `file:` 会让 pnpm 在 profile 的 `node_modules/` 里落地成**真实目录**，依赖查找才能沿 profile 往上
> 命中 App 运行时自带的 `@deepseek-ai/*`。代价：`file:` 是拷贝不是链接，改完源码要重装一次。

### 方式二：从 npm 装（发布后）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workbuddy-checkin
```

### 方式三：从 GitHub 装（已实测可用，无需 npm 账号）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:leoc114119/dsh-workbuddy-checkin
```

> DSH 桌面端也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里装，等价于上面命令。
> 装完在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里会多出 `dsh-workbuddy-checkin`。

## 与 DSH 内核的兼容性

**本包故意不声明 `peerDependencies`。** 这是 2026-10-17 踩出来的结论：

同一天 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer **精确钉死**在当时的内核版本上
（`0.2.0-rc.2`）。当天 DSH 连升两次内核（`0.2.0-rc.2` → `0.2.1-rc.1` → `0.2.1-rc.2`），宿主于是给它挂
`incompatible-version`、`rows: []`，整条 provider 从运行树里消失；而**插件页不报错**，只显示
「还没有安装任何插件」，看起来完全像插件被删了（实际文件一个没少）。

本插件只用到两个稳定面：`ctx.tools.register` + `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 的配置 schema。
钉死版本换不来安全，只会把自己的可用性绑死在别人的发版节奏上 —— 所以这里宁可**不声明 peers**，
把兼容性交给实测（见下表）。

> 代价说清楚：不声明 peers 等于放弃构建期检查。内核若真改了 `tools` 服务或 `defineTool` 的签名，
> 本插件不会在安装时被拦，而是**挂载时报错**（`failed to import` 或 fiber 起不来）。
> 升级 DSH 后想确认，跑一句 `workbuddy_checkin action=accounts` 即可（离线、不联网、不改状态）。

## 改完源码怎么生效

`file:` 安装是**拷贝**不是链接（原因见上面「方式一」），所以改完源码必须**先卸后装**一次：

| 通道 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| GUI | 设置 → 插件 → 本插件卡片 → 卸载，再「添加插件」填本地目录绝对路径 |
| 脚本 | `pluginManager/removeBundle({name})` → `installBundle({spec:"file:/绝对路径/dsh-workbuddy-checkin", options:{saveExact:true, enabled:true}})` |
| 首次安装 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-workbuddy-checkin` |

装完核对 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-workbuddy-checkin/package.json` 的 `version`
是否等于源码里的版本；不一致就是没重装。插件页没变化按 Cmd+R 刷新（客户端是更新前的旧视图时不刷新会看不到改动）。

## 用法

### 作为 DSH 工具

装好后模型就有 `workbuddy_checkin` 工具：

| `action` | 作用 | 会不会改状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | 只读查询每个账号的签到状态 | 否 |
| `claim` | 先查，未签到且有活动则领取 | **是** |
| `accounts` | 列出本机发现的账号与各自 host（不联网） | 否 |
| `selftest` | 只验解密链路（keyblob → 令牌 → host），不联网 | 否 |

`account` 参数可选，传账号名数组则只处理这几个。

### 作为命令行

包里带 `bin`，可以不经过模型直接用：

```sh
dsh-workbuddy-checkin status      # 只读
dsh-workbuddy-checkin claim       # 查并领取
dsh-workbuddy-checkin accounts    # 列账号
dsh-workbuddy-checkin selftest    # 只验解密链路
dsh-workbuddy-checkin status --json
dsh-workbuddy-checkin status --account workbuddy-desktop
```

环境变量：

| 变量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `WB_AUTH_DIR` | 覆盖登录态目录（自动探测失败时用） |
| `WB_KEYBLOB` | 覆盖 keyblob 路径 |

### 每天 8 点自动签到

在 DSH 里建一条每天 08:00 的排程，提示词写：

```
调用 workbuddy_checkin 工具，action=claim，把每个账号的结果报给我。
```

排程到期会把提醒投进原会话，模型就会调这个工具 —— 不需要系统级定时器。

## 工作原理

### 登录态在哪

按优先级找第一个含 `.info` 的目录：

| 平台 | 路径 |
|---|---|
| macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/CodeBuddyExtension/Data/Public/auth` |
| Windows | `%APPDATA%\CodeBuddyExtension\Data\Public\auth` |
| Linux | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/CodeBuddyExtension/Data/Public/auth` |
| 兜底 | `~/.workbuddy/auth` |

### 两层密钥（关键）

敏感字段用 `$wbEncrypted` 信封加密，**不是**「一个全局密钥直接加密」：

```
~/.workbuddy/keyblob                     ← 每台机器一份，首次运行随机生成，mode 600
  keyId: <本机数据密钥 ID>
  slots[]: { type: "static-v1", protectorKeyId: <保护密钥 ID>, wrapped: <信封> }
                                         ← wrapped 是用「保护密钥」加密的本机数据密钥
```

- **保护密钥**是 App 内置的全局常量，所有安装一致；
- **数据密钥**每台机器不同，随机生成后存在 keyblob 里。

所以流程是：用保护密钥按 `framing="file"` 拆开 `keyblob.slots[].wrapped` 得到本机数据密钥 → 再拿**与信封 `keyId` 匹配**的那把钥匙去解字段。

> ⚠️ 信封带 `keyId`，必须**按 keyId 选钥匙**。不能因为「开发机上恰好是保护密钥的 ID」就写死。

### 两种信封

| scheme | 结构 |
|---|---|
| 对称（默认） | 载荷直接用数据密钥 AES-256-GCM 加密 |
| `asym-v1` | 随机 32 字节文件密钥加密载荷；文件密钥被包两次 —— `userWrap`（用使用者密钥，**我们能解**）与 `developerWrap`（RSA-OAEP，托管恢复用，**读取时用不到**） |

`authorWrap` / `developerWrap` 的存在意味着**不需要任何私钥**就能读自己的数据。

### host 不写死

「该打哪个域名」从令牌自己的 JWT `iss` 推导，其次 `auth.domain`，最后才退回已知映射。账号文件名各版本/各渠道可能不同，写死必然漏。

### 两个容易踩的坑

- **状态端点必须用** `POST /v2/billing/meter/checkin-activity-status`。同目录的 `checkin-status` 是桩接口，对**所有账号**恒定返回 `active:false` / `streak:0` / `total_credits:0`，会把「今天已签到」误报成「未签到」。
- **「没有活动」≠「今天没签」**。前者调领取端点只会得到 HTTP 400「签到活动未开启或已过期」，应当跳过而不是报错。
- 判断状态看 `active` / `activity_name` / `theme_name` / `season` / `start_time` / `today_checked_in` / `streak_days` / `total_credits` / `checkin_dates`。**不要用 `daily_credit`**：真端点对所有账号恒 100、桩端点恒 0，没有区分力。

## 安全

- 令牌**只在内存中解密**，随即用于请求头；**不落盘、不完整回显**（输出一律脱敏成 `eyJhbG…(1395 字符，已脱敏)`）。
- 只**读**登录态文件与 keyblob，不改写、不复制。
- 除 `claim` 外所有动作都不发写请求。
- 请求只发往从你自己令牌 `iss` 推导出的官方域名。
- 本包不含任何硬编码的开发机密钥或账号信息 —— 唯一的常量是 App 内置的**公开**保护密钥（所有安装一致，不是秘密）。

## 已验证到什么程度

诚实分级：

| 结论 | 级别 |
|---|---|
| 解密链路（keyblob 两层密钥 → 令牌 → host） | **确定** —— 本机两个账号（`workbuddy-desktop` / `workbuddy-desktop-ai`）实测解密成功，与独立 Python 实现逐字段一致 |
| 状态查询 | **确定** —— 对两个真实账号真实请求，结果与 Python 版一致（一个 `no_activity`、一个 `already_checked_in`，连续 17 天 / 1700 积分） |
| **DSH 挂载 + 工具调用** | **确定** —— 装进 profile 后 Cordis 成功挂载；`headless` 会话里模型确实调用了 `workbuddy_checkin`，返回上面两段真实结果（即本 README 的表格数据来源） |
| **装进正在运行的 DSH 桌面端** | **确定** —— 宿主进程已连续运行两天、安装动作发生在其启动**之后**；在该进程内新建会话，模型成功调用 `workbuddy_checkin` 并返回同样两段真实结果 ⇒ **无需重启即已生效** |
| **跨内核升级后仍可用** | **确定** —— 2026-10-17 内核从 `0.2.0-rc.2` 连升到 `0.2.1-rc.2`，本插件未做任何改动即保持 `active`；`workbuddy_checkin action=status` 实跑返回 `workbuddy-desktop` 第 10 季 / 连续 18 天 / 累计 1800 积分，`workbuddy-desktop-ai` 无进行中活动按 `no_activity` 跳过 |
| 从 GitHub 直装（他人的安装路径） | **确定** —— 干净 profile 里 `dsh plugin add github:leoc114119/dsh-workbuddy-checkin` 一次成功，挂载 + 工具调用均通过 |
| `asym-v1` 信封 | **按源码实现 + 往返验证** —— 本机没有真实 `asym-v1` 样本，构造样例验证通过 |
| 真正领到一次积分 | **尚未** —— 本机账号当天都已签到 / 无活动，没有可领的机会 |
| 跨机器可用 | **未验证** —— 密钥层级按通用逻辑实现（按 keyId 选钥匙），但只在开发机上跑过 |

## 许可

MIT © 2026 leochen

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把全栈开发与问题排查提示词做成四个按场景自动加载的技能（单体/微服务 × 开发/排查），含 Vue3+TS+Spring Boot 与 Spring Cloud Alibaba 的硬约束。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-prompts

把「全栈开发 / 问题排查」提示词做成 **DeepSeek Harness 技能包**：装上之后不用再手动粘贴提示词，模型会在对的时候自己加载对应规范。

## 装了它解决什么问题

原来这些规范是几份长文档（单体 1978 行 + 微服务 2719 行）。用起来有三个麻烦：

1. 每次开新会话要重新贴，贴多了占上下文；
2. 四套提示词（单体开发 / 单体排查 / 微服务开发 / 微服务排查）混在两个文件里，靠人记哪个该用；
3. 里面有不少重复表述和不可判定的要求，真正执行时反而是噪音。

本插件把四套规范拆成四个**按场景触发**的技能，并做了压缩与结构化。

## 四个技能

| 技能 | 何时自动加载 |
|---|---|
| `fullstack-monolith-dev` | 单体全栈开发：Vue 3 + TS + Vite + Pinia / Spring Boot 3 + JDK 21 + MyBatis-Plus + Sa-Token |
| `fullstack-monolith-debug` | 单体应用故障排查（500/401/403/404、数据不一致、慢查询、连不上中间件） |
| `fullstack-microservice-dev` | 微服务开发：Spring Cloud Alibaba（Nacos / Gateway / OpenFeign / Sentinel / Seata）+ Maven 多模块 |
| `fullstack-microservice-debug` | 微服务链路排查（注册失败、网关 404、Feign 超时与 fallback 吞异常、熔断、Seata 不回滚、MQ 堆积） |

## 安装

harness 内（推荐，桌面 profile 只能走这条路）：

```
插件设置 → 安装 → 填入本包名或本地路径
```

或命令行（**只对 `web` profile 有效**；`desktop` profile 被 Electron 独占）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-prompts
```

本地开发时可直接指向目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-agent-prompts
```

## 用法

装好后不需要任何操作。当你提出「新建一个 Spring Boot 项目」「这个接口 500 了帮我查」这类请求时，对应技能会出现在技能目录里，由模型按需加载。

也可以显式触发（在对话里说出技能名）：

```
用 fullstack-microservice-dev 规范帮我搭骨架
用 fullstack-monolith-debug 流程排查这个 500
```

## 相对原文档做了什么优化

| 项 | 原文档 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 结构 | 编号章节平铺，H1 混在中段 | 统一「前置 → 硬绑定 → 约定 → 流程 → 门禁 → 提问触发」 |
| 长度 | 单体 1978 行 / 微服务 2719 行 | 每个技能约 150–200 行 |
| 重复 | 环境变量、自检清单、禁止事项多处重复 | 去重，每个约束只出现一次 |
| 可判定性 | 部分要求无法判定（"注意代码质量"） | 一律改成可检查的断言或命令 |
| 自检清单 | 60+ 项勾选，实际不会逐条执行 | 压成「提交前门禁」8–10 条，每条对应一个可执行的验证 |
| 顺序 | 开发与排查混在同一文件 | 按「单体/微服务 × 开发/排查」四象限拆分 |
| 原文 | —— | 完整保留在 `reference/`，可随时对照 |

**没有删掉任何硬约束**：技术栈版本、四套环境、包结构、Feign 契约位置、网关规则、RBAC 要求、双文档同步、验证命令，全部保留并改写成了可执行形式。

## 目录

```
dsh-agent-prompts/
├── package.json
├── cordis.patch.yml           # profile 补丁：插入一条插件行
├── lib/index.js               # 注册四个技能
├── skills/                    # 技能正文（改文案不用改代码）
│   ├── fullstack-monolith-dev.md
│   ├── fullstack-monolith-debug.md
│   ├── fullstack-microservice-dev.md
│   └── fullstack-microservice-debug.md
└── reference/                 # 原始文档，逐字保留
    ├── fullstack-single.original.md
    └── fullstack-microservice.original.md
```

## 实现说明

- 纯 Host 插件，没有 client 半，因此不需要 `dsh.client` 字段，也不占侧边栏。
- `inject: ['skills']` 是硬依赖：技能服务不存在时插件不激活，不会出现"装了但没效果"。
- 技能正文运行时读盘（`skills/*.md`），改文案后重启即可生效，不用重新构建。
- 注册时 `source: 'bundled'`，`invocation` 同时允许模型与用户触发。

## 许可

MIT。`reference/` 下的原始文档版权归原作者，随包仅作对照用途。

plugins.description: 550W-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: play a video full-screen when DSH opens, and reveal the UI only after it finishes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-boo550wt-animation

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加一段开机动画：打开 DSH 时全屏播放一段视频，播完（或者按 `Esc`）才进入界面。

> 自带素材 `assets/boot.mp4` 是一段 **550W 风格**的启动动画 —— 16.6 秒、1024×576、H.264 + AAC、12.1 MB。

```
打开 DSH  ─▶  黑底 + 视频  ─▶  播完 / 按 Esc  ─▶  淡出  ─▶  正常界面
```

关键在于**交接时机**：遮罩在 DSH 结算「启动就绪」之前就已经挂上去了，所以应用是在遮罩底下正常渲染的，等动画结束再把界面让出来 —— 而不是先看到界面再盖一层。

---

## 怎么用

### 1. 装

DSH 的插件用它自己的 CLI 安装（`desktop` 是保留 profile，由 Electron 应用托管）：

```powershell
# 先拿到仓库
git clone https://github.com/456erddgr/dsh-boo550wt-animation.git

# 再用 DSH 自带的 CLI 装进 desktop profile
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
& "<你的安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals `
  "<你的安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js" `
  plugin --profile desktop add "<clone 出来的目录>"
```

`<你的安装目录>` 默认是 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness`。

这条命令会做三件事：加一条 `link:` 依赖、在 `node_modules` 里建好入口、把 bundle 追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

> `add` 底层是 pnpm，所以也接受 git 形式：
> `plugin --profile desktop add github:456erddgr/dsh-boo550wt-animation`

### 2. 重启 DSH

**必须重启。** Host 半侧的代码只在 DSH 启动时被 import 一次，热更新不会加载它。

重启后可以自查 —— 浏览器打开这个地址，返回 JSON 就说明 Host 半侧已经起来了：

```
http://127.0.0.1:19387/boot-animation/state
```

### 3. 换视频 / 调参数

不用改代码，在 profile 的 patch 层里按行 id 覆盖配置即可：

```yaml
- id: dsh-boo550wt-animation
  config:
    videoPath: "E:/成品/别的视频.mp4"   # 留空则用自带的 assets/boot.mp4
    zIndex: 2147483000
    fadeMs: 380
```

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 设 `false` 可以临时停用而不卸载 |
| `videoPath` | `""` | 换成别的视频；留空 = 用自带素材 |
| `zIndex` | `2147483000` | 遮罩层级 |
| `maxSeconds` | `120` | 硬上限，卡死的视频也绝不会锁住窗口 |
| `graceMs` | `1500` | 上报时长之外再宽限多久才触发上限 |
| `fadeMs` | `380` | 交接时的淡出时长 |
| `hintDelayMs` | `4000` | 多久之后出现跳过提示 |
| `skipHint` | `按 Esc 跳过` | 提示文字 |
| `silentHint` | `按 Esc 跳过 · 点击开启声音` | 被降级成静音时显示 |
| `blockedHint` | `点击以播放开机动画` | 自动播放被彻底拦截时显示 |
| `errorHint` | `开机动画不可用` | 视频解不开时显示 |

### 4. 跳过 / 卸载

- **跳过**：随时按 `Esc`。如果浏览器不给出声自动播放，插件会先退回静音并在角上说明，同时装一个点击/按键处理器，让你点一下就能带着声音重来。视频彻底解不开时，遮罩 0.9 秒后放弃，正常界面照常出现。
- **卸载**：

```powershell
plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-boo550wt-animation
```

---

## 原理

这个插件是 **Host-only**（只有 `lib/index.js`），没有 client 模块，也没有构建步骤。它只用 profile 自带的 webserver 的两个机制：

1. **`webserver/index-inject` 注入行** —— 一条 `style`、一条 body `script`。DSH 会把注入行应用到页面上，时机**早于** `__DSH_BOOT_READY__` 结算、也早于客户端模块加载器启动，这正是遮罩能成为屏幕上第一个东西的原因。浏览器路径（注入行被渲染进服务的 HTML）和 Desktop 路径（注入行经 IPC 交给页面自己应用）消费的是同一批行，所以代码不需要分支。
2. **`/boot-animation` 下的 `prefix` 路由** —— 带 `Range`、`HEAD`、`416` 处理，交给浏览器自己的媒体栈去解码。页面从自己被服务的同源地址去请求它；Desktop 壳会把该请求连同会话 cookie 转发给 Host。

客户端脚本是把一个真函数 `toString()` 出来的（`lib/inject.js`），所以注入的 JavaScript 是当普通源码被解析和检查的，也保证不含尖括号和 `</script`。

---

## 自检工具

| 命令 | 能证明什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `node tools/selftest.mjs` | Range 解析、那两条注入行、路由和各状态码 —— 走真实 HTTP |
| `node tools/browser-check.mjs` | 真实 Chromium 里：交接前遮罩已就位、视频确实经 Range 路由解码、跳过与拆除都正常 |
| `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 <DeepSeek Harness.exe> --expose-internals tools/verify-install.mjs` | 用 DSH 自己的 profile 加载器验证：bundle 被组合进去了（loaded 而不是 skipped），Host 入口能解析 |

`browser-check.mjs` 通过 DevTools 协议驱动页面，并合成 Desktop 的时序（先应用注入行，再结算启动就绪）；它验证的是本包自己的页面脚本和字节服务，不是 DSH 安装本身。`verify-install.mjs` 才是"插件确实被接进 profile"的检查。

---

## 说明与限制

- 视频的 `moov` atom 在文件尾部，所以首帧之前浏览器要把整个 12 MB 抓下来；走 loopback 基本无感。素材如果真的变大，用 `-movflags +faststart` 重新封装就能消掉这个等待。
- 跳过和硬上限是刻意的设计：开机动画**永远**不应该有能力锁死窗口。
- 遮罩追加到 `body`，从不碰 `#root`，所以 React 的挂载点不受影响；拆除时它会连同自己的监听器和定时器一起收干净。
- `assets/boot.mp4` 是本仓库自带的示例素材，只作 550W 风味参考，与《流浪地球》官方无关。如果要公开分发本仓库，请自行确认你对该素材拥有相应权利。

---

## English

Plays a video full-screen while DeepSeek Harness boots, then hands the window to the shell. The bundled clip is a 550W-style startup sequence (16.6 s, 1024×576, H.264 + AAC, 12.1 MB).

The plugin is Host-only — no client module, no build step — and uses two mechanisms from the profile's webserver: injected `webserver/index-inject` rows (one `style`, one body `script`), which DSH applies before `__DSH_BOOT_READY__` settles and before the client module loader starts; and a `prefix` route at `/boot-animation` that streams the clip with `Range`, `HEAD` and `416` handling. The browser path and the Desktop path consume the same injection rows, so there is no branching.

Install with DSH's own CLI (it manages the reserved `desktop` profile), then **restart DSH** — Host code is only imported at boot:

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
& "<DeepSeek Harness.exe>" --expose-internals `
  "<resources>\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js" `
  plugin --profile desktop add "<this directory>"
```

Escape always skips. Playback that is refused with sound retries muted and says so; a clip that cannot be decoded gives up after 0.9 s. `maxSeconds` is a hard ceiling so a boot animation can never trap the window. See the config table above for every field.

plugins.description: Semantic session search backend for DSH, backed by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-query-vector

A semantic session-search backend for DSH, backed by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` endpoint.

DSH ships a SQLite full-text backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite`) that answers "which session contained this word". This package replaces it with a vector backend that answers "which session was about this" — you ask in your own words, the query is embedded, and the closest chunks come back with their session and snippet.

It is a drop-in replacement for the official backend: both extend the same `sessionQuery` service, so exactly one of them may be mounted at a time.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `3.18.5` (ships with DSH) |
| Node.js | 22+ — the indexer uses the built-in `node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`) |
| An embedding endpoint | Ollama locally, or any OpenAI-compatible API |

Earlier DSH releases are untested.

## Two pieces

| Piece | What it is |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | The **query** side — a `SessionQueryEngine` subclass mounted as a plugin. Answers searches by reading the index. Never embeds. |
| `indexer.mjs` | The **index** side — a standalone script. Walks `~/.dsh/sessions`, embeds the message text, writes the vectors. |

They are deliberately separate: search must stay fast, and embedding is slow. The query side never triggers an embedding on the search path; if the index is empty it returns nothing.

**The two sides must use the same embedding model.** Otherwise the stored vectors and the query vector live in different spaces and every score is noise. Configure `embedModel` identically in both.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start.

**The bundle patch also disables the official backend**, because both register `sessionQuery`:

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml shipped with this package
- id: session-query-sqlite
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: session-query-vector
      name: 'dsh-session-query-vector'
      config:
        provider: ollama
        baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
        embedModel: bge-m3
        openAt: first-search
```

If you would rather keep the official backend, remove that first row and do not mount this package — they cannot coexist.

## Configuration

Set these in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config` rather than merging into it, so restate every key you want to keep.

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: session-query-vector
      name: 'dsh-session-query-vector'
      config:
        path: 'C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/storages/session-query-vector.sqlite'
        provider: openai
        baseUrl: 'https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1'
        apiKey: 'sk-...'
        embedModel: 'BAAI/bge-m3'
        openAt: first-search
        topK: 20
        minScore: 0.45
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `~/.dsh/storages/session-query-vector.sqlite` | Index database. Created on first use. |
| `openAt` | `first-search` | `startup` opens the DB at mount; `first-search` on the first query; `never` disables search entirely. |
| `provider` | `ollama` | `ollama` or `openai`. `openai` means any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings`. |
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Embedding endpoint. A trailing `/v1` is stripped and re-added, so `https://host/v1` and `https://host` both work. |
| `apiKey` | `""` | Sent as `Authorization: Bearer` when non-empty. Not needed for Ollama. |
| `embedModel` | `bge-m3` | Must match the indexer. |
| `embedTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-request timeout. |
| `topK` | `20` | Candidates pulled from the index before ranking. |
| `minScore` | `0.45` | Cosine floor. |
| `relMargin` | `0.10` | Relative cutoff: a hit is kept only if its score is within `relMargin` of the best hit. |
| `snippetChars` | `240` | Snippet length in the result. |
| `readWindowMax` | `50` | Read window for the engine's live-preferred reads. |

## Endpoint contracts

### Ollama (`provider: ollama`)

```http
POST {baseUrl}/api/embeddings
content-type: application/json

{ "model": "bge-m3", "prompt": "the text to embed" }
```

Response: `{ "embedding": [0.013, -0.021, ...] }`.

Pull the model first:

```bash
ollama pull bge-m3
```

### OpenAI-compatible (`provider: openai`)

```http
POST {baseUrl}/v1/embeddings
authorization: Bearer <apiKey>
content-type: application/json

{ "model": "BAAI/bge-m3", "input": ["chunk one", "chunk two"] }
```

Response: `{ "data": [{ "index": 0, "embedding": [...] }, ...] }`. Results are sorted by `data[].index` before use — some providers return them out of order.

A trailing `/v1` on `baseUrl` is stripped before `/v1/embeddings` is appended, so `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` does not become `/v1/v1/embeddings`.

Any endpoint that satisfies this contract works: SiliconFlow, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Together, a local vLLM or LM Studio server, and so on. Set `baseUrl`, `apiKey` and `embedModel` to whatever that provider names the model.

## Building the index

`indexer.mjs` is not run by DSH — start it yourself, after the query side is configured. It must be able to `import` the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages, so run it with the DSH runtime (see below).

```bash
# layered: layer 1 (user messages) first, then layer 2 (assistant messages)
node indexer.mjs

node indexer.mjs --layer=1        # only user messages — fastest path to a usable search
node indexer.mjs --layer=2        # only assistant messages
node indexer.mjs --limit=200      # cap sessions this run
node indexer.mjs --status         # print progress, index nothing
node indexer.mjs --force          # re-index unchanged sessions
node indexer.mjs --quiet          # no progress lines, only key events
node indexer.mjs --skip-active=5  # skip sessions written in the last 5 minutes
```

| Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | DSH home. Everything else derives from it. |
| `DSH_MODULES` | `$DSH_HOME/node_modules/@deepseek-ai` | Where to resolve `@deepseek-ai/*`. Override for the packaged desktop app. |
| `VEC_DB` | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session-query-vector.sqlite` | Index path — must equal the plugin's `path`. |
| `VEC_SESSIONS` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Session log root. |
| `VEC_PROVIDER` | `ollama` | `ollama` or `openai` — must equal the plugin's `provider`. |
| `VEC_BASE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Must equal the plugin's `baseUrl`. |
| `VEC_API_KEY` | `""` | Must equal the plugin's `apiKey`. |
| `VEC_MODEL` | `bge-m3` | Must equal the plugin's `embedModel`. |
| `VEC_CHUNK` | `1200` | Characters per chunk. |
| `VEC_BATCH` | `16` | Chunks per embedding request. |
| `VEC_SUBAGENTS` | — | Set to `1` to include subagent sessions. |

### Running the indexer against the packaged desktop app

The Electron app's `@deepseek-ai/*` modules live inside `app.asar`, which plain `node` cannot read. Point `DSH_MODULES` at the asar and run the indexer under the app's own binary in Node mode:

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$env:DSH_MODULES = 'D:/APP/deepseek harness/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/'
& 'D:\APP\deepseek harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe' indexer.mjs --status
```

From a source checkout, plain `node indexer.mjs` works — `DSH_MODULES` already points at real files.

## Index schema

One SQLite file, `application_id = 1146308690` (distinct from the official backend's), `user_version = 1`. A file whose `application_id` belongs to something else is refused rather than clobbered.

| Table | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vec_chunks(session_id, seq, type, time, chunk_idx, text, dim, vector BLOB)` | One row per embedded chunk. Primary key `(session_id, seq, chunk_idx)`. |
| `vec_sessions(id, revision, indexed_at, chunks, cwd, layer)` | Per-session bookkeeping; `revision` drives the incremental skip. |
| `vec_queries(text, vector, dim, at)` | Query-vector cache, so repeating a search skips the embedding round

plugins.description: DSH 运行监控：侧栏实时读数；整机占比、CPU/内存/界面响应三轨联动、进程趋势与工具进程启停。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 运行监控

Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量插件，用来回答五个问题：

- 电脑慢，是不是 DSH 造成的？
- DSH 的哪一部分、它启动的哪个程序在占用资源？
- 刚才卡的那一下是什么时候、和什么同时发生的？
- 长时间运行后，内存有没有一直上涨？
- 哪个插件在占用 DSH 后台的 CPU 和内存？

## 安装

通过 `engines.dsh` 声明兼容 DSH 0.2 系列（`^0.2.0-rc.2`），在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测过。采集器为 Windows x64 程序，使用系统自带的 .NET Framework 4.x。

在 DSH 左侧「插件」→「添加插件」中选择本地压缩包：

```text
D:\code\plugins\dsh\dsh-performance\dist\dsh-performance-0.6.1.tgz
```

启用后完整退出并重启 DSH。不需要 API Key，不调用模型，也不与 Agent 交互。

## 使用

**侧栏入口**：侧栏底部的「运行监控」一行，右侧实时显示 CPU 和内存合计。点击打开详情页，打开期间该行显示为选中。侧栏收起时只留图标，悬停可看读数。

**详情页**从上到下分为四部分，顶栏可切换时间范围：5 分钟、15 分钟、1 小时。

1. **此刻**：整机 CPU 和内存各用一条横条表示。
   - DSH 占用的部分按组成部分着色：界面渲染、GPU、主进程与服务、后台服务、工具进程。
   - 其他程序显示为灰色，剩余部分是空闲。
   - 下方一行列出此刻 CPU 最高和内存最多的进程，点击可直接打开它的详情。
2. **趋势**：CPU、内存、界面响应三条轨道上下排列，共用一条时间轴。
   - **左侧读数**：每条轨道左侧是当前值和区间统计（平均、峰值、较区间开始的变化）。指向峰值旁的时刻标签，竖线会跳到那一刻。
   - **悬停联动**：鼠标悬停时，一根竖线贯穿三条轨道，提示框列出那一刻各组成部分的 CPU 和内存、DSH 合计以及整机占用；「后台服务」下方列出那一刻后台主线程最忙的几个插件或部分。悬停期间时间轴不滚动；方向键可逐点查看。
   - **界面响应轨道**：柱是卡顿的帧，柱高为持续时长；点是点击、按键的响应时间，超过 200 毫秒的标红。
   - **最下方的「工具进程」行**：长时间运行的程序（如开发服务器）画成运行时段条，一次性命令画成短竖线，可以直接对照内存、CPU 的变化。
   - **联动高亮**：指向图例、占比条或进程表中的任一项，所有图表里只突出该组成部分。
3. **进程**：分为「DSH 应用」和「工具进程」两组，每行带所选指标的趋势小图。
   - 工具进程按程序合并子进程。已退出的程序收在「已退出」下，同一命令的多次运行合并为一行，例如「Git × 6」。
   - 点击任一行，右侧打开详情：该进程的 CPU 与内存曲线、它是做什么的、何时启动、线程数、完整命令行（可复制），以及包含的子进程。
4. **插件**：列出已安装的插件（不含 DSH 自带的组合包），其后是 DSH 内核、垃圾回收和其他。和其他数据一样随每次读数更新，不需要手动开始。
   - **列**：所选指标的趋势小图；所选时间范围内的平均 CPU（占整机，与进程表同一口径）；最近一次读取的内存；自带进程。上方一句话汇总这段时间后台主线程的忙碌程度和各部分占比。
   - **详情**：点击一行，右侧打开该插件的 CPU 与内存曲线、所选时间范围内最耗时的函数（文件与行号）、占用内存最多的位置和自带进程；DSH 内核与其他按包列出。
   - **自带进程**：插件自带的程序（例如本插件的采集器）按所在目录归到对应插件，实时显示 CPU 和内存；它们在进程表里也会标出属于哪个插件。

窗口不可见时自动暂停采集；插件归属的采样再保持 10 分钟后停止，见「开销控制」。采集失败时，页面保留最后一次读数并变淡，显示原因和「重试」，15 秒后也会自动重试。

## 统计口径

从插件所在的后台进程向上，找到最上层的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`，即桌面主进程。再沿进程树向下，统计：

1. 桌面主进程，以及它的界面渲染、GPU、网络、存储等子进程。进程类型由 Electron 的 `--type` 参数识别。
2. DSH 后台服务，即同一个可执行文件以 Node 模式运行的进程。
3. 后台启动的全部程序及其子孙进程，即「工具进程」，计入合计。

以下不计入：
- 采集器自身的占用，显示在「插件」分区「运行监控」一行的自带进程中，不计入 DSH 合计。
- 父进程已经退出的程序，因为无法确认来源。
- 树外的同名程序。

插件不接受网页传入的 PID 或命令，也不提供结束进程的操作。

指标定义：
- **CPU**：各进程在采样间隔内使用的 CPU 时间之和，除以间隔和逻辑处理器数。100% 表示整台电脑的算力全部占满，与任务管理器一致。两次采样之间启动的进程，其全部 CPU 时间都计入这个间隔；PID 被复用时不沿用旧进程的读数。
- **内存**：进程专用工作集之和，与任务管理器「详细信息」页的「内存(专用工作集)」列一致。需要 Windows 10/11 22H2 及 2023 年 9 月以后的累积更新，不支持时显示 `—`。个别进程没有读取权限时不计入合计，并在「此刻」中注明数量。
- **整机**：CPU 来自 `GetSystemTimes`，与 DSH 用同一个采样间隔计算；内存为已使用的物理内存，即总量减去可用（`GlobalMemoryStatusEx`）。
- **界面响应**：
  - **卡顿**：取自 Chromium 的 Long Animation Frames，即一帧被拖延超过 50 毫秒；不支持时退回 Long Tasks。
  - **交互延迟**：取自 Event Timing，即从点击或按键到界面画出反馈的时间，超过 200 毫秒标红。
  - 两者都由浏览器事件推送，没有轮询，只在窗口可见时记录。打开本页期间，本页自身的绘制也会计入。
- **插件占用**：插件没有自己的进程，全部运行在 DSH 后台进程里（界面部分在界面渲染进程里），系统无法分开计量。后台在自己进程里通过 `node:inspector` 使用 V8 的 CPU 采样分析器和抽样堆分析器。
  - **CPU**：窗口可见、读数持续时，每 10 毫秒记录一次主线程的调用栈。每次读数结束上一段、开始下一段（两段重叠交接，分析器不重启），所以插件占比与 CPU 读数是同一个时间段，换算成整机占比。
  - **归属**：每个样本归到调用栈上离它最近的插件代码。插件按其安装目录（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/<插件>`）识别；DSH 安装目录中的代码算作 DSH 内核，并按包细分。插件同步调用的 DSH 代码算作该插件；插件触发后由 DSH 稍后异步完成的工作（比如等待中的模型请求）不带插件的调用栈，算作 DSH 内核。
  - **范围**：只统计后台主线程。文件和网络读写在线程池里，不计入；界面部分不在范围内，因为插件的界面由 DSH 共用的 React 渲染，无法可靠归属。
  - **内存**：从本插件加载（DSH 启动）起，每分配约 128 KB 抽样记录一次分配位置。DSH 启动约 1 分钟后第一次读取，之后窗口可见时每 5 分钟一次，得到各插件分配、目前仍占用的内存（抽样估算）。读取前 V8 会做一次完整的垃圾回收，后台会短暂停顿；本插件加载之前分配的不计入。
  - **调试会话的副作用**：会话连接期间，V8 会替调试器保留最近约 1000 次 `console` 调用的参数。后台每 30 秒、以及每次读取内存前清掉它们，所以它们既不常驻内存，也不会算进插件的内存。用 DevTools 调试后台时有两点副作用：JavaScript Profiler 面板里会看到本插件交接用的分段记录（标题以 `dsh-performance#` 开头）；控制台里超过 30 秒的旧输出，其中的对象可能无法再展开。
  - 插件列表来自 profile 的 `package.json` 中记录的组合包，去掉 `@deepseek-ai/` 下 DSH 自带的部分；插件名称取自插件的语言文件。
- **程序启停**：根据每次读数推断。启动时间取进程自己的创建时间；退出时间是最后一次看到它运行的时刻。窗口不可见期间启动又退出的程序不会出现。

## 开销控制

- **采样频率**：侧栏常驻读数时每 3 秒一次，打开详情页时每 2 秒一次，失败后每 15 秒一次。两处共用一个采样器。
- **Host 端合并**：并发请求合并为一次，1.8 秒内的重复请求直接复用结果。
- **采集器**：每次请求只读一次进程快照，以及树内各进程的 CPU 时间、内存、线程数和两项整机计数。命令行每个进程只读一次并缓存。不使用 WMI、PowerShell，不扫描文件；闲置 15 秒后退出。
- **历史数据**：只保存在内存中，保留 1 小时，不写磁盘、不上传。
  - 趋势每个读数只存五个分组的汇总。
  - 每个进程和程序的趋势按 15 秒汇总。
  - 已退出的程序最多保留 300 个。
  - 卡顿和交互各最多 3000 条。
- **插件归属**：以下是 2026-10-17 用 DSH 自带运行时（Electron 44）、约 150 MB 的堆，在本机 16 个逻辑处理器上的探测结果。
  - **常驻开销**：每 10 毫秒采样，空闲时的 CPU 开销低于 Windows 能计量的精度。按每 1 毫秒采样的单核 2.3% 推算，约为整机的 0.02%。
  - **启动停顿**：启动分析器要扫描一遍后台的内存，后台约停顿 0.3 秒，随堆大小增长。所以它只在第一次读数时启动，窗口隐藏后再保持 10 分钟才停止，短暂切走再回来不会重复停顿。实际停顿时长显示在「统计口径」中。
  - **分段交接**：每段约 0.3 毫秒。
  - **读取内存**：一次完整的垃圾回收，150 MB 的堆约 0.1 秒，每 5 分钟最多一次，只在窗口可见时进行。
  - **数据保留**：原始样本只在后台用于汇总，每段归属后即丢弃；保留的是一小时内按分钟汇总的函数耗时，每个插件每分钟最多 20 项。不传原始数据给页面，不写磁盘。
- **页面渲染**：
  - 长时间范围按绘图宽度抽稀，每两个像素约画一个点；统计仍使用全部读数。实测一小时、1800 个读数的统计每次约 0.1–0.2 ms。
  - 页面没有循环播放的动画，只在数据更新或用户操作时短暂动一下。
- **包体**：侧栏入口约 14 KB，常驻加载；详情页约 89 KB，打开时才加载；后台部分约 22 KB。复用 DSH 的 React，不引入图表库、组件库或图标库。

0.2.0 曾在本机测得：采集器稳定后约占整机 0.06% CPU，专用工作集约 10 MB；0.3.0 与 0.4.0 的采集器检查中约 5 MB。插件归属在真实 DSH 后台中的停顿以「统计口径」里显示的为准；采集器部分可用下文的基准脚本复测。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm run check:collector
npm run check:browser
npm pack --pack-destination dist
```

- `npm run build`：用系统自带的 .NET Framework C# 编译器生成 `lib/collector.exe`，发布包同时包含 `native/Collector.cs` 源码。
- `npm test`：单元测试。其中两项在 Node 进程内真实运行 V8 的 CPU 与堆分析器，验证以下几点：
  - 分段交接后，一个模拟插件的忙循环被归到该插件，并给出函数与行号；
  - 它保留的内存被计入，而只是打印过的对象不计入；
  - 长时间没有读数后分析器停止，下一次读数时重新启动。
- `check:collector`：用一棵隔离的 Windows 进程树验证采集结果，包括：
  - 进程类型识别：主进程、界面渲染、GPU、Host，Host 启动的 Shell 及其子进程；
  - 树外同名程序被排除；
  - 整机计数与线程数的读取；
  - 可执行文件位于插件目录中的工具进程归属到该插件；
  - 每次读数带上后台主线程按插件的拆分；
  - 并发合并、闲置退出、重建基线与释放。
- `check:browser`：在隔离载体中加载实际构建的界面。请求由 Playwright 拦截应答，不占用端口。
  - 数据：采集读数为脚本化场景，卡顿和慢交互是 Chromium 真实产生的事件。
  - 验证范围：懒加载、选中态、整机占比、三轨联动与提示框（含后台主线程的拆分）、程序启停、联动高亮、已退出程序、侧边详情、排序、插件分区与插件详情（拆分数据为脚本化场景）、插件自带进程、可见性暂停、错误与重试、窄屏和深色主题。
  - 截图保存在 `artifacts/`；需要 Playwright Chromium。

可选：对正在运行的 DSH 做只读实测。参数换成桌面主进程的 PID，即任务管理器「详细信息」页中最上层的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe`：

```powershell
node --import tsx scripts/benchmark.ts <DSH桌面主进程PID>
```

## 文件结构

```text
native/Collector.cs    Windows 只读采集器：沿进程树读取 CPU 时间、内存、线程、进程类型、可执行文件路径和整机计数
src/collector.ts       采集器生命周期、请求合并与缓存
src/plugins.ts         从 profile 读取已安装插件及其目录
src/profiler.ts        后台进程内常驻的 V8 CPU 与堆采样，随读数分段交接，按时读取内存
src/attribution.ts     把采样结果按调用栈归到插件、DSH 模块、垃圾回收
src/metrics.ts         进程分类、CPU 与整机占用计算
src/insights.ts        历史点、抽稀、区间统计、工具进程合并与命名
src/tracking.ts        每个进程的 15 秒趋势与程序启停记录
src/responsiveness.ts  卡顿帧与交互延迟记录
src/controller.ts      共享采样器与可见性管理
src/api.ts             页面到后台路由的请求
src/host.ts            DSH Host API
src/client.tsx         侧栏入口与详情页懒加载
src/page.tsx           详情页
src/now.tsx            此刻：整机占比
src/timeline.tsx       三轨联动趋势与工具进程运行条
src/processes.tsx      进程表
src/details.tsx        进程详情侧栏
src/plugin-section.tsx 插件分区：后台按插件拆分与自带进程
src/owner.tsx          插件详情侧栏：曲线、耗时函数与内存位置
src/spark.tsx          趋势小图
tests/                 单元测试与隔离载体
scripts/               构建、原生验证、浏览器验证与基准
```

MIT License。运行时复用 DSH 提供的 React；采集器只调用 Windows API 和系统 .NET Framework。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: report what a GitNexus index left out — skipped large files, index coverage, and git activity crossed with the index.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitnexus-plus

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for **GitNexus index visibility** — starting with the part
GitNexus itself cannot tell you: **what the index left out**.

## The problem it solves

`gitnexus analyze` silently drops files. Its entire surface for saying so is one
line on stderr, printed once:

```
  Skipped 3 large files (>512KB, likely generated/vendored)
    - dist/app.min.js
    ...and 2 more (set GITNEXUS_VERBOSE=1 to list them all)
```

That line is not returned, not persisted, not queryable, and gone when the terminal
scrolls. Meanwhile the files it names can be the difference between an index that
represents your codebase and one that does not — measured on this machine,
`material-ui` skips 4.4 MB (12.4 % of scanned bytes), and those files contribute
**zero** symbols to the graph.

This plugin turns that line into data, a tool, and a route.

## What this project is, and what it is not

[GitNexus](https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus) is a code-intelligence engine by
**Abhigyan Patwari**. It parses a repository into symbols, relationships and execution
flows and writes them to a local graph database. It is a genuinely good piece of work,
and this project would have nothing to show without it.

What GitNexus does not give an everyday user is **visibility** and **automation**:

- **Visibility** — how much of the repository does the index actually cover? Which files
  were skipped for being too large? Has the index fallen behind `HEAD`, and by how much?
  The CLI does not answer those unasked, and the answer is invisible exactly when it
  matters.
- **Automation** — once an index is stale, somebody has to remember to refresh it.

**This project is a layer that adds those two things and nothing else.** It reads the
index GitNexus wrote, reports what the index left out, and can start an incremental
refresh through GitNexus's own CLI.

It does **not**:

- fork GitNexus, patch it, or reimplement its parser or graph database;
- redistribute GitNexus source. Nothing from that project is inside this package's
  tarball. `gitnexus` is declared as a **peer**, not a dependency, so installing this
  plugin installs nothing from it — the operator supplies GitNexus, by whatever means,
  and the two stay separate;
- claim authorship of, or any contribution to, GitNexus. All rights in GitNexus belong
  to its author;
- replace GitNexus. With no GitNexus index there is nothing here to display.

## Licence — read this before a commercial use

This project is **MIT** (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

**It depends on GitNexus, which is `PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0`.** That licence grants
noncommercial use and restricts commercial use. GitNexus is **not** a dependency of this
package — it is a peer, so installing this plugin does not install it, and the plugin
never bundles or redistributes it. Installing this plugin's package therefore installs
nothing under that licence. But every GitNexus-backed feature — reading an index,
refreshing one, installing one on request — puts your use of *GitNexus* under
*GitNexus's* licence:

- **your use of this plugin's GitNexus-backed features is subject to GitNexus's
  licence**, not to this project's MIT grant;
- **commercial use requires a separate grant from GitNexus's author.** If your use is
  commercial, read
  <https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/blob/main/LICENSE> or contact the author
  before relying on any of it.

This project cannot and does not change that: it only calls the interfaces GitNexus
provides. The read-only half — reading `.gitnexus/gitnexus.json` and reporting on it —
is this project's own code and carries no GitNexus code, but it also has nothing to
report on unless GitNexus produced that file.

A one-line summary: **the MIT licence here covers my code; GitNexus's licence covers
GitNexus, and installing this plugin installs GitNexus.**

## What it reports

- **Skipped large files** — path, size, share of its language, and two independent
  signals for *why* it is not source: a single-line (minified) heuristic, and a
  build-output path heuristic. Binary assets are detected separately and never
  called minified.
- **Index freshness** — the indexed commit against HEAD, classified `current` /
  `behind` / `diverged` / `unknown` the same way `gitnexus status` does, plus the
  uncommitted-change count.
- **Graph composition** — nodes, edges, communities, processes, embeddings, and
  edges-per-node, all read from the manifest.
- **Query surfaces** — which of graph / keyword search / semantic search are
  actually available, with the reason when one is not. An index with no FTS cannot
  answer keyword queries, and hiding that is how a reader concludes otherwise.
- **Git activity, crossed with the index** — recent commits, authors (bots marked),
  branches, most-changed files and most-recent files, each carrying a three-way
  verdict: *indexed*, *excluded by design*, or **missing from the index**. That last
  one is the point: of the files people are actively editing, which does the graph
  not see?
- **Language distribution by bytes**, split three ways: languages GitNexus can
  *parse* into the graph, formats it merely *recognizes*, and everything else.
- **Resolver confidence** — untyped receiver sites, which make `impact` and
  `context` a lower bound rather than an exact answer.

## Why the git three-way split matters

A two-way "indexed / not indexed" count is misleading. Measured on a real
repository, 1 635 files had been touched in 90 days: 491 indexed, 1 143 absent, and
reporting that as "70 % missing" is wrong — 1 143 of them are lockfiles, dotfiles
and binary assets that no scan would select either. Exactly **one** was a genuine
gap (`src/stores/windowModeStore.ts`). The panel reports the three numbers
separately, and only the third raises a warning.


## Design commitments

**Reuse, don't reimplement.** "Which files did GitNexus skip?" has exactly one
correct answer: the set `walkRepositoryPaths` produced. This plugin deep-imports
GitNexus's own `createIgnoreFilter`, `glob` call and `getLanguageFromFilename`
rather than approximating them, and `test/run.mjs` cross-checks its scan against
`walkRepositoryPaths` on real repositories. If upstream reshapes those modules the
plugin degrades to a documented fallback scan (`ScanReport.primitives === 'fallback'`)
instead of reporting a wrong number.

**Absent is reported as absent.** The size cap an index was built under is read from
that index. Legacy indexes (`meta.json`, no `indexCoverage`) are reported with the
cap *unknown* and a note — never defaulted to today's value, which would misattribute
covered files as skipped.

**Read-only.** Nothing here triggers `analyze`, writes to `.gitnexus/`, or takes the
index lock. A status check must never start a 30-second rebuild.

## Getting GitNexus — the prerequisite, and the two ways to satisfy it

This plugin reads an index. **Only GitNexus produces one.** So the plugin checks
whether GitNexus is present, and when it is not, the panel says so above everything else
rather than letting you wonder why the numbers are missing.

Two ways out, in the order the panel offers them:

**① Install it yourself.** The panel shows a copyable `npm install -g gitnexus`, and
that is the recommendation. You know your network, your registry and your toolchain; a
command you can run is more useful than a download this plugin performs on your behalf,
and it works behind whatever mirror or feed your machine actually reaches.

**② Let the plugin install it.** Second in the list and behind a confirmation, because
it is a much larger decision. It runs, through the host's shell executor:

```
npm install --prefix <DSH_HOME>/gitnexus-plus/gitnexus gitnexus@^1.6.12
```

and the confirmation states what that means before anything starts:

- **about 500 MB to 1 GB** downloaded, from whatever registry your `.npmrc` already
  names — this plugin hardcodes none, because a hardcoded one breaks exactly the users
  whose network is why they need this path;
- **several minutes**, longer on a slow link or when the native modules have to compile;
- **this machine's build toolchain is used** — `@ladybugdb/core`, `tree-

plugins.description: Cut model-facing tokens out of tool output before it enters a request. A global DeepSeek Harness plugin: lossless normalization, annotated repetition collapse, and recoverable structure-aware trimming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-diet

A global DeepSeek Harness plugin that removes tokens from tool output **before**
that output can enter a model request — without removing anything the model may
need, and without changing what the model is able to do.

```
tests/t0.py::case PASSED
tests/t1.py::case PASSED
…
[... 12235 of 12416 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 4 diagnostic lines
 retained, middle elided ...]
______________________ test_charge_card_rejects_expired _______________________
src/payments/charge.py:118: in charge_card
E   CardExpiredError: card expired 2024-01-31
FAILED tests/test_payments.py::test_charge_card_rejects_expired
[…]
…899 tests collected…
(Trimmed 12235 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/session-…/bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path.)
```

## The problem it solves

Every tool result becomes part of the conversation the moment it is logged, and
from then on the model re-reads it on every step of the session. The shipped
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` only trims **once a compaction trigger
qualifies**, and rewriting a result that late invalidates the prompt-cache prefix
that was already established — so trimming late costs extra as well as saving.

`dsh-context-diet` runs at `tools/post-execute`, the last waterfall before the
registry freezes a result into a `tool/result` event. A rewrite there belongs to
the call it came from: there is no cache prefix to invalidate, no second copy to
reconcile, and no durable edit to replay.

## What it removes

### 1. Lossless normalization (on by default)

Reduces output to what a terminal would actually display. A terminal shows no
glyph for an escape sequence, so removing one cannot change meaning.

| Transform | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape sequences | `\e[31merror\e[0m` | `error` |
| OSC hyperlinks and titles | `\e]8;;http://x\a link` | `link` |
| Carriage-return overlays | `10%\r50%\r100%` | `100%` |
| Backspace erasure | `ab\bc` | `ac` |
| Trailing whitespace | `a   \n` | `a\n` |
| Blank-line padding | `a\n\n\n\n\nb` | `a\n\nb` |

### 2. Annotated compaction (on by default)

A run of at least `repeatThreshold` (8) byte-identical consecutive lines that is
also at least `repeatMinRunChars` (1000) characters long becomes one line naming
the exact repeat count:

```
npm warn deprecated inflight@1.0.6: This module is not supported…  [x400 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

The run is collapsed **only when the annotation is strictly shorter than the run
it replaces**, so this pass can never enlarge a result. The count is preserved, so
the run is exactly reconstructible from the annotation and nothing is dropped
silently — which is why this pass needs no recovery file.

### 3. Recoverable, structure-aware trimming (on by default above 32,000 characters)

A result still larger than `maxInlineChars` is replaced by:

1. its head (`headChars`),
2. an omission marker stating exactly how much was dropped,
3. **the diagnostically significant lines from the omitted middle** — errors,
   failures, exceptions, assertions, stack frames, diff hunks and headers, and
   `file:line:col` references (`significantChars`), and
4. its tail (`tailChars`),

followed by a notice naming a spill file that holds the complete normalized text,
with the backend's own retrieval guidance.

Blind head/tail cutting discards the middle unconditionally. Keeping the
diagnostic lines makes the same budget **strictly more informative**, not less —
measured on a 900-test `pytest -v` run, every one of `CardExpiredError`,
`charge.py:118`, `test_charge_card_rejects_expired`, and `1 failed, 899 passed`
survives with this plugin and is lost by a head/tail cut of the same size.

## Why quality is not affected

- **Nothing is dropped without a record.** Every removal is either a
  control character a terminal never displays, or something that is counted,
  annotated, and written verbatim to a spill file the notice tells the model how
  to read.
- **`read` is exempt by default.** File-content output is line-addressed: blank-line
  or trailing-whitespace rewriting would corrupt content a model may quote back
  at an editor. This matches the shipped `dsh-spill-policy`, which exempts `read`
  for the same reason.
- **The default budget is conservative.** No result under 32,000 characters —
  roughly 8,000 tokens — is touched at all, except by the lossless passes.
- **It cannot alter capability.** It registers no tools, removes none, changes no
  prompts, and changes no model or reasoning settings. Tool schemas, the system
  prompt, and the tool catalog are byte-identical to a run without it, so the
  prompt cache behaves exactly as before.
- **It never makes a model call and never adds a request.**
- **It fails open.** Any unexpected shape, missing service, or thrown error
  returns the incoming result untouched and logs a warning. `verify.mjs` covers
  each of those paths.

## Measured effect

On a synthetic but realistic bash-heavy corpus (900-test `pytest -v`, `npm install`
with 400 repeated deprecation warnings, 2,400-line `cargo build`, a `curl`
progress bar, and a 3,000-entry `find`), with shipped defaults:

| Result | Before | Model sees | Removed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `pytest -v`, buried failure | 48,002 | 12,555 | 74% |
| `npm install`, 400 repeats | 33,711 | 236 | 99% |
| `cargo build`, buried error | 158,997 | 20,218 | 87% |
| `curl` progress bar | 4,572 | 61 | 99% |
| `find` over a large tree | 130,890 | 12,218 | 91% |
| **Total** | **376,172** | **45,288** | **88%** |

The lossless tier alone accounts for 15% of that; the rest is annotated
compaction and recoverable trimming. Character counts are not billed tokens —
the figures are indicative, and `/diet` reports the real numbers for the session
you are in.

### Verified against a running Harness

Both passes were exercised live, through the real `tools/post-execute` waterfall
of a running `dsh web` profile, using the real `dsh-spill-local` backend:

```text
$ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo "SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING"; done
SAME LINE PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING PADDING  [x30 identical lines omitted by dsh-context-diet]
```

```text
$ awk '… 570 lines with an error at line 285 …'
download asset 0000 of 0570 ================================================
…
[... 31890 of 43967 characters omitted by dsh-context-diet; 1 diagnostic lines retained, middle elided ...]

src/engine/pipeline.rs:204:7 - error TS2345: UNIQUE_BURIED_DIAGNOSTIC_MARKER

[...]
…
download asset 0569 of 0570 ================================================

(Trimmed 31890 characters. Full normalized result stored at:
 /…/c1cbcd405966-bash.txt. Use read with offset/limit, or grep this path to search within it.)
```

The 43,967-character result reached the model as 12,077 characters (72% smaller),
the diagnostic line that a head/tail cut would have dropped was retained, and the
recovery file was verified to hold all 571 lines of the original output.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-context-diet
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-context-diet → on**.
   An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.

The bundle inserts one global Host row, so it applies to every session in the
profile — not to a single session. It needs no credentials and no other plugin;
the `tools/post-execute` seam is part of `dsh-tools`, and the spill backend comes
from `dsh-spill-local`, both of which the shipped compositions provide. Without a
spill backend the plugin still normalizes and compacts, and simply declines to
trim, because trimming without a recovery file would lose information.

## Configuration

Every field is optional; omitting it keeps the shipped default. Override any of
them in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is applied after bundle
layers and therefore survives plugin upgrades:

```yaml
- id: context-diet
  name: 'dsh-context-diet'
  config:
    maxInlineChars: 64000     # 0 keeps only the lossless and annotated passes
    exemptTools: ['read', 'read_image']
    repeatTh

plugins.description: 抓虾 Office 插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 生成、文本提取与 OOXML 检查校验。独立运行，无需 Python 或抓虾后端。
plugins.readme_text:
# 抓虾 Office 插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 文档

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

`dsh-crawshrimp-office` 是一个独立的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Office 文档插件，面向本地、可复核的小型 Word 和 PowerPoint 工作流。它可以生成真实的 `.docx` 和 `.pptx` 文件，将有界 Markdown 转换为 DOCX，读取 Word 与逐页 PowerPoint 文本，检查 OOXML ZIP 结构，并按预期文本或数量校验文档。

它适合生成会议纪要、周报、简短方案、简单演示文稿和本地文档质量检查。文件留在配置的工作区内，不调用抓虾 API、共享 connector、模型服务或外部网络。

## 快速开始

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4`。当前发布标签是 `v0.2.0`，通过 DSH 官方插件加载器从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile demo add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office#v0.2.0
```

安装后，可以直接让 DSH 完成本地任务，例如：“用 `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` 把这份周报保存为 `reports/weekly.docx`，再用 `crawshrimp_office_validate` 检查它是否包含‘本周总结’。”也可以直接调用工具；示例参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)。

插件默认将 `./crawshrimp-office-output` 作为工作区。启动 profile 前可以指定专用目录：

```bash
export CRAWSHRIMP_OFFICE_WORKSPACE="$HOME/crawshrimp-office-output"
```

`-w` 让 DSH CLI 在 profile workspace 中添加插件。安装器会读取 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并自动加载 `cordis.patch.yml`；需要手动加载 patch 的宿主可以使用 [`examples/cordis.patch.yml`](./examples/cordis.patch.yml)。如果宿主需要直接嵌入插件，请加载完整模块命名空间，让 Cordis 同时注册 `apply` 和工具 schema：

```js
import * as office from 'dsh-crawshrimp-office'

await ctx.plugin(office, { workspaceDir: './crawshrimp-office-output' })
```

## 能力与工具

插件实际注册以下 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 | 审批 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_create` | 用标题、段落和简单字符串表格生成 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_read` | 从现有 DOCX 提取有上限的纯文本。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_create` | 生成标题页以及标题/项目符号页组成的 PPTX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_inspect` | 查看 DOCX/PPTX 的 OOXML ZIP 结构、条目元数据和数量。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` | 将有上限的 Markdown 标题、段落、列表和简单表格转换为 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_read` | 读取 PPTX 每一页的有上限纯文本，不解码媒体。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_validate` | 校验 DOCX/PPTX 必需部件及可选的预期文本、表格数或幻灯片数。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |

所有文件名都必须是工作区内的相对路径。插件会解析真实路径，拒绝目录穿越和逃逸到工作区外的符号链接，不覆盖已有输出，并先写临时文件，再以不可覆盖的原子方式落盘。

## 使用示例

生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/brief.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "paragraphs": ["A short, reviewable summary."],
  "tables": [{
    "headers": ["Metric", "Value"],
    "rows": [["Orders", "12"]]
  }]
}
```

用 Markdown 生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/weekly.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "markdown": "# Weekly brief\n\n- Orders: 12\n- Returns: 1\n\n| Metric | Value |\n| --- | --- |\n| Conversion | 4.2% |"
}
```

生成 PPTX：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/launch-plan.pptx",
  "title": "Launch plan",
  "slides": [{
    "heading": "Milestones",
    "bullets": ["Design", "Review"]
  }]
}
```

更多参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)、[`examples/slides-read.json`](./examples/slides-read.json) 和 [`examples/validate.json`](./examples/validate.json)。

Markdown 转换支持标题、段落、有序/无序列表、引用、作为纯文本保留的围栏代码和简单管道表格。行内强调和链接会展平为文本。HTML 会被剥离并返回 warning；图片和媒体语法会保留 alt 文本并返回 warning。插件不会抓取或嵌入外部媒体，也不会执行 HTML；不支持的 Markdown 会在安全范围内保留为纯文本。

`crawshrimp_office_slides_read` 返回 `slideCount` 和每页有上限的文本，只读取 OOXML 文本节点。`crawshrimp_office_validate` 在预期文本或数量不满足时返回 `valid: false`；损坏 ZIP、缺失 OOXML 必需部件、无效 XML 及 DTD/entity 声明会真实返回工具错误。

## 权限与上限

写调用使用宿主的 DSH 原生权限信号。会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有的完全权限授予允许写入，无需重复弹出逐次审批；`ask`、受限模式，或审批/沙箱服务缺失、读取异常时，仍走原生审批路径，只有收到 `allowed-once` 才执行。插件没有单独绕过原生审批的配置项。

默认限制单个输入文件 16 MiB、单个生成文件 16 MiB、Markdown 输入 512 KiB、文本提取 128 KiB；段落、表格、幻灯片、项目符号、Markdown block 和 ZIP 条目也有数量上限。可以通过插件配置中的 `workspaceDir`、`maxInputBytes`、`maxOutputBytes`、`maxTextBytes`、`maxMarkdownBytes` 在限定范围内调整。

## 实际边界

实现范围是 OOXML 包的生成、读取和结构校验。插件不转 PDF/PNG，不运行 LibreOffice，也不执行视觉审查。生成成功结果会返回 `visualReview: "not_rendered"`；只有在另行完成渲染并经过人工或模型检查后，才能描述为视觉已验证。`office_run`、Office COM、宏、公式、图表、媒体解码和任意 Python 执行不属于本包。

示例和测试只使用本地临时文件，不调用模型、商家账号或外部网络服务。该包不编辑已有 Office 文档的任意复杂排版，也不渲染图表或重新计算公式。

## 与其他功能包的关系

当前维护三个可独立安装的功能包：[Browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 负责网页操作、登录态和页面脚本，[Data](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data) 负责记录与表格，Office 负责文档。PDF、标签、模板和渲染归 Office 路线图，0.2.0 尚未实现。

0.2.0 新增 Markdown 转 DOCX、PPTX 逐页文本读取、结构/内容校验，并对齐 DSH 原生完全权限映射。

plugins.description: A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Office

**Tiny coworkers. Real work.** Watch your DeepSeek Harness agents work in a living pixel office.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · MIT · Zero runtime dependencies · No extra API key

![Animated Agent Office preview — simulated events](docs/demo.gif)

Your agents leave their desks to use tools, queue up when they need approval, and take a breather when a turn finishes. Click a coworker to inspect their activity. Everything in live mode comes from Harness session events.

## Try the office in 10 seconds

Clone this repository and run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office.git
cd dsh-agent-office
node src/demo.mjs
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319**. No install, build step, model, or API key required. Demo mode uses **simulated events** and is visibly labeled. This command previews the UI; it does not connect to a running Harness.

## Connect your actual agents

Requires Node **22.19+** and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-alpha.4**. This first release deliberately declares only the DSH version whose API was checked. New DSH releases need compatibility verification before widening `engines.dsh`.

From a directory containing the downloaded `dsh-agent-office` folder:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile office add ./dsh-agent-office
dsh --profile office web
```

If the CLI is not globally installed, replace `dsh` with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.4`. Configure your model in the Harness profile as usual. Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319** alongside the Harness UI and start a task. The office logs its URL to the terminal when loaded.

To install into an existing profile, substitute its name for `office`. A server restart is needed after installation. Stop the standalone demo before enabling the plugin: both default to port 4319. The first release is a separate browser dashboard, not an embedded Harness sidebar or an operating-system desktop overlay.

### Source checkout / overlay

Generate an overlay with the absolute module path:

```sh
node scripts/make-patch.mjs > office.local.patch.yml
dsh --profile office web --patch ./office.local.patch.yml
```

The generated YAML uses an absolute path because DSH resolves plugin module paths from the profile. The overlay command works without installing the bundle.

## What's inside

- Original procedural pixel art: focus desks, tool lab, approval corner, sofas, plants, and animated coworkers. No downloaded assets or font services.
- Real event projection for main sessions and subagent sessions. Parent links represent **session lineage**, not inferred conversations.
- Independent pending-tool and approval tracking; parallel requests do not prematurely clear a waiting status.
- Distinct completion, error, blocked, paused, and idle states. “Done” means a turn completed, not that the project passed acceptance tests.
- Clickable roster, activity feed, per-session steps/tool calls/reported tokens, and PNG scene export.
- English / 简体中文, midnight / daylight themes, focus view, mobile layout, and reduced-motion support.
- Reconnecting event stream with an explicit stale-state indicator.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the agent loop.

![Desktop preview — simulated events](docs/screenshot.png)

## Configuration

Edit the installed bundle row through your profile overlay:

```yaml
- id: agent-office
  config:
    port: 4320
    maxAgents: 48
    maxEvents: 120
```

| Setting     | Default | Range      | Purpose                                               |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `port`      | 4319    | 1024–65535 | Loopback-only office server                           |
| `maxAgents` | 48      | 1–200      | Tracked sessions; inactive sessions are evicted first |
| `maxEvents` | 120     | 10–500     | In-memory activity history                            |

Up to **12 coworkers are drawn at once**; all tracked sessions remain selectable in the roster. Selecting another session brings it onto the floor. If the tracking cap is full of active sessions, new sessions are ignored until a slot becomes available. Counters cover retained sessions since plugin startup, not lifetime totals. UI feed shows the latest six events.

The port is fixed rather than silently changed. If occupied, the plugin logs an actionable error and leaves Harness running. Change it in your configuration and restart.

## Data and permissions

The office observes `session/event` and `session/disposed` at the profile root. It does not register tools, intercept execution, approve operations, or send data to a third party. Approval happens in the original Harness conversation.

Only session IDs, parent IDs, generated names, the last folder name of the working directory, tool names, lifecycle statuses, timestamps, and reported token counts enter the office projection. Prompts, assistant text, reasoning, tool arguments/results, full paths, and approval explanations are excluded. Displayed text is inserted as text, not HTML.

The HTTP server binds exclusively to `127.0.0.1`, checks Host and Origin, has no write endpoints, and closes on plugin unload. Any process or user with access to this machine's loopback can read the displayed metadata. This version is intended for a trusted local machine, not remote hosting. Do not expose its port publicly.

State is in memory. Existing idle conversations and pre-load history are not imported; a session appears on its next observed event. A restart clears the office. A detached session remains as a paused/terminal entry until eviction. Tasks run in a different Harness process are not visible.

## Development and verification

```sh
node --test
node --check public/app.js
```

Eight dependency-free tests cover concurrent tools/approvals, terminal reasons, bounded history, sensitive-data exclusion, token accounting, HTTP/SSE, host/origin protection, port conflicts, and cleanup. Published Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.2** and DSH SessionStore **0.2.1-alpha.4** were separately used to check real session append → plugin → HTTP state and unload cleanup. A full model-backed DSH end-to-end run has not yet been performed.

Browser checks cover desktop/mobile layouts, SSE updates, selection, both languages, themes, focus, and PNG export. See [verification notes](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Share the little office

The preview GIF and screenshots in `docs/` are ready for a GitHub README or release post. They are labeled demonstrations. Source: [xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office](https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office). This plugin has not been published to npm.

Suggested repository description: **A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.**

Suggested GitHub topics: `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`, `ai-agents`, `pixel-art`, `agent-observability`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Independent community plugin; not an official DeepSeek product.

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: your own OpenAI-compatible image relay as the image2_generate tool, with inline media previews.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-image2-tool ![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin?display_name=tag&sort=semver&label=release) ![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image2-tool?label=npm) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-image2-tool?label=downloads) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1-4B5563) ![Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6) **Language**: [中文](README.md) · English **社区插件标签**：`dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `cordis` · `bundle` · `text-to-image` · `image-to-image` · `image-generation` · `ai-image` · `image-relay` · `openai-compatible` · `inline-media` · `web-ui` · `tool` 给 **DeepSeek Harness** 加上「一句话生成图片」和「拿参考图改图」的能力：接你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站，生成的图**直接内联显示在对话里**。 ![dsh-image2-tool 横幅](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/544244857/dsh-image2-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.jpg) --- ## 亮点 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 一行安装 | 官方通用方式 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool`，重启后工具表出现 `image2_generate` | | 自己的中转站 | 文生图走 `POST /images/generations`，图生图走 `POST /images/edits`，同时支持 `b64_json` 与图片 URL 两种返回 | | 参考图引导 | 给 `image` 传一张本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP，角色一致性、画风与配色远比纯文字描述稳 | | 图形化配置 | 侧边栏 Plugins 页内置设置行（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 字段），也可直接写 `cordis.patch.yml` | | 视觉自检 | 生成后用原生 `read_image` 复核真实文件，不把「接口成功」当成「视觉合格」 | | 内联预览 | 自动带上 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)，图片直接渲染在回复下方，无需点开卡片 | | 克制默认 | `autoGenerateAssets` 默认 `false`，普通开发任务不会悄悄花掉生图额度；输出被限制在会话目录内 | ## 使用示例 下面两张图来自一次真实会话：让 Agent「生成一张 GPT 化龙指导器的形象」，它自己挑参考图、比对版本、迭代出成品。 **对话里长这样** —— 生成过程、参考图、版本对比都在回复里，图片由内联预览直接渲染，不用点开任何卡片（长图，可点开看全）： **最终结果** —— 该会话产出的成品（864 × 1152）： > 复现方式：装好插件后直接对 Agent 说「生成一张 XXX 的图」即可。`autoGenerateAssets` 保持默认 `false` 时，只有你明确要求才会生图。 ## 参考图引导（图生图） 只要调用里带上 `image`，插件就改走 `POST /images/edits`： ```jsonc { "prompt": "保持这个角色设定，改成少女比例，正常七头身，不要 Q 版", "image": "imagegen-output/reference.jpg", // 相对会话目录或绝对路径 "aspectRatio": "3:4", "filename": "result.jpg" } ``` | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `prompt` | 必填。要生成或要改什么 | | `image` | 可选。本地参考图路径（PNG/JPEG/WebP，≤ 20 MB）。给了就走图生图，不给就是文生图 | | `filename` | 可选。输出文件名，不含目录 | | `size` | 可选。形如 `1024x1024`。只认 `aspect_ratio` 的中转站会忽略它 | | `aspectRatio` | 可选。形如 `3:4`、`16:9`，以 `aspect_ratio` 字段发出。中转站忽略 `size` 时用它控制构图 | 细节： - 参考图按**魔术字节**判定真实类型，不信任扩展名；文件不存在、不是普通文件、超过 20 MB、或不是受支持的图片格式，都在**发出请求之前**就报错，不浪费额度。 - 上传用 `multipart/form-data`，`Content-Type` 与 boundary 交给 `FormData` 处理。 - 中转站若不接受 `response_format`，把 `responseFormat` 设为空字符串即可不发该字段。 ## 安装 ### 官方通用方式（推荐） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add dsh-image2-tool ``` 把 `` 换成你常用的 profile 名（例如 `web`、`default`）。装完**重启 DSH**，工具表里就会出现 `image2_generate`。 ### 其它等价方式 ```powershell # 从 GitHub Release 下载的 tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-image2-tool-0.4.1.tgz # 直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile add github:544244857/dsh-image2-plugin # 本地源码目录（开发调试） dsh plugin --profile add ./plugins/deepseek-harness-image2 ``` 需要新建一个独立 profile 时： ```powershell dsh --profile image2-demo --from-default-profile web --dump-config ``` ## 配置 两种方式等价、可互换，**二选一**即可。 **① 图形界面**：侧边栏 → Plugins → `dsh-image2-tool` → `image2` 行，逐项填写（含遮蔽的 `apiKey` 密钥字段），保存即写回当前 profile 的 Cordis patch。 **② 配置文件**：`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）： ```yaml - id: image2 name: dsh-image2-tool config: baseUrl: https://your-image-relay.example.com/v1 model: grok-imagine-image-2.0 apiKeyEnv: IMAGE2_API_KEY autoGenerateAssets: false outputDir: imagegen-output timeoutMs: 180000 responseFormat: b64_json ``` | 字段 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | 中转站地址（OpenAI 兼容，含 `/v1`） | | `model` | 模型名，**必须**是该中转站 `/v1/models` 里真实存在的名字，否则调用返回 404 | | `apiKeyEnv` | API key 的**环境变量名**（不是 key 本身） | | `apiKey` | 设置页里的遮蔽字段；非空时优先于 `apiKeyEnv`，后者作为兜底 | | `autoGenerateAssets` | 是否允许在软件开发任务中自动补齐缺失位图素材，默认 `false` | | `outputDir` | 输出目录，相对会话目录解析并强制不越界 | | `timeoutMs` | 单次请求超时 | | `responseFormat` | 向中转站索要的返回格式，默认 `b64_json`（图片字节内联回传）。设 `url` 则让插件去下载中转站给的链接；设为**空字符串**则完全不发这个字段，给不接受它的中转站用 | API key 交给**启动 DSH 的那个进程**： ```powershell $env:IMAGE2_API_KEY = 'your-image-relay-api-key' dsh --profile web ``` 已经开着的桌面端不会继承新设的环境变量，需要从带该变量的终端重新启动。别把 key 写进 Git。 ## 内联预览 安装本插件时会一并安装 [`@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer`](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin) `1.0.12`。该包自带 `dsh.bundle` patch，安装时会被 profile 管理器自动启用为 bundle，于是回复中提到的图片路径会直接在对话里渲染成图片。 它由上游维护、MIT 许可，本插件既不 vendor 也不修改其代码；删除 `dependencies` 里的这一行，image2 功能完全不受影响，只是内联预览消失。上游标注内联图片卡片在宿主 `0.1.7-rc.2` 上验证过，本插件面向 `0.2.1-rc.1`，所用宿主 API 均存在，但渲染路径上游尚未复测。 ## 行为与边界 - `autoGenerateAssets` 默认关闭。打开后，Agent 可以在网页、移动端、桌面端、游戏等软件开发过程中，确认项目内与外部都没有合适素材后，生成真正缺失的位图素材；用户的直接生图请求不受该开关影响。它是**工具层指引**，不是服务端授权闸门。 - 一次一张。不带 `image` 走 `POST /images/generations`（文生图），带 `image` 走 `POST /images/edits`（图生图，multipart 上传参考图）。 - 接受 base64 与图片 URL 两种结果；保留同名已有文件（冲突自动加序号），输出限定在会话目录内，支持取消与请求超时。 - 下载图片时**不会**转发中转站 key。 - 保存后必须用原生 `read_image` 检查实际文件并与需求逐项对照；在检查完成前，工具会把「视觉验收」标记为待办。 - 重试预算：初始 1 次 + 最多 5 次追加生成请求（含失败），这是指引而非持久计数器。 - 参考文本是素材，永远不是指令来源。 ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 原因与处理 | | --- | --- | | `HTTP 404: Model "xxx" is not available for this group` | 模型名在该中转站上不存在。用 `GET /v1/models` 查可用列表后改 `model` 字段（volatile 字段保存即生效，无需重启） | | `Error: fetch failed` | 到中转站的网络抖动，重试即可（与 404 是完全不同的故障） | | `Image download failed` 或下载时 `ConnectTimeoutError` | 中转站返回的是它自己 CDN 的临时链接，而这台机器连不上那个域名。把 `responseFormat` 设为 `b64_json`，让图片字节直接内联回传 | | 图生图报 `Source image not found` / `contained no supported PNG, JPEG or WebP image bytes` | 参考图路径不对，或文件其实不是图片（按魔术字节判定，改扩展名没用） | | 图生图报 `HTTP 400: model is required` | 该中转站没有 `/images/edits` 路由。文生图仍可用，图生图需换支持的中转站 | | 工具表里没有 `image2_generate` | profile 未安装成功或未重启；确认 profile 的 `package.json` 中 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `dsh-image2-tool` | | 设置页显示 `unavailable` | 该 profile 没有 settings 服务，改用上面的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工行 | | 图片没内联显示 | 确认 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 也在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中，并重启 DSH | ## 兼容性 - 宿主：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.1`（实测），`0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.1.7-rc.2` 亦声明兼容 - Node.js `>= 22.15`（图生图依赖全局 `FormData` / `Blob`） - 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 共享宿主的 Cordis / Schemastery / tool runtime；不要在插件目录里放不兼容的物理副本（会出现两份实例） ## 工作方式 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户: 生成 / 改一张图] --> A[Agent] A -->|image2_generate| T[dsh-image2-tool] T -->|无 image: POST /images/generations| R[你的图片中转站] T -->|有 image: POST /images/edits| R R -->|b64_json 或 url| T T --> F[会话目录 / outputDir] F --> V[read_image 视觉自检] V --> P[内联预览渲染在回复下方] ``` - 工具面：`image2_generate`（宿主工具注册表） - 客户端面：`lib/client.js` 向 Plugins 页注入 `image2` 配置行 - bundle 面：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件行 `id: image2` - 测试：`test/smoke.js` 用本地假中转站覆盖两条通道，不需要网络与额度 ## 许可 MIT © 2026 544244857。依赖 [@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer](https://github.com/Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin)（MIT，版权归其作者）。 --- English documentation: [README.en.md](README.en.md).
