plugins.readme_text:
# Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness

[中文](#中文说明) · [License](LICENSE) · [Compatibility and validation](docs/validation.md)

An experimental **native DSH agent preset**, combining task context, native/PTC interface selection, execution evidence, and stage reports. It preserves the host's permission system and full tool capability selection. It does not add a second model or an autonomous benchmark loop.

This is the standalone distribution of the author's Flow Next 1.8.3 mode. It is independently maintained and is not an official DeepSeek product. It is a separate project from other tools named Flow Next.

## Install

Tested with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**. The bundle declares this exact host version because DSH's preview APIs change quickly.

Open DSH's **Plugins** page, choose the external bundle installation option, and enter:

```text
https://github.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next.git#v1.8.3
```

The Plugin Manager installs and enables the bundle in the current profile. When DSH requires a restart, restart it, create a new conversation, and choose **Flow Next（试用）** before its first turn. Run `/flow-next status` to check the actual loaded version. Installing files does not migrate an existing conversation.

If you already use an earlier private distribution that registers the `flow-next` preset, disable that bundle before enabling this one; both register the same preset identifier. This release does not modify an existing installation automatically.

The official CLI's `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec>` installs a dependency. If using that path, also select the installed bundle in the profile's Plugins page; a dependency on disk alone does not establish activation.

## Use

Give it your ordinary task. It can answer a small question directly or work through repository changes using existing instructions and checks. Complex work can use the following tools and commands without turning every answer into a report:

| Surface | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `flow_select` | Choose native tools or PTC for a later request boundary while retaining full capabilities. |
| `flow_task` | Link native task entries to observed artifacts, checks, gaps, and a next action. |
| `flow_run_check` | Execute one check with explicit inputs and expected names through native execution and permission controls. |
| `flow_check` | Inspect execution observations; retain prospective scope, coverage declarations, and explanations. |
| `flow_stage` | Read a stage report, keeping failures, skips, disabled and unknown results distinct. |
| `/flow-next status` | Show the loaded version, current interface, and switch budget. |
| `/flow-next report`, `task`, `history`, `stage` | Read the relevant retained state without requesting a model response. |

A recorded zero exit, an agent's coverage declaration, and product acceptance remain different claims. The plugin cannot certify semantic correctness, visual quality, or that every relevant test was selected. Historical observations retain their provenance and do not become fresh acceptance merely by resuming a conversation.

## Development

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

The unit tests exercise the existing state, evidence, coordination, and check mechanisms. The separate installed-host smoke test uses fixed responses and blocks provider dispatch; see [validation](docs/validation.md). There is no claimed general improvement in task success, speed, or cost. Run comparative model trials separately when evaluating those outcomes.

The runtime files are under `lib/` and `modes/`. The root entry registers only Flow Next. The research benchmark panel, personal feedback records, model experiments, and project transcripts are excluded from this distribution. Runtime utility names such as `telemetry.js` describe local parsing helpers; this bundle does not mount the research collector or configure a remote reporting destination. DSH itself retains its own data and telemetry settings.

## Distribution

This package uses the official `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest and a Cordis patch. The repository is tagged `dsh-plugin` for community discovery. Its [custom market index](marketplace/index.json) follows DSH's documented format and pins install sources to Git commits; add the raw index URL under **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** after enabling **Custom plugin markets**.

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next/main/marketplace/index.json
```

The index also lists the companion [Ambitious Prompt](https://github.com/sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt) skill bundle. The index is a community-maintained source, with no claim of official review or endorsement. Native mode functionality requires DSH; copying these files into another agent's skills directory does not reproduce the runtime mechanisms.

References: [official plugin bundles](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/README.md), [official custom market format](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.md), [community contribution guidance](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## 中文说明

Flow Next 是 DeepSeek Harness 的原生模式插件，保留原生权限和完整工具能力，增加任务上下文、native/PTC 切换、检查执行证据与阶段报告。它不强制简单任务填写计划或输出报告，检查记录也不自动等于产品验收。

在 DSH 的插件页面安装上面的 Git 地址，启用后新建会话，首轮前选择「Flow Next（试用）」，用 `/flow-next status` 核对版本。当前公开版仅声明与实际验证过的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 兼容；预览版宿主升级后应重新验证。

本仓库独立整理运行代码和相关回归测试，未发布研究工作区、真实项目会话或个人配置。它不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。源码采用 MIT 许可证；宿主预设快照的来源与原许可证见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: DSH Maestro5 — Lead + L1–L5 difficulty-tier subagents for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). One install adds the Team Lead session mode and a per-tier model configuration page. ｜ DSH 团队模式插件：主控 + 五档难度子智能体，安装即得配置界面。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Maestro5 **一个主控 + L1–L5 五档难度子智能体，把「团队」变成 DeepSeek Harness 的默认工作方式。** 安装即获得「团队主控」模式与模型配置界面：主控负责拆任务、按难度与成本选档、并行分派、汇总复核；每个档位的模型都可以在设置页里独立配置。 [English](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/README.en.md) · [中文](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/README.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/blob/main/LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-informational)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5?label=release)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/releases/latest) [![validate](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/actions/workflows/validate.yml) [![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2f6feb)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/profile-web%20%7C%20desktop-lightgrey)](#兼容性) > 社区插件，与 DeepSeek AI 无隶属关系，也不是官方项目。 ![在「团队主控」模式下，主控并行派出 L1 / L2 两个子智能体，汇总后给出结果](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/chat-delegation.png)
--- ## 这是什么 **DSH Maestro5** 是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web 插件。装上之后，新任务里会多出一个 **「团队主控」** 模式： - 你说一句任务，**主控**先拆解，再决定「哪些自己做、哪些交给子智能体、交给哪一档」； - 有 **L1–L5 五档难度**子智能体，越往上模型越强、越慢、越贵； - 五档的工具集相同（文件、bash、联网、Office 技能），差异在**模型 / 思考强度 / 人设**，所以任何任务都能交给任何档； - 每一档用哪个 Provider、哪个模型、什么思考强度，都能在 **设置 → 团队模式** 里单独配置，模型列表直接来自你当前 DSH 的模型目录； - 安装插件即自动注册模式、五个档位 preset 和配置页——**不需要手动改任何配置文件**。 ### 为什么值得装 | 痛点 | Maestro5 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 一个模型包办所有任务，简单任务浪费贵模型 | 简单任务派 L1/L2（便宜快），关键交付才上 L4/L5（强而贵） | | 长任务一个上下文越滚越大，越跑越慢越贵 | 子任务在独立上下文里执行，主控只收结果，上下文更干净 | | 多个独立子任务只能串行做 | 主控可以在同一轮并行派出多个子智能体 | | 子智能体「用哪个模型」写死在代码里 | 设置页逐档配置，模型目录变化自动跟随 | | 高风险交付没人复核 | 主控人设要求关键交付再派 L4/L5 独立复核 | --- ## 截图 | 新任务里的「团队主控」模式 | 设置 → 团队模式（逐档配模型） | | --- | --- | | ![模式选择器：团队主控 + L1–L5 档位](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/mode-picker.png) | ![设置页：五档的 Provider / 模型 / 思考强度](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/settings-team-mode.png) | | 安装后出现在插件列表 | 实际分派过程 | | --- | --- | | ![已安装插件里的 DSH Maestro5](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/main/docs/screenshots/plugins-installed.png) | 见页面顶部大图：主控并行派出 L1 / L2，6 秒汇总交付 | --- ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 - **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或同系列 `0.2.x`**（插件声明了 `engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`） - **Web / Desktop profile**：本插件依赖 agent preset 注册表与 Web 设置界面，因此仅在 `web` / `desktop` profile 生效；headless / TUI profile 不适用 - 至少配置一个可用的模型 provider（**设置 → 模型**），否则子智能体没有可用的模型路由 ### 安装 三种方式任选一种，装完都得到同一个 bundle。 #### 方式 A：Web 界面（最直观） 1. 侧栏 **插件（Plugins）** → 右上角 **添加插件 ▾** → **安装第三方插件**； 2. 输入本地目录绝对路径，确认安装； 3. **刷新页面**（`Cmd+R` / `Ctrl+R`）加载浏览器端配置页； 4. 新建任务，模式选择器里应出现 **「团队主控」**。 #### 方式 B：从 GitHub 安装 ```sh # 源码安装（跟随 main 分支） dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5 # 或从 Releases 的打包文件安装（固定版本、可离线分发） dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/bigbigtooth/DSH-Maestro5/releases/latest/download/dsh-maestro5-0.1.0.tgz ``` > 桌面版如果提示找不到 `dsh` 命令，可在菜单栏用 **Manage dsh command** 把它装进 PATH（不同版本入口可能略有差异）。 > 安装完成后**重启 DSH**（bundle 层在启动时组装）；至少刷新页面以加载客户端半。 #### 方式 C：本地目录（开发态） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/DSH-Maestro5 ``` 本地目录是 `link:` 安装：源目录就是安装物，**改代码 / 改配置后重启 DSH 即生效，无需重装**。 ### 安装后验证清单 - [ ] 新任务 → 模式选择器出现 **「团队主控」**（旁边还有 `团队·L1` … `团队·L5` 五个档位卡，它们只供子智能体使用，不建议直接选作会话模式） - [ ] **设置 → 团队模式** 能打开，五个档位的 Provider / 模型 / 思考强度都能下拉选择 - [ ] **插件 → 已安装插件** 里出现 **DSH Maestro5**，点开后能看到 `maestro-levels` 行与 6 个 preset 行 - [ ] 发一句「用 delegate_l1 计算 1+1」，能看到主控派出子智能体并汇总结果 ### 设为默认模式（推荐） **设置 → Agent 预设 → 团队主控 → 设为新任务默认**。 > ⚠️ 不要通过编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 去改 `agent-preset-registry` 的默认值：那会让 preset 注册表重启，运行中的会话会丢失 preset 工具。请只用设置界面。 --- ## 使用 选中「团队主控」后，直接描述任务即可。主控会自己判断要不要派、派给谁、派几个。也可以直接指定档位： ```text 用 L1 把这份 CSV 转成 xlsx，保持表头不变。 先让 L2 整理这些素材，再让 L5 写终稿并做一次事实核查。 这件事拆成三份并行：L2 查资料、L3 做表、L4 写结论；最后你汇总并给我一页摘要。 ``` ### 主控怎么工作 1. **拆解**：把任务拆成独立、边界清晰的子任务；简单问答 / 单步操作自己做； 2. **选档**：机械可复核 → L1/L2；推理链长、错误代价高 → L4/L5；默认从最低可行档开始； 3. **分派**：每个子智能体拿到一份**自包含**的任务说明（背景、输入路径、方法、输出格式、落盘路径、验收标准）——它们看不到你的对话； 4. **并行**：互相独立的子任务在同一轮同时派出，而不是串行等待； 5. **复核**：结果回来后对照验收标准检查；关键交付再派 L4/L5 独立复核； 6. **交付**：汇总成结论 + 可直接使用的产物，并说明用了哪几档、产出在哪个文件。 ### 五档难度 | 档位 | 定位 | 默认模型 / 思考强度 | 适合任务 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **L1 极简执行** | 最便宜最快 | `deepseek-flash` / off | 格式转换、字段提取、简单改写、单步操作 | | **L2 常规执行** | 便宜且快 | `deepseek-flash` / low | 资料整理、摘要、日常写作、模板产出 | | **L3 复杂执行** | 性价比高 | `deepseek-flash` / max | 长文写作、多步脚本、表格分析、多来源整理 | | **L4 难题解决** | 较贵 | `deepseek-v4-pro` / high | 严谨分析、代码实现与调试、关键结论、方案设计 | | **L5 关键任务** | 最贵最慢 | `deepseek-v4-pro` / max | 疑难推理、终审复核、关键决策支持、最高质量交付 | > 表格是**出厂默认值**。你可以在设置页把任意一档换上你配置的任何 provider / 模型（例如 MiniMax、9router 里的模型）。 ### 成本控制建议 - 默认让主控「能用 L2 就不上 L4」； - 大批量同类任务用 L1/L2 并行，比单个高价模型串行更划算； - 只有**错误代价高**的交付才用 L4/L5，并且只让 L5 做终审而不是全程主力。 --- ## 配置每档模型 **入口：设置（Settings）→ 团队模式**（与插件页 **插件 → DSH Maestro5 → 行 `maestro-levels` → Configure** 是同一份配置）。 每一档一行，三个字段： | 字段 | 来源 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Provider** | 当前 DSH 可路由的 provider 列表 | 如 `deepseek-official`、`deepseek-account`、`minimaxcode`、`myrouter` —— 名称取自模型目录，悬停可看路由 id | | **模型** | 所选 provider 下实际配置的模型 | 如 `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` / `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview` / `TopCoder`…；另有「自定义模型 ID…」兜底 | | **思考强度** | **所选模型自带的 efforts** | DeepSeek：默认 / off / low / high / max；MiniMax：默认 / off / low / medium / high；无思考档的模型只有「默认」 | 交互细节： - 切换 Provider 会自动选中该 provider 的第一个模型并清空思考强度； - 切换模型会重置思考强度（不同模型支持的档位不同）； - 「默认」表示不显式指定，由模型自己的默认思考强度决定。 ### 生效方式（重要） - 点 **保存** → 配置写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`- id: maestro-levels` 的 override），重启后保留； - **保存后需要重启 DSH Desktop**，且只对**新建**的会话生效——DSH 的 preset 在会话创建时固定，已运行的会话保持原配置； - 想恢复出厂默认：把五档改回上表的值保存 + 重启即可。 --- ## 工作原理 ``` ┌──────────────────────────── dsh-maestro5（bundle） ───────────────────────────┐ │ cordis.patch.yml │ │ ├── 根层设置行 maestro-levels（Config.levels 是 volatile，设置页可写） │ │ ├── preset team 主控 Lead（人设 + 全部工具 + 5 个 delegate 工具） │ │ └── preset team-l1…l5 五个档位（人设 + 全套执行工具） │ │ │ │ index.js Host 半：注册 maestroLevels 服务（读 volatile 配置） │ │ client.js Client 半：注册「设置 → 团队模式」页 + 插件行配置页 │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ 安装时自动注册 ▼ 新会话可选「团队主控」 │ ▼ 主控 Lead ──选档──► delegate_l1 … delegate_l5 │ │ agentOptions = !!js maestroLevels.agentOptionsFor('lN') │ ▼ │ team-lN preset 子智能体（独立上下文） │ │ 完成通知（不轮询） ▼ ▼ 汇总 / 复核 / 交付 ◄────┘ ``` 关键机制： - **安装即注册**：DSH 安装 bundle 时读取 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把设置行与 6 个 preset 插入 profile 层栈； - **配置可持久化**：`maestro-levels` 行的 `levels` 字段标了 `.volatile()`，因此能被设置表单编辑、由 config-editor 写回 profile 的 patch 层； - **模型注入 preset**：主控的 5 个 `delegate-*` 委派工具通过 `!!js ctx.get('maestroLevels').agentOptionsFor('l1')` 在挂载时读取当前配置，把模型写进子智能体； - **浏览器半手写**：`client.js` 是 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 工厂包，注册到 `settings.section` 与 `plugins.row.config` 两个槽位，**不需要打包器**。 --- ## 自定义与开发 ### 目录结构 ``` DSH-Maestro5/ ├── package.json # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（浏览器半）+ engines.dsh ├── cordis.patch.yml # 设置行 maestro-levels + 主控 preset + 5 个档位 preset ├── index.js # Host 半：maestroLevels 服务 ├── client.js # Client 半：设置页 / 插件行配置页 ├── locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件显示名与描述 ├── icon.svg # 插件图标 ├── docs/screenshots/ # README 截图 ├── README.md / README.en.md └── LICENSE ``` ### 本地开发 ```sh # 把本地目录装进 profile（link，改完重启即生效） dsh plu

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Cross-session messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness: let user-launched sessions in one workspace message each other and coordinate tasks, write scopes, and conflicts.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-messaging

Cross-session messaging for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh): let **user-launched sessions in the same workspace message each other** to coordinate tasks, declared file-write scopes, and conflicts — without turning them into parent/child subagents.

[![CI](https://github.com/XBXyftx/dsh-session-messaging/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/XBXyftx/dsh-session-messaging/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-messaging.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-messaging)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Status: early preview (`0.2.0`). Targets dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`. dsh plugin APIs are pre-stable, so expect breaking changes on upstream upgrades.

## Why

dsh already has strong delegation (subagents, Agent Teams), but those are hierarchical and lifecycle-bound to a parent. When you open several conversations yourself — frontend, backend, docs — they work in one workspace with no way to say "I'm editing `src/ui.ts`, please avoid it" or "the API field is frozen".

This plugin adds a **peer channel** between those top-level sessions:

- Sessions discover each other in the same working directory.
- A model can send a message to a peer session; the message is inserted into the target conversation as a normal user message.
- Reception can be paused per session; write scopes are declared advice, and overlaps are reported to both sides.

## Demo

![A peer session's message arriving in the desktop app](docs/assets/cross-session-demo.webp)

A real run in the macOS desktop app (`0.2.1-rc.2`): another user-launched session sent a test message. It arrived inline as a `session-message` envelope — sender id, timestamp, and the "peer is not an authority" note — and this session replied through `session_send`. Both sessions work in the same directory; no subagent hierarchy is involved.

### Case study: peer-reported bug to verified fix

Two user-launched sessions used the plugin to coordinate a real fix. One session sent a reproducible defect report with a code-level root cause; the fix shipped as `v0.1.2`, and the reporting session independently re-ran the regression on the desktop build.

![Bug report received from a peer session](docs/assets/defect-report-demo.webp)

*The reporting session's message as seen here: reproducible steps, root-cause pointers, and the fix request — all delivered through `session_send`.*

![Regression verification after the fix](docs/assets/regression-verification.webp)

*Independent regression verification: static checks plus a desktop runtime probe that returns `caller-not-top-level`, proving `v0.1.2` is active. The same message also proves the top-level → top-level path still works.*

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the `0.1.2` entry.

### Settings panel

![Session Messaging settings panel](docs/assets/panel.webp)

The sidebar entry opens a small panel: toggle cross-directory messaging (persisted through the dsh settings form), check the latest npm version, and open npm, GitHub, or the author's blog. After installing or upgrading the bundle, refresh the Web UI once so the client half joins the module graph.

## Features

- `session_peers` — list live, same-directory, top-level sessions and their reception state.
- `session_send` — relay a coordination message, optionally declaring `writeScopes` and replying to a message.
- `session_reception` — pause/resume receiving peer messages for the current session and declare its write scopes.
- **Sidebar panel** — a “Session Messaging” entry in the left sidebar with a cross-directory toggle, update check, and author links.
- Messages appear inline in the target conversation, attributed to the sending session — no separate inbox UI.
- Advisory **write-scope conflict detection**: if a peer declared an overlapping path, the receipt and the message envelope carry a `conflict-warning`.
- No new Session event types and no `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` change: the relay is a durable `user/message` with a declared `session-message` source.
- Bilingual plugin-card metadata and icons (English / 简体中文) for the dsh plugin manager.
- **Cold-session delivery** — a persisted session that is not live is resumed through the Web/Desktop `sessionController` before delivery (`allowColdDelivery`, on by default).
- Bounded: message size, per-sender→target rate limit, top-level-only, self-send rejected. Cross-directory peers are allowed by default; `sameDirectoryOnly: true` restricts to one working directory.

## How it works

```text
Session A (model) calls session_send
  → tools.ts uses exec.agent as the only identity source
  → service.send validates target, body, scopes, reception, rate limit
  → createUserMessage({ content: envelope + body, source: session-message/relay })
  → target.steer(message)          # next step boundary, or wake an idle agent
  → await ctx.sessions.flush(target.session)
Session B's log gains a user/message with source.kind = 'session-message'
  → deriveMessages() rebuilds it → B's next model request sees it → B can reply
```

The envelope always states that the message comes from another session, not the current user, and repeats that a peer is not an authority. Peer text is treated as data, never as higher-priority instructions.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop app or source checkout).
- Node.js `>= 22.19.0`.
- The plugin needs the host's copies of `@deepseek-ai/{cordis,schemastery,dsh-agent,dsh-llm,dsh-session,dsh-tools}`. They are declared as peer dependencies and resolved from the running dsh installation.

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-messaging
```

The package is published as [`dsh-session-messaging`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-messaging) (latest `0.4.0`). For library use: `npm install dsh-session-messaging`.

### From GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:XBXyftx/dsh-session-messaging
```

The repository ships the built `lib/` output, so a git install does not run a build.

### From a local checkout

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-messaging
```

### Troubleshooting: switching from a link install

If a profile previously linked a local checkout and later installed the npm package **while the app was running**, the running Loader can still reference the old checkout path. Removing that checkout's `node_modules` then surfaces `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for `@deepseek-ai/*` peers even though the npm package is installed. Remove and reinstall the bundle, then restart the app (a page reload is enough for the client half):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-session-messaging
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-messaging@latest
```

### Desktop app

The macOS/Windows desktop app uses its own profiles (for example `desktop`). Install with the bundled CLI or the agent's `plugin_manager` tool, targeting that profile. In dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` the configuration reloads through HMR, so the two plugin rows usually activate without restarting the app.

Verify the plugin is active:

- the agent's tool list contains `session_peers`, `session_send`, and `session_reception`;
- `plugin_manager list_plugins` reports both `session-messaging` and `session-messaging-tools` with `fiberPhase: active`.

## Usage

Open two sessions in the same working directory, then ask either model to coordinate. The tools are model-facing; no manual UI is required.

Example prompts:

```text
Use session_peers to see which other sessions are working here.
Send session-b a message: I am editing src/ui.ts and declared it in writeScopes; avoid it.
Check whether anyone else declared a conflicting write scope before you edit src/api.ts.
Pause receiving peer messages for this session.
```

Tools:

| Tool | Arguments | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `session_peers` | none | `{ peers: [{ sessionId, status, canReceive, writeScopes }] }` |
| `session_send` | `targetSessionId`, `message`, optional `writeScopes`, `replyTo` | `{ accepted, mess

plugins.description: Embed chat.deepseek.com web chat in DSH and transfer the conversation into a workspace session for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
<!-- 写作规范见 playbooks/reference/readme.md；与 README.en.md 保持相同章节。 -->

# 网页聊天桥

简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

<!-- npm:start -->[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-webchat-bridge?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-webchat-bridge) <!-- npm:end -->[![CI](https://github.com/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge?sort=semver)](https://github.com/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge/releases/latest) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge)](LICENSE) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20%E2%80%93%200.2.1--rc.2-blue) [![Maintained with RED](https://img.shields.io/badge/maintained_with-RED-C1121F)](https://github.com/exoticknight/red)

在 DSH 里直接使用 chat.deepseek.com 的网页对话，并把对话一键转成工作区会话继续开发。

## 功能

- **不消耗 API token 的网页对话**：用真实浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com，复用你已登录的网页会话，回复从页面自己的流式响应中读取。
- **登录一次，之后无头运行**：首次点 **打开登录窗口** 完成扫码或密码登录，插件记住浏览器资料；之后聊天在后台无头运行，不再打扰你。
- **流式回复与两个开关**：回复边生成边显示；**深度思考**、**联网搜索** 直接切换网页端的对应模式。
- **一键转到工作区**：核对来源、选择目标工作区，把问答与来源写成一个新的工作区会话；也可以 **追加到已有会话**。转移后目标会话输入框保持空白，可以直接接着做开发任务。
- **可选的任务简报**：勾选后由 DSH 当前配置的模型把对话蒸馏成 120–180 字简报，覆盖 outcome、audience、supplied_inputs、constraints、output_shape、acceptance_check、stop_boundary；对话里没有的事实写 `unknown`，长对话按 map-reduce 分段处理。**完整原文仍会附在同一会话里**，不会因为蒸馏而丢失。
- **手动导入**：支持 UTF-8 的 `.txt`、`.md`、`.json` 对话记录，导入后同样可以转移；面板里可以随时 **删除当前对话** 或 **清空全部** 本地记录。

## 安装

环境要求：DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <=0.2.1-rc.2`，使用 `web` profile。开发目标为 `0.2.1-rc.2`，实际验证结果见兼容性记录。

<!-- npm:start -->

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-webchat-bridge
```

<!-- npm:end -->

### 从 GitHub 安装

固定到某个 Release tag：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge#v0.1.0
```

安装后重启 DSH（桌面版请重启应用），刷新页面。命令会装到你平时使用的 DSH；如果你设置了自己的 `DSH_HOME`，请在同一个环境中运行。

从源码安装用于开发调试，见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md)。

## 使用

1. 打开 DSH 页面，在左侧栏点 **网页聊天**。
2. 首次使用点 **打开登录窗口**，在弹出的浏览器里登录 chat.deepseek.com。检测到登录后窗口自动关闭。
3. 在底部输入框输入消息，按 Enter 发送；回复会流式显示。需要时勾选 **深度思考** 或 **联网搜索**。
4. 点 **导入** 可以把本地的 `.txt`、`.md`、`.json` 对话加入列表。
5. 点 **转到工作区**：核对来源、选择目标工作区；需要追加到已有会话时选 **追加到已有会话** 并选目标会话；勾选 **同时蒸馏一份任务简报** 会在原文之上再生成一份简报。可以对同一个会话多次追加：每次会自动结束上一次留下的未完成轮次。点 **开始转移**。
6. 转移完成后会话会立即出现在左侧工作区（无需重启）；打开即可继续，输入框是空的，不会替你把问题预先填好。
7. 需要清理本地记录时，点 **删除当前对话** 或 **清空全部**；已转移到工作区的会话不受影响。

## 配置

配置保存在 DSH 的插件设置中（`cordis.patch.yml` 提供默认值）。

| 键                        | 默认值                      | 说明                                                     |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`                 | `true`                      | 启用插件。                                               |
| `headless`                | `true`                      | 登录后使用无头浏览器；首次登录仍会弹出可见窗口。         |
| `channel`                 | `auto`                      | 浏览器通道：`auto`、`chrome`、`msedge`、`chromium`。     |
| `executablePath`          | 空                          | 自定义 Chrome/Edge 可执行文件路径；留空自动探测。        |
| `baseUrl`                 | `https://chat.deepseek.com` | DeepSeek 网页端地址。                                    |
| `dataDir`                 | 空                          | 数据目录；留空使用 `~/.dsh/webchat-bridge`。             |
| `replyTimeoutMs`          | `180000`                    | 等待回复的最长毫秒数。                                   |
| `distillProvider`         | 空                          | 蒸馏简报使用的 provider；留空自动选择。                  |
| `distillModel`            | 空                          | 蒸馏简报使用的模型；留空自动选择。                       |
| `distillMaxTokens`        | `16384`                     | 最终简报的输出 token 上限（推理模型的思考也占用该额度）。 |
| `distillChunkTokens`      | `4096`                      | 分段摘要的输出 token 上限。                              |
| `transferDistillDefault`  | `false`                     | 转移对话框是否默认勾选“蒸馏任务简报”。                   |

## 更新、回滚与卸载

版本变更与升级说明见 [更新日志](https://github.com/nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge/releases)。

更新或回滚时请写明版本号，然后重启 DSH（新版本发布后 24 小时内，不带版本号的安装命令可能仍会装到旧版本）：

<!-- npm:start -->

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-webchat-bridge@X.Y.Z
```

<!-- npm:end -->

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:nai-loong/dsh-webchat-bridge#vX.Y.Z
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-webchat-bridge
```

卸载后 `~/.dsh/webchat-bridge/` 仍然保留：网页登录用的浏览器资料、本地对话记录 `transcripts.json` 和登录令牌 `token.json`。不再需要时手动删除该目录即可；不删除也不会影响 DSH 本身。

## 隐私与数据

- **网络**：插件用本机 Chrome/Edge 访问 `https://chat.deepseek.com`（可在配置中改地址）。除此之外不访问其他网络地址，不做遥测。
- **本机文件**：`~/.dsh/webchat-bridge/` 下的 `browser-profile/`（网页登录资料）、`transcripts.json`（本地对话）、`token.json`（从网页请求中观察到并保存的登录令牌，文件权限 0600，仅本机可读）。
- **凭据**：DeepSeek 网页登录令牌只写入上面的本机文件，由 Host half 读取；Client half 只能看到“是否已保存”，页面接口永远不会返回令牌内容。
- **转移**：转移写入 DSH 标准会话存储（`~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/`），内容是你选择的对话与来源信息。

## 兼容性

见 [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md)。已知限制：DeepSeek 网页端的 DOM 与流式协议没有公开契约，页面改版可能导致发送或读取失败；插件会报出 `PAGE_CHANGED` 而不是静默丢弃内容。

## 开发

见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) 与 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。使用 AI agent 开发、发布或维护时，让它先读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。

## 许可证

[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)

包内附带 vendored 的 [playwright-core](vendor/playwright-core/LICENSE)（Apache-2.0）和打包进 `lib/index.js` 的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（MIT）。它们的 NOTICE 与许可证文本见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt)，playwright 的 NOTICE 与 ThirdPartyNotices 随包保留。

plugins.description: Pulse: a Claude-inspired live status layer for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar - state table, project tabs, live run steps, FLIP transitions.
plugins.readme_text:
# Pulse **给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏注入 Claude 的状态流。** 原生工作区树一行不动，状态表叠在它上面：谁在等你、谁在跑、谁刚完成——一眼到底。 > 名字取自「侧边栏的脉搏」：会话状态像心率一样实时起伏，你随时知道系统还在跳。 [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-3fbf7f)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-5b8def)](https://github.com/zhangyuzhangyu233/dsh-pulse) [![no deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-e2a33c)](#)
--- ## 为什么要它 DSH 的侧边栏擅长回答「我的会话放在哪个项目」， 但它不太回答「**现在**发生了什么」——哪个在等我批准、哪个在跑、哪个刚跑完我还没看。 Claude 的桌面端把这件事做得很好：agent 列表按状态分组、运行中的会话带实时动静、完成的会话留一个未读标记。 Pulse 把**这套状态语言**移植到 DSH：不是替换原生列表，而是在原生列表上方加一层实时状态表，让「项目结构」和「任务状态」同时可见。 ![Pulse 在 DSH 中的实际效果](docs/screenshots/overview.png) ## 它能做什么 ### 🧭 状态总表：叠在「工作区」上方，原生树不动 ``` 状态 ⌄ › ● 需要输入 2 › ● 正在工作 1 › ● 未读 3 › ● 已完成 12 ──────────────────────────────────── 工作区 ← 原生列表，完全保留 ▸ dsh-coderipper ▸ ... ``` - 状态分组、展开/折叠、折叠摘要都按 Claude 的语义组织； - 原生工作区分组、搜索、拖拽、置顶、归档、右键菜单**一行没改**； - 折叠总表时摘要行保留实时数字（正在工作 / 需要输入 / 未读），空分组自动隐藏箭头。 ### 🗂 状态 → 项目 → 会话 → 执行步骤 展开任意状态，里面先按**项目选项卡**分栏（沿用原生 folder 图标与行规格），再是会话： ![状态表细节](docs/screenshots/status-table.png) - 运行中的会话前面是**和原生列表一模一样的转圈图标**（同一套 SVG 几何 + 1.5s 呼吸节奏）； - 会话下方显示**当前执行步骤**：来自 DSH 的 `todo` 投影里 `in_progress` 的条目；没写 todo 时回退到运行中的**子代理名称**，绝不编造； - 步骤文字带**白色高光从左往右扫过**，字号/行距与会话行一致（14px / 20px / 32px 行高）； - 点会话直接打开，点项目行收起该项目。 ### 🎞 丝滑的状态切换 逆向自 Claude timeline 动画的运动参数，做了一套 FLIP 转场： | 动作 | 动效 | |---|---| | 会话跨状态组移动 | 240ms `cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)` 平滑滑行 | | 新出现 | 淡入 + 上移 6px，同曲线 | | 消失 | 180ms ease-out 淡出 + 上浮 4px（幽灵行） | | 流式更新 | rAF 合帧 + 内容签名去重，数据没变不重建 DOM，动画不被打断 | 系统「减少动态效果」时全部降级为静态。 ### 🎛 可控、可演示 - 设置 → 通用里两个开关：**Claude 状态表**、**模拟状态数据（演示）**； - 演示模式用脚本数据循环播放全部状态、项目分栏、执行步骤，不需要真的跑任务； - 中英双语、明暗主题 token 自适应、侧栏折叠 rail 时自动隐藏。 ## 安装 > 需要 DeepSeek Harness，且 Web UI 中安装过本地插件。 **方式 A（推荐）**：在 DSH 的「插件」面板里从**本地目录**安装本仓库根目录， 或调用 Harness 的 `plugin_manager` 工具： ```text install_bundle target = <本仓库绝对路径> ``` **方式 B（手工登记）**： 1. 把本仓库克隆到任意位置； 2. 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建软链指向仓库根目录（例如 `/node_modules/dsh-coderipper`）； 3. 在 profile 的 `cordis.yml` 插件列表里加一条： ```yaml - id: dsh-coderipper name: dsh-coderipper ``` 4. 重启 DSH，在插件面板确认 `Pulse · 状态栏脉搏` 已启用。 安装后：设置 → 通用 → 打开「Claude 状态表」。想先看看效果，再打开「模拟状态数据（演示）」。 ## 设计来源（逆向笔记） - **Claude 桌面端**（`Claude_2.42304`，`ion-dist` bundle）： - 侧边栏行状态只有四种：`blocked / review / working / unread`，文案 `Needs input / Ready for review / Working / Unread`； - 行状态色：warning 琥珀 / accent 蓝 / muted 灰； - 动画：`timeline-status-rise`（240ms `cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)`）、`timeline-status-fall`（180ms ease-out）、展开 200ms `cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)`。 - **DSH 原生 UI**：行高 32px、标题 14px/20px、行间距 2px、section header 36px、`StateDot ongoing` 转圈几何，全部按原生 CSS 实测值对齐。 - 本项目**没有包含、复制或分发任何 Anthropic / DeepSeek 的代码或资源**；视觉与交互为独立重实现，与 Anthropic 无关联、未获其背书。 ## 目录结构 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---| | `package.json` / `client.js` / `index.js` | Pulse 插件本体（零依赖） | | `locale/` | 中文 / English 界面文案 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | Cordis 插件登记 | | `docs/` | 宣传横幅与效果截图 | ## 姊妹项目 动态背景（代码涟漪）是独立项目：[**dsh-coderipple**](https://github.com/zhangyuzhangyu233/dsh-coderipple)。 ## 已知限制与路线图 - `待审查（Ready for review）` 分组已预留：DSH 当前没有对应信号，计数为 0 时整组隐藏； - 执行步骤依赖会话的 `todo` 投影，未写清单的长任务只显示转圈（+ 子代理名兜底）； - 路线图：hover 卡片（最近活动/工作区）、右键菜单扩展（移动到工作区/分叉）、状态片段筛选。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)。 --- **English** — Pulse is a Claude-inspired status layer for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: a live state table (Needs input / Working / Unread / Completed) stacked above the untouched native workspace tree, expandable down to project tabs, sessions and their current run steps, with native-matching spinners, project folder icons, and FLIP state transitions. Zero dependencies, MIT licensed. Visual language and motion parameters are reverse-engineered for parity; no Anthropic or DeepSeek code/assets are included, and there is no affiliation.

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：侧边栏底部动作区加「问助理」按钮，一键用内置浏览器打开 DeepSeek 网页版，随手问事不消耗会话 token。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ask-assistant

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（下称 DSH）桌面版加一个**「问助理」按钮**：点它就用右侧栏的内置浏览器打开 DeepSeek 网页版对话。随手查个东西、问个小事不必新开一个 DSH 会话，也就不消耗会话 token、不污染工作区上下文。

> 截图占位：安装后在侧边栏底部动作区（展开态 + 收起态）各截一张，放到 `docs/images/sidebar-button.png` 并把下面这行的注释去掉。
>
> <!-- ![侧边栏底部的问助理按钮](docs/images/sidebar-button.png) -->

## 特性

- **官方插槽，不改 asar**：按钮挂在 DSH 官方的侧边栏底部动作插槽（`sidebar.footer.action`）里，和「设置」齿轮同一行；侧边栏展开、收起两种状态都由 DSH 自己排版。
- **不依赖哈希类名**：不使用 `._2H3hWW_newSession` 这类 CSS Modules 哈希选择器，DSH 升级换样式也不会失效；也不用 `MutationObserver` 去硬插节点。
- **复用内置浏览器**：点按钮走官方 `sidebarRight.openTab('browser', …)`，在右侧栏开一个内置浏览器标签页加载 `https://chat.deepseek.com`，登录态与浏览器分区由 DSH 自己管理。
- **可配置地址**：想换成别的问答站点，改 `lib/client.js` 顶部的 `ASSISTANT_URL` 即可。
- **零依赖**：宿主半边只有一个空壳插件；浏览器半边只 `require('react')` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，两个都由 DSH 前端自带。

## 安装

### 方式一：本地链接安装（推荐，改代码即时生效）

```powershell
# 1. 把插件目录放到任意位置，例如 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\plugins\dsh-ask-assistant

# 2. 在 DSH profile 的 package.json 里登记依赖（link: 指向插件目录，路径用正斜杠）
#    "dsh-ask-assistant": "link:C:/Users/<你>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-ask-assistant"

# 3. 在同一个 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组末尾加一项
#    "dsh-ask-assistant"

# 4. 建好 node_modules 里的链接（任选其一）
#    a) pnpm install        —— 干净环境最省事
#    b) 手动建 junction     —— pnpm 供应链策略拦住时的替代做法
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path   "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-ask-assistant" `
  -Target "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\plugins\dsh-ask-assistant"

# 5. 完全退出 DSH 再启动
```

### 方式二：npm 安装（发布之后）

```powershell
cd C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add dsh-ask-assistant
```

然后把 `dsh-ask-assistant` 加进 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启 DSH。

## 挂载方式：bundle 还是 patch？

包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 提供了两种挂载通道，**二选一，不要同时用**：

- **bundle 通道（推荐）**：把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，DSH 会读 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，自动加载包内补丁层里的 `insert` 条目。
- **patch 通道**：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾自己写：

  ```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: ask-assistant
        name: 'dsh-ask-assistant'
  ```

  ⚠️ 这里必须写**包名**，不要写成 `./cordis.patch.yml` 之类的相对路径：patch 的解析基准会落在这个包自己的目录里，向上找不到 profile 的 `node_modules`，加载会失败。

两条通道同时开会出现两个按钮，所以选了 bundle 通道就不要再往 profile 补丁里写。

## 卸载

1. 从 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉 `dsh-ask-assistant`（如果用的是 patch 通道，删掉那段 `insert`）；
2. 删掉 `node_modules/dsh-ask-assistant` 链接，以及 dependencies 里的那一行；
3. 重启 DSH。

插件本身不写任何配置文件，卸载后除了按钮消失不会有残留。

## 开发

```
dsh-ask-assistant/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml；dsh.client 声明浏览器半边
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 层：insert 一个 id 为 ask-assistant 的插件条目
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 宿主半边（空壳，只有 name / inject / apply）
│   └── client.js         # 浏览器半边：注册 sidebar.footer.action 插槽组件
└── test/
    └── test_plugin.mjs   # 离线自检：假 ModuleLoader + 假 ctx + 假 React
```

自检不需要安装任何依赖：

```powershell
node test/test_plugin.mjs
# dsh-ask-assistant 自检通过：4 组用例
```

### 客户端半边的关键点

```js
ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.footer.action', () => ctx.slots.register({
  name: 'sidebar.footer.action',
  id: 'ask-assistant',               // 同一插槽里区分不同插件
  locale: 'askAssistant',            // 文案命名空间
  inject: () => ({ openAssistant })  // 往组件里注入回调
}, AskAssistantButton));
```

组件签名是 `({ wide, t, ...注入的属性 })`：

- `wide` 由插槽提供，侧边栏收起时是 `false`（用来在 14px / 16px 图标间切换）；
- `t` 是宿主按 `locale` 命名空间绑好的翻译函数（`locale.bind(ns)`），**不是** `locale.t(key)`；
- 文案用 `ctx.get('locale').register('askAssistant', { zh: {...}, en: {...} })` 注册，随 `ctx.effect` 自动注销。

### 改动后的生效方式

浏览器半边由 DSH 前端在启动时按 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 打包加载，**改完 `lib/client.js` 需要重启 DSH 桌面端**。

## 兼容性

- 依赖的公开面只有三样：cordis 的 `ctx.get`、官方插槽名 `sidebar.footer.action`、官方服务名 `sidebarRight`。三者都由 DSH 官方客户端插件注册。
- 若宿主缺少 `sidebarRight`（比如以后的版本改名），按钮仍在，但点击不会有反应——不会报错、不影响其它功能。
- 在 DSH Desktop 2.0.21（`@deepseek-ai/*` 0.2.1-rc.2）上开发与验证。

## 与内置「问助理」按钮的关系

部分 DSH 版本的侧边栏已经内置了一个「问助理」按钮（在「新会话」下面）。本插件**不覆盖也不替代**它，而是把同样的能力再放一个到侧边栏底部动作区，方便在侧边栏收起、或长会话列表把顶部按钮挤走时仍然一点就到。

如果你的 DSH 版本已经内置了满意的入口，可以不用装本插件。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 插件：会话 AI 回复结束时用 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标弹系统通知 | DSH plugin: system notification with the DeepSeek whale when a session's AI turn finishes
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

System notifications for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: when a session's AI turn finishes, DSH raises a system notification carrying its black-whale mark and tells you **which task** completed.

![preview](preview.png)

---

## English

### How it works (and why it is built this way)

The **host** subscribes to the session log's own `session/event` stream and reacts to `turn/end`; the **browser** receives those completions over Server-Sent Events and raises the notification.

This split is deliberate. Earlier versions tried to detect completion in the browser by reading client-side projections, and both attempts failed silently:

| Attempt | Why it never fired |
|---|---|
| `sessions.list.byId[*].running` | DSH 0.2.x keeps `running` on the session object and no longer refreshes the list row live, so no `true → false` edge ever appeared. |
| `sessions.binding(id).session` | `binding()` returns `this.scopes.get(id)?.binding` — it only answers for an **already-retained** scope, so a root-level plugin got `undefined` for every session. |

Both are private internals. `session/event` is the documented seam — the `dsh-session` package documents *"Persistence is a plugin concern (subscribe to `session/event`, drain on `session/flush`)"* — and `turn/end` is a stable type in the session log's own event vocabulary. The host also has the durable session header, so titles come from the source of truth rather than from a UI projection.

### Behaviour

- Fires for **every** finished turn, in any session.
- Title `任务完成` (`任务出错` when the turn failed); body names the session.
- Icon: the **DeepSeek whale**, served by the host at `/dsh-notify/whale.svg` and rasterized to a PNG in the browser (Windows toasts prefer a bitmap).
- **Click** the notice to ask the shell to focus that session.
- One `EventSource` handles reconnection on its own.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** — the node half is loaded at boot, so a page refresh alone is not enough.

### Diagnosing

**Settings → General** shows the permission state, a **"Send a test notification"** button, and the live link state:

```
Link: live · 3 completion event(s) received
```

- Test button works but the counter stays 0 → the host half is not loaded (restart DSH).
- Counter grows but no toast → the OS/browser is suppressing notifications.

### Endpoints

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-notify/stream` | `text/event-stream` of completion frames |
| `GET /dsh-notify/completions` | recent completions + current sequence watermark |
| `GET /dsh-notify/whale.svg` | the whale mark |

### Tests

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`tests/host-test.mjs` (29 assertions) covers the event mapping (only `turn/end` counts; title/cwd/id fallbacks; failure text), the feed (monotonic seq, history cap, detach), and every route including the SSE handshake, a pushed frame, and detach on close. `tests/client-test.mjs` (20 assertions) covers the two-slot registration, the stream wiring, notification content, click-to-open, denied permission, and the settings row.

### License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Third-party marks: [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

---

## 中文

### 工作原理（以及为什么这样设计）

**宿主**订阅会话日志自身的 `session/event`，对 `turn/end` 作出反应；**浏览器**通过 SSE 收到完成事件后弹出通知。

这个分工是刻意的。此前两版都试图在浏览器里读客户端投影来判断"是否跑完"，两次都静默失效：

| 尝试 | 为什么从不触发 |
|---|---|
| `sessions.list.byId[*].running` | 0.2.x 把 `running` 放在会话对象上，列表行不再实时刷新，因此永远等不到 `true → false` 边沿。 |
| `sessions.binding(id).session` | `binding()` 返回的是 `this.scopes.get(id)?.binding` —— 它只对**已被 retain** 的 scope 有答案，根级插件对每个会话都拿到 `undefined`。 |

这些都是私有内部实现。而 `session/event` 是**文档化的**扩展点（`dsh-session` 包里写明"订阅 `session/event`"是持久化插件的做法），`turn/end` 是会话日志事件词汇表里的稳定类型。宿主还能读到会话的 header，所以标题取自事实来源，而不是 UI 投影。

### 行为

- **任何会话**的每一轮结束都会通知；
- 标题 `任务完成`（该轮失败则 `任务出错`），正文带会话标题；
- 图标是 **DeepSeek 鲸鱼**：由宿主在 `/dsh-notify/whale.svg` 提供，浏览器栅格化成 PNG（Windows 通知偏好位图）；
- **点击通知**让外壳聚焦该会话；
- `EventSource` 自带重连。

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-notify
```

**装完必须重启 DSH** —— 宿主半边在启动时加载，只刷新页面不够。

### 怎么排查

**设置 → 通用** 里显示权限状态、**「发一条测试通知」** 按钮，以及实时连接状态：

```
连接：已连接 · 已收到 3 条完成事件
```

- 测试按钮能弹、但计数一直是 0 → 宿主插件没加载（重启 DSH）；
- 计数在涨、但没弹窗 → 系统/浏览器在拦截通知。

### 接口

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-notify/stream` | 完成事件的 `text/event-stream` |
| `GET /dsh-notify/completions` | 最近的完成记录 + 当前序号 |
| `GET /dsh-notify/whale.svg` | 鲸鱼图标 |

### 测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`tests/host-test.mjs`（29 项）覆盖事件映射（只有 `turn/end` 算数；标题/cwd/id 兜底；失败信息）、feed（序号单调、历史上限、解绑），以及全部路由（含 SSE 握手、推送一帧、断开解绑）。
`tests/client-test.mjs`（20 项）覆盖两个 slot 注册、流接线、通知内容、点击跳转、权限拒绝、设置行渲染。

### 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方说明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: delete archived sessions with reference-aware attachment garbage collection, as one reversible transaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archived-chat-cleanup（已归档会话清理）

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archived-chat-cleanup)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> A DSH plugin that deletes **archived** sessions together with their exclusively-referenced
> attachment objects and derived request-image caches — one reference-aware, journalled,
> reversible transaction. Install by package name: `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`.

## 安装

**通过 DSH 输入包名安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 插件管理器里输入 `dsh-archived-chat-cleanup`，
或使用 CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archived-chat-cleanup
```

安装/升级后需要重启宿主（模块缓存按包说明符生效）。

从源码安装（本地开发）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add <插件目录的绝对路径>
```

## English overview

DSH stores attachments content-addressed: one object can be referenced by many sessions, so
deleting a session must not blindly delete its attachments. This plugin deletes only archived
sessions, cascades into their subagent child sessions, scans every surviving session for
`sha256:` references, removes only unreferenced attachment objects, clears the
`request-images` derived caches, and updates the live indexes through the running services.
Every file move is journalled and reversible, including crash recovery on the next boot.

It ships a Host half (`delete_archived_session` tool + `archivedCleanup` Remote namespace) and
a browser half (two rows in the archived session's “…” menu). See the Chinese sections below
for the full behaviour, transaction protocol and test coverage.

删除**已归档**会话，并按引用关系回收附件实体；整个过程是一个可回滚的事务。
Host 半 + 浏览器半在同一个包里，安装后提供三个入口：会话「...」菜单、模型工具、Remote API。

## 它解决什么

DSH 的附件是**内容寻址**的：同一张图被多个会话引用时磁盘上只有一份。
所以"删除会话"不能简单地把附件一起删掉，必须先判断还有没有别的会话在引用。
DSH 自身没有删除会话的 API（`sessionPersistence` / `attachments` 都没有 delete），
这些数据只能由插件自己按事务方式落盘删除。

## 行为

一次删除调用按顺序完成：

1. **归档校验**：目标必须在 `workspaceRegistry.archivedSessionIds`（界面上的"已归档"）里。
   非归档会话直接拒绝（`session-not-archived`）。
2. **运行中会话**：`one` 模式整体拒绝（`target-live`）；`all` 模式**跳过**该会话及其全部子会话并在结果里报告（`skippedLive`），绝不删正在写的日志。
3. **级联**：递归带上目标会话的子代理子会话（它们是归档会话的内部会话，保留会让附件被"永久引用"）。
4. **取目标会话的附件引用**：完整读取会话日志，扫描其中出现的所有 `sha256:<64hex>`。
5. **取存活会话的引用**：扫描除目标外的**所有**现存会话（磁盘 + 内存 live，不区分是否归档）。
6. **判定**：
   - 未被任何存活会话引用 → 删除附件实体（镜像对象 `attachments/v1/objects/`、
     文件对象 `file-objects/`、以及别名目录 `files/`）；
   - 仍被其他会话引用 → **不删**，只随目标会话一起删除那条引用（引用存在会话日志里）；
   - 任何存活会话日志读不出来 → 整个操作中止（fail-closed，宁可不删）。
7. **删除派生缓存**：`<cacheRoot>/request-images` 与旧版遗留的 `attachments/v1/request-images`
   整体清掉（按"源对象+请求尺寸"派生，无法精确归属到某个会话，且下次看图会自动重建）。
8. **删除会话正文与索引引用**：会话目录、投影缓存记录（`session_projcache` 域）、
   message_feedback 记录、workspace 归属与归档集合。
   索引一律走**活着的服务/域**，不直接改文件——`workspaceRegistry` 会在内存里缓存状态，
   直接改文件会被它写回（这正是前两次手工清理踩过的坑）。

### 事务与回滚

- **阶段一**：把每个待删路径 `rename` 进隔离区（同卷、原子），每步写一次 journal；
- **阶段二**：改索引（先快照原值）；
- **阶段三**：两者都成功后彻底清空隔离区。
- 任意一步失败：先回滚索引，再逆序把文件搬回原位，journal 记为 `rolled-back`（隔离区清掉，journal 留作审计）。
- 进程崩溃：下次启动扫描 journal，自动恢复未完成的事务；`rollback-incomplete` 表示恢复不完全，需人工看 journal。
- 所有待删路径必须**严格位于**会话根/附件根/缓存根之内，否则 `unsafe-path` 中止。

## 用法

| 入口 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 会话「...」菜单 | 仅在该会话已归档时显示"删除已归档会话…"（order 500）与"清理全部已归档会话…"（order 501），**点两次**才执行 |
| 模型工具 `delete_archived_session` | `{ mode: "one"\|"all", session_id?, dry_run?, confirm }`；`dry_run:true` 只报告计划；真正删除需 `confirm:true` |
| Remote 命名空间 `archivedCleanup` | 端点 `archivedCleanup/status`、`/preview`、`/deleteArchived`，参数按名字传 `{ mode, sessionId, confirm }` |

## 路径与数据

- 会话根：`ctx.sessionPersistence.root`（回退：Loader 配置 / `DSH_HOME/sessions`）
- 附件根：`ctx.attachments.root`（回退 `DSH_HOME/attachments/v1`）
- 派生缓存：`ctx.attachments.cacheRoot`（回退 `DSH_HOME/cache/attachments`）
- 插件数据：`DSH_HOME/plugin-data/archived-cleanup/`（`transactions/` journal，`reports/` 执行报告）

plugins.description: A sidebar prompt template library for DeepSeek Harness: browse, manage, and insert reusable prompts into the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Library for DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that keeps reusable prompt templates one click away. It adds a searchable template library to the sidebar and a compact picker to the message composer. Choosing a template inserts it at the caret, or starts a new conversation with the template already in the draft when no conversation is open.

Repository: <https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt>

## Features

- **Sidebar library** — a bookmark entry in the left sidebar opens a full library panel.
- **Composer picker** — a small bookmark button in the composer tool row opens a compact, searchable picker without leaving the conversation.
- **Insert at the caret** — templates are inserted into the current draft; a selection is replaced. The edit is undoable through the composer's normal undo history.
- **No-conversation fallback** — with no conversation open, choosing a template starts a new conversation and puts the template in the draft.
- **Template management** — create, edit, delete, duplicate, copy, search, and filter templates by category.
- **Categories** — create a category before it has templates. The empty category offers **New template in this category**. A name matching a built-in category label belongs to that built-in category instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Eight built-in templates** — code review, refactoring, tests, debugging, explanation, summarization, translation, and structured research. They follow the UI language and are read-only; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy.
- **English and Simplified Chinese UI** — the interface follows the DSH language setting.
- **No configuration required** — no API key, token, password, account, or external service.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** or newer, with the Web or Desktop UI.
- A DSH profile in which bundles can be installed (the default Desktop profile is fine).
- Network access to GitHub when installing from this repository.

The plugin is a **bundle**, not a standalone web page. Install it through DSH's plugin manager; do not try to open `client.js` directly.

The repository root is the installable package root. It contains `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `index.js`, and `client.js`; there is no monorepo subdirectory and no build step.

## Install from GitHub

### Desktop / Web (recommended)

1. In DSH, open **Plugins**.
2. Choose **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Paste the repository address:

   ```text
   https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
   ```

4. Review the trust notice and confirm the installation. DSH reads `package.json` and installs the bundle.
5. If the `prompt-library` row remains off, enable it in **Plugins**.
6. If the sidebar bookmark does not appear, refresh the Web GUI once.

### CLI

`dsh plugin --profile <name> add ...` forwards the install to pnpm in that profile. Use the profile you actually run (`web`, `desktop`, or a custom profile):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The equivalent GitHub URL form is accepted by pnpm-based installs:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

A git install fetches sources, not a prebuilt artifact. This package is plain JavaScript with no `prepare`/`build` script, so pnpm does not need to run an install-time build and users are not asked to allow one.

Do not edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand; the plugin manager owns those files.

### Local checkout (development)

Install the absolute path to this repository as a linked bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile dev add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

The plugin manager links the checkout into the profile, so edits to `client.js` are picked up after a page refresh. Replace `dev` with a disposable profile name; do not mix development links into a profile you rely on.

### Update and uninstall

DSH upgrades non-official plugins by uninstalling and reinstalling them. Uninstall the bundle in **Plugins**, then install the new repository version. With the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-prompt
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qifenglun1/dsh-plugin-prompt
```

Removing the bundle removes the sidebar entry and composer picker. Templates already saved in the browser are not deleted by uninstalling; clear the keys below if you want to remove them.

## Configuration

The plugin has **no Config schema** and no required settings. There is no API key, token, password, endpoint, or model selection to configure.

| Setting | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Templates | Managed in the library panel or the template editor. |
| Categories | Created with **New category** or by typing a new category in the template editor. |
| Language | Follows the DSH language setting (`English` or `简体中文`). |
| Built-in templates | Fixed in the plugin; **Save as mine** creates an editable copy. |

### Browser storage

Templates and categories are stored in the Harness Web origin's `localStorage`:

- `dsh.prompt-library.templates.v1` — user templates.
- `dsh.prompt-library.categories.v1` — categories that exist independently of templates. When this key is missing, categories already used by saved templates are migrated into it.

`localStorage` is scoped to the Web origin. A different origin, browser profile, or cleared browser storage has separate data. The plugin does not write templates to the session log, does not send them to a server, and does not read credentials. When you send a message, its text reaches your configured model through DSH as usual.

## Usage

### Sidebar library

1. Click the bookmark entry in the left sidebar.
2. Search by title, text, or category, or choose a category chip.
3. Choose **Insert** to put the template into the current draft, **Copy** to copy it, or **Save as mine** to duplicate a built-in template.
4. Use **New category** to create a category before it has templates.
5. Use the back arrow in the panel header to return to the conversation.

### Composer picker

1. Click the bookmark button in the composer's left tool row.
2. In a new, empty conversation the picker opens as a centered dialog, so the search field is always visible; in an active conversation it opens above the composer.
3. Search for a template. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to insert, or click a row.
4. The template is inserted at the caret (or replaces the current selection).

### Example

Create a reusable review prompt:

1. Open the sidebar library.
2. Choose **New template**.
3. Set the title to `Review a pull request`, the category to `Engineering`, and the body to:

   ```text
   Review this change for correctness, edge cases, performance, security,
   and maintainability. List issues by severity, then give concrete fixes.

   ```

4. Save. The template appears under **My templates**.
5. In any conversation, click the composer bookmark, choose the template, and it is inserted at the caret.

### Empty categories

A newly created category is selected immediately. Until it has templates, the panel shows **No templates in this category yet** and **New template in this category**. That button opens the editor with the category prefilled.

Categories can be created and selected, but renaming or deleting a category is not yet supported.

## Compatibility

- Built and verified with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**.
- The package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"`. Installation and profile startup refuse a bundle outside that range.
- The client half uses the public slot entries `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, `conversation.input.left`, and `conversation.input.overlay`, plus the composer's `InputActions.captureInsertion()` / `insertText()`.
- If a future DSH release changes those slots, the plugin may need an update. Please include the DSH version in bug reports.

## Privacy and security

- No analytics, telemetry, or network calls of its own.
- No credential, API key, token, cookie, or account access.
- No host filesystem access; the host half is an empty `apply()` row.

plugins.description: Ghost-text next-prompt prediction in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer, accepted with Tab.
plugins.readme_text:
# Prompt Forecast

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Ghost-text prediction of your next action in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer,
in the style of Codex and Claude Code prompt suggestions.

After a completed turn the Host half asks the session's own model for the single
most likely next actionable message, publishes it through a client-visible
session projection, and the Client half renders it as gray text on the first line
of an empty composer. Press **Tab** or **→** to accept it into the draft, or
**Esc** to ignore that suggestion. Typing anything hides it; the text you typed is
never replaced.

The default mode is a Codex-style context fork: the parent's current text
transcript plus one synthetic user turn, `Suggest my next message.`, with
explicit rules that restrict the answer to an action.

## Requirements

- **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer within `0.2.x`**, declared as `engines.dsh: ^0.2.1-rc.2`.
- This plugin is built on the 0.2.1-rc.2 client and Host surfaces: the
  `conversation.input.overlay` composer slot, `InputActions.captureInsertion()` /
  `insertText()`, and the session-projection carrier fed by `agent/turn-stopping`.
- `dsh plugin add` validates the range during installation and restores the
  previous profile state when it does not match; profile startup checks it
  again. An unmet range refuses to load the plugin; upgrade DSH or install a
  plugin release whose `engines.dsh` matches your runtime. A DSH `0.3` release
  will need a matching plugin release rather than an exemption.

## What it does

- Fork mode (default) predicts from the full text transcript; digest mode uses a
  compact JSON excerpt.
- Predicts the next action, not a status report or an outcome guess.
- Writes in the language the user writes in, one short line.
- Uses the route that served the turn (falling back to the profile default
  model), so no extra provider setup is required.
- Skips subagent sessions and turns with no human input.
- Fails silently: a slow, aborted, or failed prediction never surfaces an error
  in the conversation.

## What gets predicted

The target is the next **actionable** message, not a literal continuation of the
conversation. A useful suggestion is one the user would send to tell the
assistant what to do next:

- an instruction: run the tests, fix this error, check the projection cache,
  explain the failure
- a choice or approval: use option A, go ahead, keep it
- a correction: no, change the client side
- a request to explain or diagnose: why does the fork call time out?
- a short report followed by an instruction: restarted, still empty — check the
  logs

Pure status reports, test results, log observations, narration, and guesses about
what might happen are rejected; `NONE` is a valid answer. A conservative
post-filter drops obvious pure-report clauses, and fork mode falls back to the
digest when the result is unusable.

## Prediction modes

`mode: 'fork'` (default) mirrors the Codex composer-prediction shape. It takes
the session's current text transcript — system and developer instructions plus
user/assistant text — drops tool calls, tool results, reasoning, and attachment
blocks, then appends one synthetic user turn:

```text
Suggest my next message.
```

The model's reply becomes the ghost line. No child session or session event is
created; the fork is an in-memory message list for one auxiliary call. A short
action-rules block is appended to the inherited system prompt so the model writes
the user's next instruction rather than a status report. Because the whole
transcript is sent, this mode costs more tokens and needs a larger `timeoutMs`
than the digest mode.

`mode: 'digest'` keeps the earlier lightweight path: a compact JSON excerpt
(`recent_user_messages`, `latest_assistant_reply`, `tools_used`) with a short,
action-oriented system prompt. Use it for cheap predictions or long sessions
where sending the transcript is too expensive.

## Configuration

The row's `config` block in `cordis.patch.yml` overrides every default:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` leaves the Host half unregistered |
| `mode` | `fork` | `fork` = full transcript + `Suggest my next message.`; `digest` = compact JSON excerpt |
| `maxTokens` | `1024` | Output budget of the prediction request |
| `temperature` | `0.4` | Sampling temperature |
| `timeoutMs` | `12000` | Hard bound on the request; a slower answer is dropped |
| `maxPromptChars` | `80` | Clip length of the predicted prompt |
| `maxForkChars` | `12000` | Character budget of the forked conversation window (system/developer text is always kept) |
| `fallback` | `true` | When the fork yields no text, retry with the compact digest |
| `maxInputChars` | `6000` | Digest-mode excerpt size bound |
| `skipSubagents` | `true` | Subagent sessions get no prediction |
| `provider` | turn route | Explicit provider override |
| `model` | turn route | Explicit model override |

The prediction is produced while the turn boundary is still open
(`agent/turn-stopping`), so its text arrives with the finished turn instead of
requiring a poll. `timeoutMs` is the price: a prediction that does not settle
within that budget is dropped and the turn finishes without one.

## Install

### From GitHub (no build step)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:littepointR/dsh-prompt-forecast
dsh web
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm in the chosen profile, installs the package,
and automatically adds the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` because the package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. Restart the profile for the plugin to load. The
package is plain JavaScript with no `prepare` build script, so a git install
needs no extra pnpm build approval.

To pin the tagged release:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:littepointR/dsh-prompt-forecast#v0.2.4
```

The Desktop application's `desktop` profile is reserved for the Electron app, so
the CLI rejects `--profile desktop`. Use Settings → Plugins there, or install
into a CLI profile.

### From a local checkout

Use Plugin Manager with this package directory as the bundle target. The bundle
patch inserts the `prompt-forecast` row; it survives restarts because it is a
normal profile bundle.

## Limits

- Only an empty composer shows a suggestion. Completing a partially typed draft
  needs caret geometry the slot does not expose yet and is not part of this
  version.
- The suggestion is a hint, not an action: accepting inserts plain text into the
  draft and nothing is sent.
- Prediction quality depends on the session model; a very small model may return
  a generic follow-up.

## Development

```bash
node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
```

- `index.js` — Host half: generate at `agent/turn-stopping`, publish through the
  `promptForecast` projection.
- `client.js` — Client half: register in `conversation.input.overlay`, render the
  ghost line, handle Tab/→/Esc.
- `test/host.test.mjs` — text normalization, digest building, projection fold.
- `test/client.test.mjs` — structural smoke test of the Client render branches
  (no DOM emulation).

## License

MIT
