# dsh-smart-proxy

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

> 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供可切换的代理模式、连通性自检和 SSE 超时保护，专治 `Transport Failed` 与 TLS 证书拦截。

## 解决什么问题

国内网络环境下，DSH 桌面版经常出现以下症状：

- 对话请求报 `Transport Failed`，但浏览器/curl 访问同一域名正常；
- 公司网络或杀毒软件做 HTTPS 中间人，导致 TLS 证书校验失败；
- 深度思考模型流式输出中途断连，前功尽弃。

本插件把「代理选择 → 连通性验证 → 长连接保活」串成一条链路，并把当前网络状态暴露成 Agent 工具，出问题时能直接问出来。

## 功能

- **三种代理模式**：`system`（跟随系统） / `manual`（手动指定） / `direct`（强制直连）
- **启动自检**：启动时探测 DeepSeek API 连通性，失败时在日志中给出明确原因
- **超时保护**：单独放大 SSE 流式超时（默认 10 分钟），避免长回答被截断
- **热重载**：修改配置后即时生效，无需重启 DSH
- **诊断工具**：在对话中调用 `smart-proxy.status` / `smart-proxy.switch-mode`

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smart-proxy       # Web / 插件中心
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-smart-proxy   # 桌面版
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`，在「设置 → 插件」中确认 `smart-proxy` 已启用。

本地开发时也可以直接从目录安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jack-jiang421/dsh-smart-proxy.git
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-smart-proxy
```

## 配置

在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖 `smart-proxy` 的配置：

```yaml
- id: smart-proxy
  config:
    mode: manual
    proxyUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
```

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `string` | `system` | 代理模式：`system` / `manual` / `direct` |
| `proxyUrl` | `string` | `http://127.0.0.1:7890` | `manual` 模式使用的代理地址 |
| `streamTimeout` | `number` | `600000` | SSE 流式超时（毫秒） |
| `connectTimeout` | `number` | `30000` | TCP 连接超时（毫秒） |
| `keepAlive` | `boolean` | `true` | 启用 TCP Keep-Alive |
| `retryOnTransportError` | `boolean` | `true` | 传输层错误自动重试 |
| `maxRetries` | `number` | `3` | 最大重试次数 |
| `ignoreTlsErrors` | `boolean` | `false` | 忽略 TLS 证书错误（仅在自签/中间人环境开启） |
| `bypassDomains` | `string[]` | `["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"]` | 不走代理的域名 |
| `autoTest` | `boolean` | `true` | 启动时自动测试连通性 |

> `ignoreTlsErrors` 会降低安全性，只在明确知道证书被拦截时临时开启。

## 在对话中使用

插件注册了三个 Agent 工具，直接用自然语言触发即可：

| 说法 | 工具 |
| --- | --- |
| 「看一下当前代理状态，顺便测下连通性」 | `smart-proxy.status` |
| 「切换到直连模式」 | `smart-proxy.switch-mode` |

`status` 返回当前模式、代理地址、TLS 豁免状态、连通性结果与延迟；`switch-mode` 支持 `direct` / `manual` / `system`，可同时传入新的 `proxyUrl`。

## 排查 Transport Failed

1. 先把 `mode` 改为 `direct`，确认问题是否由代理引起；
2. 核对 `proxyUrl` 端口与本机代理软件一致（Clash 常见 7890，V2Ray 常见 10809）；
3. 在代理规则里把 `api.deepseek.com` 设为 `DIRECT`，排除规则误判；
4. 临时关闭杀毒软件的 HTTPS 流量扫描（卡巴斯基、火绒等）；
5. 日志中搜索 `[dsh-smart-proxy]` 获取完整诊断。

## 兼容性

- DSH `>=0.2.0`（`engines.dsh`）
- Cordis `^4.0.1`

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Short model-generated recap under every completed turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, plus an on-demand /recap command.
plugins.readme_text: # Turn Recap for DSH A persistent [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that writes a short, model-generated recap under every completed turn in the Web UI — and regenerates one on demand with `/recap`. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## What it does - **After a turn the session goes quiet** a card appears at the end of that turn: one to three sentences saying what the turn accomplished and, only when it matters, what is still unfinished. The card waits out a quiet window (two minutes by default) and never appears for a turn you kept working past — it is a "where did I leave off" card, not a second summary of a reply you are still reading. The text follows the conversation's language. - **`/recap`** produces the same card for the latest turn on demand, immediately — useful when a turn never got its quiet window, when you scrolled past it, or when you want a fresh read of where things stand. - Turns that carry nothing to summarize (interrupted or failed turns, empty turns) produce no card, and subagent sessions are skipped by default. - When the turn leaves exactly one real next action — an unanswered question, an agreed next step, or a remedy for a blocker — the card adds a single **Next step** line under the summary. Turns that finished cleanly get no such line. The card uses the host's theme tokens, so it follows light/dark and the active locale (English and Simplified Chinese dictionaries ship with the bundle). ## Requirements - **DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`** — the runtime this plugin was built and verified against. `package.json` declares that floor as `engines.dsh`, and the launcher enforces it twice: when the bundle is installed, and again when a profile holding it starts. An older runtime refuses the operation with `incompatible-version` and names the unmet range. - Check which runtime a profile will use with `dsh --version`. - The floor is the API set this plugin binds, not a guess: `agent/turn-stopping`, session projections with a client-visible `wire` view, the `commands` registry (including `command/done` result text), `llm.prepareCall()` streaming, and on the Client side the `conversation.chat.turnTail` and `conversation.chat.commandview` slots plus `remote.session.projections`. A nearby version that provides all of them will almost certainly work, but only the declared floor is the combination tested here. No `peerDependencies` are declared on purpose: this bundle imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` module — it only resolves Cordis services at runtime — so a peer range would describe a dependency that does not exist. If you must run it on an older runtime, the launcher's escape hatch is an exact-version exemption, never a range: ```bash dsh plugin --profile allow-version '@local/dsh-turn-recap@1.0.1' --dsh-version '' --accept-risk ``` The same grant is available in Plugin Manager. It authorizes in-process code against a runtime it was never verified with — crashes and data loss are the documented risk — and it applies to one exact plugin version on one exact runtime version. ## Install This package is a DSH bundle: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` half, so it installs into a profile with the launcher's own plugin command. Nothing is published to npm. ```bash # newest commit on the default branch dsh plugin add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap # or pin the tagged release dsh plugin add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap#v1.0.1 ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and selects the bundle when the install finishes. With HMR enabled in the profile's YAML the composition reloads immediately; otherwise the profile picks it up on the next start. Install into a named profile by passing it through: ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:littepointR/dsh-turn-recap ``` The bundle patch adds one Loader row: ```yaml - insert: - id: turn-recap name: '@local/dsh-turn-recap' ``` ### From a checkout ```bash git clone https://github.com/littepointR/dsh-turn-recap.git dsh plugin --profile add link:D:/path/to/dsh-turn-recap ``` Or ask a DSH session to install the bundle from that directory with the profile's plugin manager. Reinstalling or toggling the plugin needs no Harness restart: disable and re-enable the row and the Host module is imported again. ## Configuration Every key is optional. Add a `config` block to the Loader row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — that layer survives package upgrades. | Key | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | `false` unregisters the projection, the turn listener, and `/recap` | | `maxTokens` | `200` | Output budget of the recap request | | `temperature` | `0.2` | Sampling temperature | | `timeoutMs` | `12000` | Hard bound on one recap request, in milliseconds | | `digestChars` | `6000` | Size bound of the turn digest sent to the model | | `idleMs` | `120000` | Quiet window a finished turn must hold before its card may appear; `0` shows it immediately | | `skipSubagents` | `true` | Subagent sessions get no automatic recap | | `provider`, `model` | unset | Explicit route; by default the turn's own request route is reused | ```yaml - insert: - id: turn-recap name: '@local/dsh-turn-recap' config: maxTokens: 300 skipSubagents: false ``` ## How it works ``` agent/turn-stopping ──▶ digest the turn ──▶ model call ──▶ pending map │ turn/end (committed) ──▶ projection apply ──▶ recap projection ──▶ useProjection("recap") │ conversation.chat.turnTail ``` 1. **`agent/turn-stopping`** is the serial event the agent loop dispatches just before it commits `turn/end`. The plugin digests the turn from the session log — the user request, the newest tool calls (with failures marked), and the turn's *final* assistant reply — and asks the model that served the turn for a short recap. 2. The following **`turn/end`** commit folds the text into the client-visible **`recap` session projection**, so the card and the finished turn arrive in the same frame. 3. The Client half registers into the **`conversation.chat.turnTail`** slot and reads the projection with `useProjection("recap")`. Each entry carries a `revealAt` deadline: the card is held back until that instant passes **and** no newer turn has started, so the quiet window costs nothing and the card never interrupts active work. **What the model is asked for.** One plain-text prompt: one to three sentences in the conversation's language, precise about how far the work actually got (`proposed`, `queued`, `implemented`, `tested`, `published`, and `installed` are different states), keeping unresolved caveats such as "not installed yet", and treating the latest user message as scope rather than proof that the work is done. A real next action — and only a real one — rides in on a final `Next:` line, which the Host parses into its own field so the card can label and style it. **Why a projection instead of a session event?** A plugin may not append new event types: a log carrying a type the build does not know cannot be reopened, and `appendPluginRecord()` is reserved for first-party experimental packages. The session projection is the supported carrier for session-derived client state. **Why is the recap produced before `turn/end`?** Projection state is folded synchronously from committed events and its Value is only re-read when a committed event changes that state. Producing the text while the turn boundary is still open is what lets the commitment bake it into state — the delayed *appearance* is a client-side rule over the stored `revealAt`, not a delayed request. **`/recap`** is a plain DSH command: it runs outside any turn, and its result travels in `command/done`. The Client half claims the command row through the `conversation.chat.commandview` slot under the `recap` key and renders the runn

# dsh-cost-slip

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在输入框底部显示当前会话的估算费用（人民币），点击打开，显示费用明细和账号余额。

![截图展示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pktheme/dsh-cost-slip/main/docs/Screenshot.png)

## 功能

- **独立胶囊**：在输入框底部统计行里，和「会话统计」「Token 用量」并排；收据图标 + `费用 ¥0.44`，hover 底色和圆角与原生一致。
- **费用明细**：点开胶囊，按「缓存命中 / 未缓存输入 / 输出」列出 token 数与金额，标题右侧是合计。
- **账号余额**：明细下方显示当前登录账号的「充值余额」「赠金余额」；打开弹窗时刷新读一次，之后每 10 秒刷新。
- **按条计价**：每条回复用当时的模型和峰谷价单独计算，中途换模型、跨高峰都保持准确。
- **窄窗口自适应**：窗口变窄或打开右侧边栏时，胶囊文字像原生统计项一样省略号截断。

## 安装

基于 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 开发，更低版本安装使用尚未测试。

桌面版：插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件，填 `dsh-cost-slip`，点「立即启用」后重启 DSH。

Web 版：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cost-slip
```

（`dsh` 未全局安装时：`npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cost-slip`）

安装后重启 `dsh web` 生效。

首次安装需要联网：宿主端依赖 `zod`，由 pnpm/npm 自动安装。

## 怎么算的

按**每条** `assistant/message`（以及失败重试的 `assistant/attempt`）单独计价：

1. 取这条回复的 `usage`：未命中输入 `inputTokens`、缓存命中 `cacheReadTokens`、缓存写入 `cacheWriteTokens`、输出 `outputTokens`。
2. 取这条回复的模型（`message.source.model`，缺失时用最近一次 `request/header`）和完成时间 `event.time`。
3. 用 `lib/pricing.js` 的价目表计算，单位换算成微元后累加。

**缓存写入按未命中单价计。** 价格来源：[DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)

## 隐私

- 只通过 DSH 宿主接口读取会话的 token 用量与事件，不抓包、不联网。
- 余额通过宿主提供的账号接口读取，仅用于显示。
- 不上报任何数据，不写入额外文件。

## 已知边界

- **估算值**：不是官方账单；赠送额度、优惠、失败请求的计费细节以 DeepSeek 账单为准。
- **子智能体**：subagent 跑在独立会话里，主会话的费用不含它们的消耗。
- **旧事件**：只对带 provider usage 的回复计费；没有 usage 的旧事件会跳过。
- **兼容性**：依赖 DSH 的 `sessionProjections` 和 `composer.dock` 插槽；DSH 大版本升级后若改名，插件需要跟着改。

## 开发

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pktheme/dsh-cost-slip.git
cd dsh-cost-slip
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

- `lib/index.js`：宿主端会话投影，按条累计费用。
- `lib/client.js`：胶囊与弹窗 UI。
- `lib/pricing.js`：价目表与峰谷判断，调价只改这里。
- `locale/*.json`：插件名与简介。

协议：MIT。

## 图标

插件页图标 `icon.svg` 与界面里的收据图标均为作者本人绘制。

---

非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao

Session bell for DeepSeek Harness: mark a conversation, and **when it finishes
answering** the machine plays an alarm and the page flashes a card.

## Why the sound is not played by the tab

A hidden browser tab is frozen after a few minutes: none of its timers run, so an
alarm built in the page only fires when the person is already back, exactly when
it is useless. Here the **harness process** plays the sound (it does not freeze),
through `pw-play`, `aplay`, `afplay` or `ffplay`, and the page only shows the
visual part. If the GUI window is focused, the host stays silent: the person is
already looking at the screen.

## How it works

| Half | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| host | `index.js` | keeps the marked conversations on disk, listens to `api-session/status`, plays the alarm, sends a desktop notification and serves `/aviso-sessao/api/*` |
| page | `client.js` | bell in the conversation header, flashing card in the global layer, and the tab title blinking |

The two halves meet over HTTP on the local host. The page reports whether it is
focused on every poll (5 s), and that is what decides between sound and silence.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` (the harness manages profile plugins with it).
- A sound player: `pw-play` or `aplay` on Linux (PipeWire/ALSA), `afplay` on
  macOS (built in), `ffplay` on Windows (part of FFmpeg). Without one the card
  still works; only the sound is lost.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao
# restart the harness (stop `dsh web` and start it again)
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` installs it **and**
adds its line to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. The bundle layer
is read at boot, so a restart is what activates it.

### Remove

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao   # then restart
```

## Use

- Ring the bell in the conversation header to mark (or unmark) that conversation.
- When a marked conversation finishes answering, the alarm plays and a card
  flashes in the GUI; the tab title blinks while the alert is pending.
- Click the card (or the bell) to dismiss the alert.

## Configuration

Config lives on the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`); a
patch replaces the whole config of the line, so restate what you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: aviso-sessao
  config:
    statePath: '~/.dsh/aviso-sessao.json'
    som: 'sons/alarme.wav'
    repeticoes: 3
    pausaMs: 250
    notificar: true
    tocaComFoco: false
```

| Key | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `statePath` | `~/.dsh/aviso-sessao.json` | where the state lives |
| `som` | `sons/alarme.wav` from the package | which file to play |
| `repeticoes` | `3` | how many times per alert (1 to 10) |
| `pausaMs` | `250` | silence between repetitions |
| `notificar` | `true` | also send a desktop notification |
| `tocaComFoco` | `false` | `true` plays even when the window is focused |

`statePath` is what keeps the bell lit across a page reload or a harness restart:
delete the file to unmark everything.

## Test

```sh
node --test test/      # alarm decision, config limits, player ladder
```

To hear and see it with the plugin mounted: `curl -s -X POST
http://127.0.0.1:3080/aviso-sessao/api/testar`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-tool-cost-hint

> 不告诉你花了多少钱，只告诉你每个工具往你的上下文里塞了多少东西。

纯被动观察插件：**不注册工具**、**不往模型上下文写任何东西**、**不 append 任何 session 事件**。
它只监听 `session/event`，在每轮结束时整理出"这一轮谁调了哪些工具、各几次、各自注入多少 token"。

**当前范围：host 面（记账）+ client 面（对话流内一行可折叠提示，`conversation.chat.turnTail`）。**
host 面归因口径与第一轮完全一致，第二轮只新增了"把已有折叠结果送到浏览器"的通道和渲染层，没有改动任何计数逻辑。

---

## ⚠️ 安装前必读（桌面版用户）

**DSH 桌面版（Electron）的 `desktop` profile 被主进程独占，`dsh plugin` 命令对它是只读的：**

```text
$ dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:.../dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

这不是权限问题、也不是命令写错，而是设计如此——桌面端的 profile 由 Electron 应用自己管理。
**所以如果你的 DSH 是桌面版，安装本插件的唯一方法就是手动改配置文件**，`dsh plugin add` 永远会失败。

### 桌面版手动安装（三步）

设你的用户目录为 `%USERPROFILE%`（即 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>`），插件包放在任意位置，例如
`C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`。

**第 1 步：把包装进 profile。** 打开命令行，在
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\` 里执行（这一步只是解包，不会触发 Electron 限制）：

```bash
npm install "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
# 或者用 pnpm（DSH 自带）：pnpm add "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
```

装完应该出现 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js`。
（如果想直接链接源码目录调试，改用 `npm install "file:C:/path/to/dsh-tool-cost-hint"`，
或在 `node_modules` 里建一个指向源码目录的 Junction。）

**第 2 步：改 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`。** 用记事本打开，改两处：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    // ……原有的依赖都保留，只追加下面这一行……
    "dsh-tool-cost-hint": "file:C:/Users/you/Downloads/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ……原有的 bundle 都保留，数组末尾追加下面这一项……
        "dsh-tool-cost-hint"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

两处都要改，缺一不可：
- `dependencies` 让它能被 `require` 解析到（路径写成 `file:` + 正斜杠，或 `link:` 指向源码目录）；
- **`dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾的 `"dsh-tool-cost-hint"` 才是真正让它被加载的开关**。
  写进 bundles 后，loader 会自动套用它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把 `tool-cost-hint` 这行插进组合。

改之前建议先备份 `package.json`。**注意 JSON 不允许注释**，上面代码块里的 `//` 只是说明，别抄进文件。

**第 3 步：完全退出 DSH 进程再重开**（不是关窗口；插件在启动时组合，托盘退出或任务管理器结束进程都行）。

### 验证装好了没有

重开后随便发一轮**用到工具**的消息（比如让它读个文件），回复底部操作栏上方会出现一行：

```text
🛠 read ×1 · pwsh ×2 · ≈3.4K tok
```

点它展开：逐行的 `工具名 / ×次数 / 输入 / 输出`，末行 `注入量 ≈Z tok`。**没有这一行就是没装上**，按顺序查：

1. `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 里两处都改了吗？（最常见的原因就是只改了 `dependencies` 忘了 `dependencies` 之外的 bundles）
2. `node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js` 存在吗？
3. 重启时是不是只关了窗口、进程还活着？

> 非桌面版（`dsh web` / `dsh tui` 命令行启动）不受影响，可以直接
> `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:<tgz 路径>`，无需手改 JSON。

---

## 0. 怎么把插件发给别人

**最简单的办法：直接发这个固定下载链接。**

```text
https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

这个链接指向带着**预构建 `dist/`** 的 tarball，永远指向最新 Release，不会失效。
对方下载后一条命令装好（命令行版）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面版看本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」——`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 一定会失败，必须手改 `package.json`。

当前 Release：https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/tag/v0.2.0

---

**注意：本仓库的网页地址本身不是一个可以直接安装的地址。**

```text
# ❌ 这些都不行（网页地址不是安装源）
dsh plugin add https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

DSH 的安装来源只有三种（[官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)）：

| 来源 | 命令形态 | 能不能用在本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm 包名 | `dsh plugin --profile web add <包名>` | **暂不可用**——还没发布到 npm registry |
| GitHub 源码 | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint` | **可用**，但拉的是源码，对方要能连 GitHub 且本机得有构建工具链 |
| Release / 本地 tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add ./x.tgz` | **可用且最省事**，`dist/` 已经打包在里面 |

> 注意：`github:` 源拉的是**源码**而不是构建产物（`dist/` 不进 git）。
> 对方装完如果没有构建产物，插件加载会失败。想省掉这一步就用 Release 里的 tarball（路线 A）。

### 路线 A：发 tarball 文件（现在就能用，推荐）

**推荐直接发 Release 链接**，不用自己打包：

```text
https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

也可以自己打包后发文件（`dist/` 必须先构建好，见第 8 节）：

```bash
npm run build
pnpm pack        # 或 npm pack，产出 dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

把 `dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`（约 32 KB）通过微信 / 网盘 / 邮件发给对方，对方执行：

```bash
# 非桌面版
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面版按本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」手改 `package.json`（`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 永远会失败）。

安全提示：对方用非官方渠道拿到的文件时，先核对 sha256 再装（Windows）：

```bash
certutil -hashfile dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz SHA256
```

`v0.2.0` 的期望值：`73190410b86206af6e4b5785dec006f2ca59a7c6ce8c97b637607285fb19cba6`

### 路线 B：发布到 npm registry（之后就能"一个包名直接装"）

发布后对方只需要：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

需要的东西：

1. 一个 npm 账号（https://www.npmjs.com/signup），本机 `npm login`；
2. `npm publish`（包名 `dsh-tool-cost-hint` 目前**未被占用**，已确认 registry 返回 404）；
3. 之后每次更新 `npm version patch && npm publish`。

这是唯一能做到"我发个名字，对方一条命令装好"的路线。注意 `dist/` 必须在发布前构建好——包里的 `files` 白名单要求 `dist/` 存在（见第 8 节）。

### 路线 C：进 DSH Plugin Hub 插件市场（覆盖面最大）

[DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins)（`dsh-plugin` 包，装完在「设置 → 插件市场」）靠爬虫自动收录，收录条件写得很明确：

- **GitHub 公开仓库** + 仓库 Topics 加 `dsh-plugin`（爬虫只认 GitHub）；
- README 含可复制的安装命令（本文件已有）；
- 导出 `apply(ctx)`（本插件已导出）。

仓库已经是 GitHub 公开仓库，剩下的就是给仓库加 `dsh-plugin` topic，然后到 https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/submit 提交。

### 三条路怎么选

- 只想给一两个朋友试：**路线 A**，一分钟搞定；
- 想让人一条命令装、且能持续更新：**路线 B**（需要 npm 账号）；
- 想被更多人搜到：**路线 C**（仓库已满足条件，去提交即可）。

> 补充：部分 DSH 版本的客户端界面上有「添加插件」输入框，可以填包名 / GitHub 仓库地址 / 本地目录路径。
> 填 GitHub 地址时拉的是源码（可能需要本机构建）；**填本地 `.tgz` 的完整路径最稳**，因为 `dist/` 已经打包好了。

## 1. 文件清单

```
dsh-tool-cost-hint/
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明 + 依赖
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 组合插入行（同时可用作 --patch 覆盖）
├─ tsconfig.json         # 只做类型检查（noEmit），产物交给 tsdown
├─ tsdown.config.ts      # 构建 host 入口 → dist/index.js
├─ tsdown.client.config.ts # 构建 client 入口 → dist/client.js（包 __ModuleLoader__ 壳）
├─ README.md
└─ src/
   ├─ index.ts           # apply()：监听、记账、轮末折叠、emit
   ├─ events.ts          # 纯函数：事件读取/校验 + token 定价
   ├─ types.ts           # host 对外契约：ToolUsage / TurnToolUsageSummary / Config
   ├─ contract.ts        # host↔client 共享的形状：投影 key + ToolCostHintView
   ├─ wire.ts            # 投影定义：同一套折叠逻辑 + wire.view（浏览器数据通道）
   └─ client/
      ├─ index.tsx       # 折叠条组件 + slot 注册 + 惰性降级
      ├─ style.ts        # 内联 CSS 字符串（client 产物必须自包含）
      └─ types.ts        # client 侧结构类型（不依赖 Harness Client 包）
```

---

## 2. 归因口径（本插件唯一的"技术核心"）

| 字段 | 含义 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputTokens` | 该工具**调用侧**注入量：本轮 tool/call 事件里 tool-call 块的（工具名 + 参数 JSON）token | `estimate`（官方公式） |
| `outputTokens` | 该工具**结果侧**注入量：tool/result 追加进模型可见 surface 的那条 tool 消息的 token | `meter` 优先，`estimate` 回退 |
| `injectedTokens` | 前两者之和，**UI 上展示的就是这个数**，标签为"注入量" | 派生 |

为什么叫"注入量"而不是"花费量"：

- provider 只报整轮的 usage（uncachedInput / cacheRead / output …），**没有任何 per-tool 计费数据**；
- 命中缓存后，"注入 3000 token"和"花了 3000 token 的钱"是两件事。
- 因此本插件不引入任何价格换算、不显示金额；计价留给 `dsh-bill` 这类插件，两边口径不重叠。

为什么 `inputTokens` 只能是估算：

- `tool/call` **不是 surface 事件**（模型可见 surface 只有 system/developer/user/assistant 消息和 tool/result），
  它在 `ctx.tokenMeter.measure()` 里没有独立节点，拿不到官方数字；
- 但 tool-call 块确实会进入下一次请求，必须算进去；
- 于是用 token meter **自己的**定价公式（`estimate.js` 的 tool-call 分支）：
  `ceil(name.length/4) + ceil(arguments.length/4) + 4`，并**不计 block.id**（上游也不计，计了就对不上）。

> 结论：这不是"重算一个已有的数"，而是"补一个框架没有单独露出来的数"，且公式与框架逐字一致。
> 数据结构里用 `inputTokensSource` / `outputTokensSource` 显式标出来源，UI 上可以区分"计量"与"估算"。

---

## 3. 事件时机（为什么等 `turn/end`）

| 事件 | 到达时做什么 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `turn/start` | 建本轮累加器 | 拿到 `startedSeq` / `startedAt`，用于时长与定位 |
| `tool/call` | `calls += 1`，累加 `inputTokens`，登记待配对调用 | O(1)，参数已在事件里，不需要任何服务 |
| `tool/result` | 配对 `callId`，累加 `errors`，**只记 seq + 一个估算数字** | 不缓存结果正文：工具结果动辄几十 KB，长会话里留在插件内存里既浪费又长期驻留 |
| `turn/end` | **调一次** `ctx.tokenMeter.measure()`，用节点 tokens 覆盖估算值，折叠成摘要，emit | `measure()` 是 O(surface) 的整表快照，只能一轮一次；此时本轮所有结果都已落地，数据到了终态 |

未配对情况都显式记录，不静默吞掉：

- `unattributedCalls`：发了 tool/call 但没等到 tool/result（中断/仍在跑）→ `outputTokens` 记 0，`calls` 与 `inputTokens` 照算；
- `orphanResults`：收到 tool/result 但没有配对调用（插件中途加载、框架补写恢复结果）→ 归到合成桶 `(unattributed)`，结果 token 照算。

---

## 4. 推送接口设计（三层，第三层第二轮已落地）

三层，边界很清楚：

1. **内存态（host 内部）**：`WeakMap<Session, SessionBook>`，`SessionBook.turns: Map<turn, TurnAccumulator>`

plugins.description: DSH tools that drive your running Brave browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-brave-cdp

Drive **your own, already-running Brave** over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: the
real window, your profile, your cookies, your logins, your tabs — including the
tab you are looking at right now.

Most browser automation launches a fresh browser it owns. This one attaches to the
one you already have open, so an agent can read a login-walled page, fill a form in
a session you are signed into, or hand a task back to you mid-flight in the same
window. Nothing is scraped from a parallel profile.

Two surfaces, one implementation:

| Surface | Use it when |
|---|---|
| **DSH tools** (`brave_tabs`, `brave_goto`, …) | an agent drives the browser — schemas, rendered results, no shell quoting |
| **`brave-cdp` CLI** (shipped in this package) | a human or script drives it, or you want `jq`/`batch` pipelines |

Both call the same CDP client, so behaviour and failure messages match.

## Tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `brave_tabs` | list / open / focus / close tabs |
| `brave_goto` | navigate a tab (or a new one) and wait for load |
| `brave_snapshot` | interactive elements with `@eN` refs (role, name, value, href, state) |
| `brave_click` | real mouse click by `@eN` ref, CSS selector, or visible text |
| `brave_fill` | set an input / textarea / contenteditable, firing `input`/`change` |
| `brave_key` | press a key, optionally with ctrl / shift / alt / meta |
| `brave_eval` | evaluate JavaScript in the page, awaiting promises |
| `brave_wait` | wait for a selector, text, url, or document load |
| `brave_screenshot` | capture a PNG and return its path |

With no `tab` argument a tool acts on the tab the user is looking at
(`document.visibilityState === 'visible'`), and every result carries the CLI's
`tab:` header so it is clear which tab ran the call. `@eN` refs come from
`brave_snapshot` and stay valid until the page navigates.

Screenshots return a **path** rather than inline pixels: the agent reads the PNG
with whatever image-reading tool it already has, so this plugin needs no vision
pipeline of its own.

## Requirements

1. **Brave started with a CDP port.** Add the flag to the launcher's flag file
   (`~/.config/brave-flags.conf` for the Arch `brave-bin` wrapper):

   ```
   --remote-debugging-port=9222
   ```

   The flag applies at startup only, so Brave must be restarted after adding it.
   The port binds to loopback, but see [Security](#security) before enabling it.

2. **Node ≥ 22** for the CLI (it uses the built-in `fetch` and `WebSocket`; no
   dependencies). Node ≥ 22 is also required by DSH itself.

3. **DSH** with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peer
   packages (present in any DSH install) for the tool surface.

The CLI itself is bundled at `bin/brave-cdp.mjs`; the tools resolve it from the
package, falling back to `~/.local/bin/brave-cdp`, then to `cliPath` /
`BRAVE_CDP_CLI`.

## Install

```bash
# into a DSH profile (declares dsh.bundle.patch, so the tools row mounts itself)
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:olegedly/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp"

# or from a checkout / tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp
```

Then confirm the endpoint is reachable:

```bash
brave-cdp status     # endpoint UP + browser version + tab count => ready
```

Standalone CLI, without DSH (not on npm yet, so install it from the repository):

```bash
npm install -g "github:olegedly/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp"   # provides `brave-cdp`
brave-cdp tabs
brave-cdp snapshot -i
brave-cdp click '@e4'
brave-cdp eval 'document.title'
brave-cdp shot page.png --full
```

## CLI

```
brave-cdp status                     endpoint, browser version, tab count
brave-cdp tabs [list]                tabs, 1-based indices, * marks the target
brave-cdp tabs new <url>             open a tab
brave-cdp tabs select <n|id|text>    focus a tab and raise its window
brave-cdp tabs close <n|id|text>     close a tab
brave-cdp open <url> [--new]         navigate (or open) and wait for load
brave-cdp back | forward | reload [--hard]
brave-cdp snapshot [scope] [-i] [--compact] [--json]
brave-cdp click <@eN|css|--text T> [--exact] [--dblclick]
brave-cdp fill <@eN|css> <text> [--append]
brave-cdp type [@eN|css] <text>
brave-cdp key <Enter|Tab|Escape|ArrowDown|...> [--ctrl --shift --alt --meta]
brave-cdp eval <js> [--file <path>|-]     evaluate JS, print JSON
brave-cdp html [css] [--text] / text [css]
brave-cdp shot [file] [--full]
brave-cdp wait <ms>|@eN|--selector S|--text T|--url U|--load
brave-cdp batch "open https://x" "wait --text Done" "shot done.png"
```

Global flags: `--tab <n|id|url-substr>`, `--json`, `--timeout <ms>`, `--port <n>`.
Env: `BRAVE_CDP_PORT` (9222), `BRAVE_CDP_HOST` (127.0.0.1), `BRAVE_CDP_TIMEOUT`.

`brave-cdp help` is the source of truth.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cliPath` | packaged `bin/brave-cdp.mjs` | CLI to invoke |
| `port` | `9222` | CDP port (must match the Brave flag) |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Per-call timeout |
| `screenshotTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Screenshot timeout |

The bundled patch mounts the row as `brave-cdp`; a profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` is applied afterwards, so override that id to change the port
or point at another CLI:

```yaml
- id: brave-cdp
  config:
    port: 9223
```

## Security

CDP is **full control of the browser**: page contents, cookies, and any session
you are logged into are readable, and it can act as you on any site. The port
binds to loopback only, which limits it to local processes — that is a boundary,
not a guarantee. Add the flag when you want an agent to drive the browser, and
remove it (and restart) when you do not.

## Development

```bash
npm run check    # node --check on the plugin and the CLI
npm test         # node --test test/ (no network, no browser needed)
```

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | the nine tools: schemas, argument mapping, result rendering |
| `bin/brave-cdp.mjs` | the CDP client — transport, target selection, DOM refs, input, screenshots |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the bundle patch that mounts the tools row |
| `test/` | CLI behaviour and packaging invariants |

Because the CDP client lives in the CLI, the plugin is a thin adapter: one tested
code path serves both the tool surface and the shell, and the DSH host process
never imports a browser-automation dependency.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-image-pin-comment · 图片图钉标注 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的图片预览加一层**图钉 + 评论**：在图上点一下钉一颗编号图钉， 图钉下方弹出评论框写一句话；点「插入到输入框」后，**原图 + 一段带坐标的说明**一起进草稿， 回车即发。 **发出去的是原图**，图钉只存在于屏幕上 —— 模型看到干净的图，靠文字里的坐标精确定位。 ![预览](docs/preview.png) ## 它解决什么 > 「把这个按钮往左挪 8px。」—— 模型问：哪个按钮？ > 「这里文字重叠了。」—— 模型开始认真猜「这里」是哪里。 图片进入模型后只剩像素。本插件把「这里」变成模型能直接算的东西：**图像编号 + 百分比 + 原图像素 + 容差 + 建议裁切框**。 一次可以标记多张图，每张图独立编号： ```text 这两个地方怎么改？ 【图片标注】图像 1（1200×800）锚点 2 处，已在输入框中。锚点不画在图上，按下面的坐标定位：百分比 = 锚点占图片宽高的比例，px = 原图像素坐标，裁切 = 以锚点为中心的方形区域（x0,y0,x1,y1）。 1. (x: 30.0%, y: 40.0% | px 360,320 | ±13px | 裁切 321,281,399,359) 这个按钮往左挪 8px 2. (x: 70.0%, y: 65.0% | px 840,520 | ±13px | 裁切 801,481,879,559) 这里文字重叠了 【图片标注】图像 2（900×600）锚点 1 处，已在输入框中。… 1. (x: 50.0%, y: 50.0% | px 450,300 | ±10px | 裁切 420,270,480,330) 这张图的标题要加粗 ``` ## 流程（两次回车） | 步骤 | 你做什么 | 插件做什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 点开会话里的任意图片（消息里的截图、输入框草稿图、工具返回的图） | 预览底部出现工具条：`标注 · 0 处 · 清空 · 插入到输入框` | | 2 | 点「标注」 | 进入图钉模式，光标变十字 | | 3 | 在图上任意位置左键点一下 | 落一颗空心环 + 十字准星的编号图钉，下方弹出评论框并自动聚焦 | | 4 | 打字，按 **第一次回车** | 只确认**这一颗**图钉的内容；气泡收起，仍在标注模式，可以接着钉第 2、3… 颗 | | 5 | 全部写完，点「插入到输入框」 | 把**原图**（原字节、原分辨率）放进输入框；坐标说明先记在输入框上方的一枚 chip 里，**草稿保持干净**；预览自动关闭 | | 6 | 在输入框里补一句问题，按 **第二次回车** | 发送瞬间把 chip 里的清单拼进消息，一起发出去；chip 自动消失 | 要点：**第一次回车只确认图钉，第二次回车才是发出去** —— 因为图钉可以不止一个。 ### 输入框保持干净（chip） 坐标清单默认**不落进输入框**，只在输入框上方显示一枚 chip：`● 2 张图 · 3 处锚点 [查看] [清空]`。 - **查看**：弹出完整清单（就是模型会收到的内容），只读、可选中复制； - **清空**：丢弃这一轮的锚点记录（已经插进输入框的图片不动）； - **发送**：按回车或点发送按钮时，插件先把清单拼到你的问题后面，再交给宿主发送，chip 随之收起。 宿主版本拿不到 `setDraft` / `submit` 时（例如没有会话的极端情况），插件会退回老行为：把清单直接写进草稿，保证信息不丢。 再多张图也一样：接着点开第二张、钉点、插入 → 自动写成「图像 2」，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 「图像 N」按这一批里被标注的顺序编号，块里同时给出尺寸和附件名，便于和输入框里的附件对上号。 其它交互： - 点已有图钉 = 重新编辑它的评论；拖动图钉 = 挪位置（坐标跟着变）； - 气泡里 `Esc` = 取消（备注为空时这颗钉一起删掉）、`Shift+Enter` = 换行、「删除」= 删掉这颗钉； - 同一张图再次打开：**之前的锚点会被预载回来**，编号延续，坐标块就地更新（不会出现第二份「图像 N」）； - 图本来就在输入框里（草稿附件）：只补坐标说明，**不会重复插一张一样的图**； - 预览右上角 `×` / `Esc` 关掉预览，整层随预览一起消失。 ## 安装 ### A. 本地开发（推荐先这样试） ```sh cd /path/to/dsh-image-pin-comment ./scripts/install-local.sh # 默认装进 desktop profile（DSH 桌面端） ./scripts/install-local.sh web # 或 web profile ``` 它做两件事：把插件目录 symlink 进 `~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules/`， 并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一行挂载配置（写之前会备份）。 然后刷新界面（⌘R）；若工具条没出现，重启一次 DSH。 卸载：`./scripts/install-local.sh --remove`。 ### B. 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐，不需要 npm） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 装完重启一次 DSH（profile 的 bundle 组合在启动时展开）。 要固定版本也可以直接指向 tag：`github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment#v0.2.0`。 不装 CLI 也行：桌面端 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件** 里填 `github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment`。 ### C. 从 Release 的 tarball 装（离线/内网） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment/releases/latest/download/dsh-image-pin-comment.tgz ``` ### D. 从 npm 装（发布后可用） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 本仓库自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），装成 bundle 时插件自己挂载自己。 双挂载有保护：bundle 行与本地 install.sh 同时命中时只挂一份。 ## 它怎么工作（给改代码的人） 两个半边，都在 `lib/`： - `lib/index.js`：宿主半边，故意是空的；只负责给 loader 一个 entry，让 `dsh-client-modules` 扫到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.client` 与 `exports["./client"]`。 - `lib/client.js`：浏览器半边，手写、无构建、不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。 几处关键实现： | 环节 | 做法 | 为什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 挂载点 | 只认一个稳定特征：`body > div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]` 且直接子元素里有 ``（`ImageLightbox`），节流 `MutationObserver` 扫描，出现即挂、移除即销毁 | 不注册 slot、不动 React 树，官方改内部 API 也影响不到 | | 坐标 | 图钉一律存「原图像素」；显示时按 `rect.width / naturalWidth` 缩放，百分比在生成文本时现算 | 缩放窗口、换 DPI、导出三处永远一致 | | 图钉外观 | 空心环 + 中心留空的十字准星 + 右上角编号徽标 | 被指的字符不会被钉挡住（对着截图问「这是什么字」时全靠这点） | | 发原图 | `fetch(src)` 取回原始字节，按原扩展名作为附件塞进输入框；拿不到才退回「像素副本」 | 模型看到干净原图；不重编码、不动分辨率 | | 文本投递 | 一级 `inputActions.setDraft`（通过只读的 `conversation.input.overlay` 桥接组件拿到）→ 二级合成文本 paste → 三级 `execCommand` → 四级复制到剪贴板 | 全走 DSH 自己的入口；每级都有兜底 | | 一批多图 | `draftBatch` 按图片 `src` 记账，记录每张图已写进草稿的块；再次标注同一张图时预载锚点并就地替换该块 | 「图像 N 的锚点 1..k」永远指同一张图的同一批点，不串号 | | 草稿比对 | 空白归一化 + 下标映射后再定位块（Lexical 的 `innerText` 是 `\n\n`，我们写进去的是 `\n`） | 判断「上一批是否已经发出去」，并在原始文本上精确 splice | | 会话键 | bridge 组件卸载时只标记失效、不清空，会话键记住最后一次看到的值 | composer 重渲染的瞬间不会把多图编号清掉 | ## 自测 三档，从便宜到可信： | 脚本 | 跑什么 | 结果 | | --- | --- | --- | | `npm run check` | `node --check` 两个半边 | 语法 | | `node test/smoke.mjs` | 真实 Chrome（headless + CDP）加载 `test/fixture.html`（复刻 `ImageLightbox` + composer 的离线夹具）；bridge 档位（chip + 发送拦截）**33 / 33**，兜底档位（直接写草稿）**22 / 22** | **全部通过** | | `node test/real-flow.mjs ` | 真实 dsh 实例 + 真 composer + 真 lightbox：paste 两张图 → 分别钉点 → 插入 → 回车发送（submit 用桩替换，不真发） | **14 / 14** | `test/smoke.mjs` 覆盖的断言（A/B/C/D/E 五段场景）： - **A** 未进标注模式点图不落钉；进模式后落钉、气泡聚焦；第一次回车只确认备注、**不触发任何发送**； 锚点中心保持透明（不遮字）、环上有颜色； 发出去的是**原图**（整张图 0 个红点、锚点位置像素 = 原图灰度）；附件名 `image-1-*.png`； **插入后草稿里没有坐标块，只多了一枚 chip**（`1 张图 · 2 处锚点`）；用户自己写的问题保持原样。 - **B** 第二张图 → 「图像 2（900×600）」+ chip 变 `2 张图 · 3 处锚点`，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 - **C** 同一张图再打开 → 预载旧锚点；chip 的锚点数涨到 4，同一张图不会重复插附件。 - **D** 已经在输入框里的图 → 只补记录（`已在输入框中`），附件数不变，chip 变 `3 张图 · 5 处锚点`； - **E** 在输入框打一句话按回车 → 清单被拼到问题后面并调用 `submit`，chip 收起；提交内容含三张图的块、`px`、`±容差`、`裁切框`。 重新生成夹具：`node test/build-fixture.mjs`；重新拍预览图：`node test/screenshot.mjs`。 ### 真机验证：开一个隔离实例（不碰你自己的 `~/.dsh`） ```sh APP="/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app" CLI="$APP/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" # 1) 在临时 DSH_HOME 里造一个 web profile（复制 web 模板，不联网） DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --from-default-profile web --dump-config DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home ./scripts/install-local.sh piniso # 2) 起一个隔离的 web 实例（port 0 = 系统随便给一个），记下打印出来的 token URL DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --no-open --port 0 # 3) 另一个终端跑真机链路 node test/real-flow.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:/?token=" # 4) 收工 rm -rf /tmp/dsh-home ``` `test/real-e2e.mjs ` 是更轻的一档：只验证 client bundle 加载、boot 清单收录、 locale / 主题 token 可用、观察器在真实外壳里挂上预览、图钉与气泡可用。 调试：控制台里 `__dshImagePinComment.annotators[0].state` 看实时状态； `localStorage.setItem('dsh-image-pin-comment.debug', '1')` 打开详细日志。 ## 已知限制 - 坐标是**点**，不是框。要框选请配合 `dsh-image-annotate` 那类画笔插件使用。 - 只接管 DSH 自己的图片预览（lightbox）；输入框草稿缩略图点开走同一个预览，因此同样可用。 - 消息气泡里不渲染「标注 ×N」chip（第一版只做核心链路）；坐标块作为普通文本随消息发出。 - 不提供设置页；工具条文案跟随 DSH 的 `locale`（zh / en）。 - 一次标记太多张图时坐标块会变长（每张图一块，带像素与裁切框）——刻意的取舍： 宁可文字长一点，也不要模型去猜。 ## 开源方案对照（为什么是这个做法） 调研过 DSH 生态里所有图片标注类插件（2026-10 快照），与本需求的重合度： | 项目 | 能力 | 与本需求的差距 | | --- | --- | --- | | [zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 预览上加画笔/箭头/框/圆圈/文字，原分辨率导出进输入框 | 没有图钉，不产出坐标文本 | | [janewas/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/janewas/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 输入框待发图片就地标注，作为第二张附件插回 | 同上，且只针对草稿图 | | [heshuren371/dsh-annotator](https://github.com/heshuren371/dsh-annotator) · MIT | 网页/图片上**画框**+描述，Agent 拿到框坐标与 DOM | 是框不是钉，且是 agent preset + host 路由的重架构 | | [Max-Null/dsh-capture](https://github.com/Max-Null/dsh-capture) | 截图 + 框选 + 红框标注进输入框 | 面向截图，不是对已上传图片打点 | | [omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) · MIT | 文本选区批注随消息发送、逐条编号回复 | 对象是文字不是图片，但「编号清单」的思路可借鉴 | 结论：**没有「图钉 + 坐标清单」的现成实现**，但「预览叠加 + 原图像素坐标 + 合成 paste 投递」 这套骨架已被上面两个插件在真实 DSH 上验证过，所以本插件沿用它（MIT，已在 LICENSE 里标注）， 只把「画笔」换成「图钉 + 评论 + 坐标清单」。 ## License MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)（含上游 dsh-image-annotate 的版权声明）。 与 DeepSeek 官方无关，未获其许可或背书。

plugins.description: Ollama Cloud for DeepSeek Harness: one API key, auto-pulled model catalog, real thinking levels, hosted web tools, and 5h/7d quota + token usage UI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ollama-cloud

Ollama Cloud for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). One API
key; no local Ollama install.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![Sidebar quota chip](docs/ui-main.png)

## Install

```sh
# desktop app profile and/or web profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git:github.com/pei-lin-001/dsh-ollama-cloud
dsh plugin --profile web add git:github.com/pei-lin-001/dsh-ollama-cloud
```

Open **Settings → Ollama Cloud**, paste a key from
[ollama.com/settings/keys](https://ollama.com/settings/keys), and press **保存并同步** (save and
sync). The key goes into the credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`) and never reaches
the browser. The catalog is written to the `llm-pi-ai` settings section as route `ollama-cloud`, and
the models appear in the picker.

`OLLAMA_API_KEY` in the process environment also works. It shadows a stored key, and the credentials
service then refuses writes.

Development checkout:

```sh
git clone git@github.com:pei-lin-001/dsh-ollama-cloud.git ~/Dev/dsh-ollama-cloud
cd ~/Dev/dsh-ollama-cloud && dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
./scripts/link-peers.sh   # schemastery, dsh-credentials, dsh-settings, dsh-tools
```

A linked package resolves peers from its own `node_modules`, which is why the last step exists.

## What it does

On boot, on credential change, and on demand, the plugin pulls the account's catalog and writes it as
an `llm-pi-ai` route: `GET /v1/models` for the ids, then one `POST /api/show` per model. Chat, tools,
vision and thinking are served by `dsh-llm-pi-ai` (`api: openai-completions`,
`baseURL: https://ollama.com/v1`); the plugin supplies the catalog and the credential, and
`dsh-llm-pi-ai` does the transport.

Model entries come from `/api/show`:

- `capabilities` decides which models get tools, vision and a thinking set. Models without `tools`
  are skipped unless `includeNonToolModels` is on.
- `<arch>.context_length` becomes `contextWindow`.
- `thinking.values` becomes `reasoningEfforts`. `false` maps to `off: 'none'`, since sending nothing
  would fall back to the model default (usually on). `true` maps to a single `medium` level. Graded
  names map one-to-one, so a model advertising both `xhigh` and `max` offers both.

The list replaces the route's models, and an unchanged section is not rewritten.

Two tools come with it: `ollama_web_search` and `ollama_web_fetch` call `/api/web_search` and
`/api/web_fetch` with the same key.

Quota and usage come from `GET /api/balance` (5h session, 7d weekly) and `GET /api/usage`. A current
plan reports tokens and cost there; a legacy plan reports requests only. For legacy plans the plugin
taps the `usage` chunk its own requests emit through `llm/stream`, counts input/cached/output per
model in hourly buckets, keeps 30 days in `$DSH_HOME/ollama-cloud-usage.json`, and aligns the totals
with the reset times the balance reports. Other clients' traffic stays invisible to that meter, so
server numbers win when they exist.

Every history image is re-sent on every step, and Ollama Cloud rejects an oversized request at the
gateway before the model runs (413, around 12 MB observed). The plugin keeps image base64 under 6 MiB:
on `0.2.x` it writes `maxRequestImageBytes` into the route, so the adapter stops at the bound and the
harness offloads the oldest images and retries with placeholders; on `0.1.0-rc.x`, whose adapter has
no such bound, the plugin drops the oldest images from the outgoing request itself. Text is not part
of that budget.

## UI

![Settings: connection and plan quota](docs/ui-settings-quota.png)

![Settings: usage charts and per-model table](docs/ui-settings-usage.png)

The settings page has four parts: connection, quota bars, charts, per-model table. The 24h chart is
hourly requests. The 7d chart switches between requests and tokens, because requests are the series
every plan returns. The sidebar footer shows both quota windows. UI copy is Chinese.

## Configuration

Entry config is the `ollama-cloud` settings section; override it in the profile patch:

```yaml
- id: ollama-cloud
  config:
    provider: ollama-cloud        # llm-pi-ai route name
    displayName: Ollama Cloud
    apiKeyRef: OLLAMA_API_KEY     # credential reference, never the secret
    baseURL: https://ollama.com
    syncOnStart: true             # pull the catalog on boot
    includeNonToolModels: false   # keep tool-less models out of the picker
    webTools: true                # register ollama_web_search / ollama_web_fetch
    maxOutputChars: 20000         # per ollama_web_fetch result
    usageCacheSeconds: 120        # /api/balance + /api/usage cache
    maxRequestImageBytes: 6291456 # base64 image budget per request; 0 = adapter default
```

## Command and routes

`/ollama-cloud [status|sync|usage]`, defaulting to `usage`:

```
Ollama Cloud 用量：
  会话（5h） ▕█░░░░░░░░░▏ 已用 7.2% · 3 小时后重置
  每周（7d） ▕█░░░░░░░░░▏ 已用 6.4% · 18 小时后重置
  5h 统计：267 次请求 · 输入 8.9k · 输出 127
  7d 统计：1.2k 次请求 · 输入 8.9k · 输出 127
```

The settings page and the sidebar use these routes over the same origin; scripts can too.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/_dsh/ollama-cloud/status` | key configured?, route, model count, last sync |
| `GET` | `/_dsh/ollama-cloud/usage[?force=1]` | balance windows, usage, token totals |
| `POST` | `/_dsh/ollama-cloud/key` | `{ "key": "…" }` stores and syncs, `{ "remove": true }` deletes |
| `POST` | `/_dsh/ollama-cloud/sync` | re-pull the catalog |

`/key` and `/sync` write. They take the app's own page only (same origin, or an opaque `file://`
origin) and a loopback or IP-literal `Host`; everything else gets 403.

## Runtime compatibility

| Runtime | Settings seam | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `0.1.0-rc.x` | `ctx.settings.register` / `get` | the plugin owns the `ollama-cloud` section; the adapter's section is read with `get('llm-pi-ai')` |
| `0.2.x` (desktop) | `describe` / `mutate` | the entry config is the section; the adapter's entry is read with `describe()` and written with `mutate()` |

`engines.dsh` accepts `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <1.0.0`, so both runtimes load the bundle. Tested on
`0.1.0-rc.6` (CLI) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (the desktop app's bundled runtime). CSS tokens carry literal
fallbacks, so the older runtime renders the same layout with plainer colors.

## Known limits

There is no way to cap output from here. pi-ai's compatibility probe sends `max_completion_tokens`,
which Ollama ignores (it honors `max_tokens`), and `dsh-llm-pi-ai` exposes no switch for that field.

The local meter only sees traffic from this harness home. Another machine or another client will not
appear in the token totals, and hourly buckets can put a window edge off by up to an hour.

When the catalog changes, the sync replaces `llm-pi-ai.providers.ollama-cloud` whole, so any hand
edits to that route are lost. `syncOnStart: false` makes syncing a manual step.

`webTools` and `includeNonToolModels` are read when the tools register, so changing them needs a
restart. Client-side changes also need one.

The usage endpoint allows 10 requests per minute per user. One refresh is three calls, which is why
the result is cached and the sidebar polls every five minutes.

## Development

```sh
node test/smoke.mjs   # catalog mapping, thinking levels, usage math, meter, route guards
```

No build step. The host half is plain ESM; the client half is written in the loader's factory form
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`).

To run the web profile on the desktop app's bundled runtime:

```sh
APP="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness"
CLI="$APP/../Resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js"
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME=/tmp/probe "$APP" --expose-internals "$CLI" --profile web --port 8130 --no-open
```

License: MIT.

plugins.description: Claude-Desktop-style Projects sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: group conversations into projects, per-conversation working directories, drag-and-drop migration, permanent empty-conversation cleanup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-projects

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@wxysskd/dsh-projects.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxysskd/dsh-projects) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Claude-Desktop-style **Projects** for **DSH Desktop** (the `desktop` DSH profile
only — Web and headless profiles are untouched).

The shipped DSH sidebar groups conversations by Workspace (directory). This
plugin replaces that sidebar region with a project-first browser:

- create **projects** (name, color, one or more working directories);
- every conversation lives inside a project;
- **each conversation can use a different directory**, chosen when it is
  created (or switched later through *Change working directory*), backed by the
  Host's real `workingDirectory` service — the same durable, model-visible
  mechanism as the `working_directory` tool;
- sessions outside any project stay visible under **Other conversations**,
  still grouped by Workspace, so nothing is lost;
- **empty conversations are hidden and can be deleted for real**: the Host keeps
  reusable blank Sessions from every "New Session" click (`blank: true`); only
  the empty Session that is currently open is shown. The Host also scans legacy
  Sessions whose catalog row is not marked blank but whose log contains no
  conversation events at all (only tiny header/metadata logs are inspected), so
  old "Badstuff"-style empty chats are hidden too. *View options → Delete empty
  conversations (N)* permanently removes both kinds from disk through a
  validated Host route (never touches a conversation with content; sessions
  still live in the current app run are archived and can be purged after the
  next start);
- **projects keep the workspace hierarchy**: inside a project, conversations
  stay grouped under their workspace (folder + title + count), so moving a
  workspace into a project preserves its identity instead of flattening the
  chats; workspace headers have their own `+` (new conversation directly in
  that directory — assigned to the containing project, or ungrouped under
  *Other conversations*) and `⋯` menu (new conversation, move to another
  project, rename, remove from project, delete workspace);
- pinned sessions, relative times, running/pending/unread status dots,
  archive/unarchive, rename, fork, pin and copy-ID work from the new rows.

## Install (desktop profile)

The plugin ships as a normal DSH bundle and is published on npm as
**[`@wxysskd/dsh-projects`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxysskd/dsh-projects)**.
Three equivalent ways to install it into the **desktop** profile
(`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`):

```bash
# 1. from npm (registry install; also works from Plugins -> Add plugin)
plugin_manager install_bundle target=@wxysskd/dsh-projects@1.0.0
#   or: desktop-cli plugin --profile desktop add @wxysskd/dsh-projects@1.0.0

# 2. from the self-contained release tarball
npm run pack                                  # -> dist/wxysskd-dsh-projects-1.0.0.tgz
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/abs/path/dist/wxysskd-dsh-projects-1.0.0.tgz

# 3. source link for development (client.js edits hot-reload)
desktop-cli plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD"
```

The npm package contains only runtime files (`index.js`, `client.js`,
`cordis.patch.yml`, `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg`, `package.json`, `README.md`,
`LICENSE`), plus `SHA-256`/manifest in `dist/`. See
[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md) for installation, the market index,
activation/verification and rollback details.

## Plugin market (Discover tab)

DSH has no official built-in market; the Discover tab reads index sources the
user adds. This repository publishes a format-1 index with a commit-pinned Git
install target:

```
https://aobakaolengmian.github.io/dsh-projects/market/index.json
```

Add that URL as an index source in **Plugins → Discover** and install
**Projects** from the card; the same index is readable by the `plugin_market`
tool and by any other DSH Desktop user:

![Projects in the Discover tab](docs/preview-market.png)

The market entry installs the published npm package
(`@wxysskd/dsh-projects@<version>`), the same artifact as the tarball. See
[market/README.md](market/README.md) for the format and how to regenerate it
(`npm run market`). Installing from the market still needs one app restart for
the Host row.

## Data

Project metadata is Host-owned and durable, independent of session logs:

- `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-projects.json` — projects, session→project
  assignments, last recorded working directory per session;
- sessions themselves stay owned by the Session Controller (nothing is
  rewritten into session logs by this plugin).

HTTP routes served from the existing DSH web server (same origin as the GUI):

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/state` | complete project state |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/health` | liveness + counts |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/mutate` | `project.create`, `project.update`, `project.delete`, `session.assign` |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/cwd` | change one conversation's working directory |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/purge` | permanently remove validated empty sessions (rejects content) |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/empty-sessions` | list sessions that hold no conversation content |

POST routes require `content-type: application/json` and `x-dsh-projects: 1`
and a 64 KiB body limit.

## Build

```
npm install          # dev-only: esbuild, react, react-dom, playwright
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/client/* -> client.js (committed artifact)
npm run pack             # build + dist/<name>-<version>.tgz + SHA-256 + manifest
node harness/build.mjs   # mock harness bundle
node harness/shoot.mjs   # screenshots -> harness/shots/
npm test                 # host/model tests (node --test)
```

## Design notes

- The browser entry registers into the shipped `sidebar.workspaces` single slot
  at `priority: -1`, shadowing `ui-workspace`'s browser. The shipped entry stays
  registered underneath: if our component crashes, its entry is abdicated and
  the original sidebar comes back.
- The client bundle imports only `react` / `react-dom` / `react/jsx-runtime`
  from the shell's shared module table and uses `ctx` services for everything
  else (`sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `locale`, `slots`).
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens; literals are limited to project accent
  artwork. All classes are prefixed `pj-`.

## Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

Everything can be migrated without deleting or recreating sessions, through the
project metadata only (session logs are never touched):

- **Drag a conversation row** onto any project section → the session is assigned
  to that project (drag it onto *Other conversations* to remove it from its
  project).
- **Drag a workspace group header** (under *Other conversations*) onto any
  project section → the directory moves into that project (removed from any
  other project's directory list, never duplicated) and every conversation in
  that directory is assigned to it. While dragging, every project shows a
  dashed drop outline and the hovered target is highlighted.
- **Menu path** (same result without dragging):
  - workspace group `⋯` → *Move workspace to project* → pick the target;
  - project `⋯` → *Move working directory to another project…* → pick the
    directory → pick the target project (or *Remove from project (back to Other
    conversations)*);
  - conversation `⋯` → *Move to project* → pick the target (or *No project*).

Moving a directory between projects also makes future sessions created in that
directory (including the shipped Cmd+N flow) land in the target project, and the
project keeps the workspace title as a nested folder group.

Workspace headers (both inside projects and under *Other conversations*) expose
their own menu: **Rename workspace…**, **Move workspace to project**, **Remove
from project** and **Delete workspace**. Deleting a workspace removes only its
registration, puts its conversations back under *Other conversations*, and never
deletes a conversation.

## Compatibility with other sidebar plugins

The installed sidebar-touching pl

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏工作区文件树右键，一键把文件/文件夹以原生 @引用 chip 插入输入框｜Right-click a file-tree row to insert a native @ reference chip into the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-reference

**右键**一键引用：把侧栏「工作区文件」树里的文件/文件夹、或消息里**已交付的文件卡片**，以原生 `@路径` 引用 chip 插进当前会话输入框。

DeepSeek Harness 里想引用一个文件，只能手打 `@` 再一层层找；而侧栏文件树只有**左键**一个手势（点文件=打开预览、点目录=展开），交付文件卡片也没有引用入口。本插件补上**右键**这一步，走的是宿主自己的引用通道，不自造协议。

## 效果

在右侧栏「工作区文件」面板里**右键**任意文件或文件夹行，或者在消息里**右键已交付的文件卡片**（例如收尾回复下方的 `combo_index.html` 卡片）：

| 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **引用到会话** | 把该条目以 `@路径` chip 插入当前会话输入框——与把文件拖进输入框**同一条宿主通道**，插入的是真正的引用 chip，发送时宿主按文件引用解析 |
| **复制引用文本** | 把 `@路径` 文本写入剪贴板 |

- 路径自动折算成相对当前会话工作区的相对路径；含空格的路径自动加引号（`@"my dir/readme.md"`）；目录尾随 `/`。
- 插入成功自动聚焦输入框；会话未挂载、正在发送或输入框拒绝插入时**给出提示**，不静默失败。
- 命中不到路径时**不拦截右键**，浏览器的默认行为照常。
- 菜单样式全取宿主主题令牌，亮暗主题跟随；点击别处、Esc、滚动、窗口失焦自动关闭。
- 中英双语，跟随宿主语言。

## 安装

> **发布状态**：本插件目前只在 GitHub 发布，**尚未发布到 npm**。下面标注「npm 未发布」的写法暂不可用，等发布后再用。

### 方式一 · 插件页添加（桌面版用户，推荐）

DSH 桌面版：打开侧边栏**插件**页 → **添加插件** → 粘贴下面一行 → 装完点**启用** → 按提示重启或刷新。

```
https://github.com/dyhdesu/dsh-file-reference
```

### 方式二 · 命令行（web / headless profile）

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dyhdesu/dsh-file-reference
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，浏览器硬刷新。

npm 发布后可直接用包名安装（**当前 npm 未发布，此条暂不可用**）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-reference
```

### 方式三 · 本地目录接线（开发用）

`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，官方 CLI 会拒绝直接写入（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。自己开发时走手动接线：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
```

在该目录的 `package.json` 里，`dependencies` 增加一条指向本目录的 `file:` 依赖，并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-file-reference"`；然后在同目录执行安装并重启桌面版。

```
pnpm install
```

改完源码后同步安装副本，client 半区刷新页面即生效：

```
rsync -a --delete src/ ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-file-reference/src/
```

## 原理

- 两个右键表面都由一个纯逻辑函数 `contextTarget()` 判定，命中才拦截：
  - **侧栏文件树行**：官方文件树（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files`）的行节点带 `data-files-entry="file|directory"` 与 `data-files-path="绝对路径"`，树根带 `data-files-root`；官方树本身没有任何右键处理，这块手势是空的。
  - **交付文件卡片**：官方交付卡片（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables`）是 `div[data-presented-file]`，其中**只作标记、不带路径**；绝对路径在卡片内**首个带 `title` 的节点**（预览按钮，官方 `resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, file.path)`）上。该 `title` 是非 i18n 的，但属于官方**内部实现**而非公开契约——因此插件按**文档顺序**取第一个非空 `title`，取不到就完全不拦截右键。卡片位于正文中，归属即当前会话，无需树根纠偏。
- 插入走宿主 `conversation` 服务的 `input.shell(sessionId).addFiles([reference], [])`，即 `SessionInputShell.addFiles`——官方给引用 chip 留的程序化入口（内部走 `draftEditor.insertFileReferences`）；chip 形态 `{source:'reference', ref, label, appearance, clipboardText}` 与官方 `@` 菜单、拖文件进输入框**完全一致**，不是自造协议。
- 当前会话由 `uiSession.current.value.key` 提供；多会话时按文件树根路径与会话 `cwd` 比对纠偏，避免把引用插进别的会话。
- 与官方 `@` 引用语义对齐：引用只携带**路径**，不读取也不附带文件内容（官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference` 明文规定「选中候选绝不读取或附带文件内容」），模型要看内容必须自己调文件系统工具。
- **纯前端插件**：host 半区为空操作（`export function apply() {}`），不碰宿主源码、不注册路由、不改配置，装卸无残留；HMR 重评估时先拆上一代句柄（监听器、菜单、代际槽）。

## 兼容性

- 在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**（macOS 桌面版）上开发与验证。
- **Windows**：路径处理对齐官方文件树的混合分隔符契约（官方 `childPath` 以 `/` 拼接、宿主解析混合分隔符），盘符与 UNC 形态按大小写不敏感比对，POSIX 形态仍严格区分大小写。盘符、反斜杠与混合分隔符、盘符大小写差异、UNC 四种形态均有单元测试覆盖；**尚未在 Windows 实机验收**。
- 依赖官方文件树的行属性契约（`data-files-entry` / `data-files-path` / `data-files-root`）、交付卡片的 `data-presented-file` 标记与其预览按钮的 `title`、以及 `SessionInputShell.addFiles`。官方若改动这三处，插件需要跟进；已做降级：服务缺失、结构不匹配或取不到路径时既不抛异常，也不拦截右键。
- 输入框中的引用 chip 形态与官方 `@` 菜单、拖拽入文件一致，因此引用在草稿恢复、跨工作区切换等场景下与官方行为一致。

## 已知局限

- 一次只处理单行：暂不支持多选批量引用。
- 右键覆盖侧栏文件树行与**交付文件卡片**两处；消息里已渲染的 `@` 引用 chip、改动文件卡片的行、收尾正文的行内文件链接暂不在范围内。
- 交付卡片依赖官方 `title` 这个内部实现细节；官方改版后可能失效（表现为右键不再弹菜单，不影响其它功能）。
- 目录引用只插入 `@目录/`，不展开目录内容（官方 `@` 菜单的 Tab 下钻能力未复刻）。
- 引用 chip 插入需要会话已挂载且输入框可编辑；发送中会被宿主拒绝并提示。

## 开发与测试

```sh
npm test
```

45 项用例覆盖：路径归一化与 `@` 语法（含空格引号、目录尾斜杠、控制字符拒绝）、**Windows 形态**（盘符、反斜杠与混合分隔符、盘符大小写差异、UNC、根前缀兄弟目录不误判）、chip 载荷构造、会话归属判定、**右键命中判定**（树行/交付卡片/树外与无 title 不拦截）、菜单生命周期与拆卸、服务全缺时的降级，以及 `src/client.js` 内联逻辑段与 `src/logic.mjs` 的**逐字同源校验**（防止两侧逻辑漂移）。

## 许可

MIT © 2026 dyhdesu

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard plugin: task progress, downloads/extraction, training, tests, local+SSH GPU monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dashboard

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 侧边栏插件：在左侧新增「项目看板」，把任务进度、下载/解压、模型训练、测试结果和 GPU 状态集中到一个紧凑面板。

## 功能

- **紧凑单面板**：顶部任务进度卡 + 任务 / 下载 / 训练 / 测试 / 传输五个页签，列表在面板内滚动。
- **任务进度**：读取工作区任务计划，结合服务器产物与运行中的进程推断每项任务的状态、进度和下一步（转换、校验、训练、评测进程会自动识别）。
- **下载与解压**：本地下载目录与远端 raw 目录；归档显示已解压体积/文件数，解压中显示百分比和当前第几个压缩包。
- **模型训练**：最近的训练产物；GPU 支持**本机 + 多台远端**（`remoteAliases`），每个来源一组，显示利用率、显存、温度、功耗、风扇、频率、驱动、占用进程，以及该机器的 CPU / 内存 / load；每张卡带一条最近约 30 个采样的利用率迷你趋势线。
- **测试信息**：pytest 历史（每个 run 目录取最新一份日志）、评测指标和结果目录。
- **传输**：新增「传输」页签，显示 dsh-ssh 文件传输的**方向（↑ 上传 / ↓ 下载）、阶段（接收/发送）、已传输字节、速率、已用时间**和最近完成记录，并可一键清空已完成；同时聚合服务器上的 `scp` / `rsync` / `sftp` 进程并解析其方向。传输页签每 2 秒单独轮询，不拖慢主快照。
- **点击查看详情**：点击任意条目打开右侧详情抽屉——测试显示 pytest 日志末尾，训练显示产物列表/指标/日志末尾，下载显示大小与解压明细，传输显示方向/阶段/速率/路径；详情里的路径可一键复制，行尾的复制图标仍可直接复制完整路径。
- 支持来源筛选（全部/本地/服务器）和名称/路径搜索；当前页签与来源会记住；服务端不可用时不影响本地数据。

远程数据通过 `dsh-ssh` 的 loopback exec 路由只读采集，不复制或存储 SSH 凭据；未安装 `dsh-ssh` 时插件仍可只展示本地工作区。

## 安装

1. 克隆仓库；
2. 在 DSH 插件管理页安装本目录，或使用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 指向克隆目录的绝对路径；
3. 首次安装后重启 DSH。之后修改文件可以在插件管理页把 bundle 关一次再开，触发热重载，无需重启。

可选依赖：已安装并配置主机别名的 `dsh-ssh`（用于远程数据与 GPU）。

## 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里配置：

```yaml
config:
  localRoot: '/path/to/workspace'   # 要扫描的本地工作区
  remoteAlias: 'my-ssh-host'        # 主 dsh-ssh 主机别名；留空则只扫描本地
  remoteAliases:                    # 可选：额外的 GPU/主机监控目标（同样经 dsh-ssh）
    - 'gpu-host-2'
  remoteRoots:
    downloadRoot: '/data/downloads'
    trainingRoot: '/data/runs'
    logRoot: '/data/logs'
  refreshSeconds: 20                # 快照缓存时间
```

`remoteAlias` 同时是项目数据（下载/训练/测试/任务）的主机来源；`remoteAliases` 里的额外主机只聚合 GPU 与主机资源。可选键：`showLocal`、`showRemote`（布尔）。

仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 只保留空配置；本机实际使用的路径、SSH 别名等建议写在 **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`** 覆盖层（同 id 覆盖），这样仓库里不会出现个人路径。

## 接口

- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/state`：当前快照（过期则重建）
- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/transfers`：轻量传输状态（2 秒轮询，不触发 SSH 扫描）
- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/detail?source=local|remote&path=...&kind=...`：条目详情（本地读文件末尾/目录；远端经 dsh-ssh 读取）
- `POST /api/dino-dashboard/refresh`：强制重建

两个接口都只接受 loopback 请求，且只返回只读状态信息。

## 开发

```
package.json         # bundle patch + dsh.client（platform web）
cordis.patch.yml     # Host 行与配置
index.js             # Host：本地扫描、远程探测、路由
client.js            # Client：侧边栏入口与看板页面
locale/{zh,en}.json  # 插件管理页标题/描述
icon.svg             # 图标
```

安装后修改文件，重新安装或对 bundle 做一次「关→开」即可热重载。

plugins.description: DSH 回收站插件：把工作区会话拖进回收站，保留 14 天后自动删除，可随时恢复或立即删除。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-recycle-bin（回收站）

把工作区里的会话移入回收站，保留 14 天后自动永久删除；也可以随时恢复或立即删除。

## 安装（给其他人）

仓库地址：<https://github.com/EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin>

要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（本插件在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上开发和验证；用到的是 `sidebar.panellist`、`main`、`sidebar.session.row.hover`、`shell.overlay` 四个槽位和 `webServer` 路由，老版本可能没有这些槽位）。

**方式一：直接按 GitHub 地址安装**（Harness 支持 pnpm 的 `github:` 规格）

在 Harness 里调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 填：

```
github:EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin
```

安装完成后条目为 `include:dsh-recycle-bin`，侧边栏底部会出现回收站图标。若没出现，按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新页面；仍未出现就把它禁用再启用一次。

**方式二：先克隆，再从本地目录安装**（想改代码或锁定版本时用）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/EnhydraLutristus/dsh-recycle-bin.git
```

然后 `install_bundle` 的 target 填克隆目录的**绝对路径**（例如 `D:\plugins\dsh-recycle-bin`）。本地安装是链接（`link:`），改完代码禁用/启用一次即可生效。

**更新**

```bash
git pull            # 本地目录安装时
```

或重新执行一次 `install_bundle`（GitHub 规格）；更新后在插件管理器里禁用再启用。

## 界面在哪里

侧边栏底部、Settings 之上的图标区（`sidebar.panellist`）多了一个回收站图标，排在其它面板图标之后。点击它，主区域会切换到回收站面板。

## 怎么把会话放进回收站

有三种方式：

1. **拖拽**：把侧边栏工作区里的会话行拖到回收站图标上——现在整个侧边栏条目（图标 + 文字区域）都是投放目标，不要求精准对准图标。
2. **大投放区**：一开始拖动会话，屏幕底部中央会浮出一个 236×52 的「松手移入回收站」提示块（`shell.overlay` 图层，盖在所有列之上），把会话拖进去松手即可；松手后提示块自动消失。放在底部中央而不是左下角，是为了不挡住侧边栏最后几行会话——否则想把会话拖到列表末尾时会误落进回收站。
3. **拖进面板**：回收站面板打开时，把会话拖进面板空白处。
4. **悬停按钮**：鼠标悬停在某个会话行上，浮层里点「移入回收站」。

放入时底层会调用官方的 `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession`，所以会话会先从工作区列表里消失（和官方「归档」一致），再进入回收站。**当前正在跑回合的会话会被拒绝**（提示「该会话正在运行，请先停止它再移入回收站」），不会打断正在进行的任务；**已经打开、但没在跑回合的会话**才会自动停掉界面占用后归档。

失败不会再只闪一下红灯：底部投放块会把原因显示 6 秒，同时写一行到 `<DSH_HOME>/recycle-bin/host.log`；跨站校验失败会记成 `guard-reject`，带完整请求头，便于排查。

## 回收站里能做什么

- **恢复**：把会话取消归档，重新回到原来的工作区。
- **立即删除**：需要点两次（第二次是「确认永久删除」，5 秒内有效）。
- **清空回收站**：同样需要二次确认。
- **自动删除**：每小时扫描一次，超过 14 天的条目会被永久删除；应用启动 5 秒后也会扫一次，补上关机期间到期的条目。

## 删除到底删了什么

DSH 目前没有「删除会话」的 Host API（`sessionPersistence` 只有 create/open/flush/stat/list，`sessionController` 与 `workspaceRegistry` 都没有删除会话的方法），所以这里的「永久删除」是文件级删除：

1. 如果该会话还在跑回合，直接拒绝并提示「该会话正在运行，请先停止它再删除」，不会取消、也不会打断任务；
2. 用 `sessionPersistence.open(id, 'write')` 抢占写句柄（重试 3 次、每次间隔 200ms）。**抢不到不再报错**：应用打开过的会话（启动时默认打开的那个、刚新建的对话、界面里还开着的归档行）会一直占着写句柄，直到页面关闭或应用重启——以前这就是「不重启就删不掉」的原因。现在抢不到就降级为直接删文件，并在 `recycle-bin/host.log` 里记一行 `force-delete`；
3. 删除 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<工作区桶>/<sessionId>/`（会话日志，可能是 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），删完再检查目录确实消失，否则整次删除判为失败、条目留在回收站；
4. 删除 `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json`（预览缓存）；
5. 把该会话从所有工作区的 `sessionIds` 里 detach；抢占成功时再从归档集合里移除，抢占失败（会话仍活在内存里）时**保留归档标记**，这样重启前它也不会以「未分组」的空壳重新冒出来；
6. 发出 `api-session/removed` 事件，界面立刻把这一行从工作区列表（含「未分组」）里移掉，不会留下空壳。

## 状态文件

`<DSH_HOME>/recycle-bin/state.json`，记录每个被移入会话的 id、标题、所属工作区、移入时间。删除该文件等于清空回收站记录（不会恢复已删除的会话）。

## 已知限制

- **没有官方删除接口**：删除是文件级操作，属于绕过 API 的做法，未来 Host 若给会话加锁/改存储格式，需要同步调整 `lib/index.js` 的 `purgeFiles`。
- **搜索索引**：`session-query-sqlite` 的索引不在删除范围内，历史搜索命中可能仍指向已删除会话，点开时可能提示会话不存在。
- **正在运行的会话不能移动、也不能删除**：会提示先停止，不会打断任务。等回合结束后再操作。
- **打开的会话可以直接删除**：启动时默认打开的那个会话、刚新建还没重启过的对话，都能立即删除——写句柄被占用不再阻止删除，改删文件。代价是内存里仍留着它的对象，直到应用重启；因为保留了归档标记，它不会重新出现在列表里。
- **不可撤销**：删除就是真的删除，没有第三方工具无法恢复。
- **回收站里的会话仍归档在工作区**：这是有意的（不出现在会话列表），恢复时自动取消归档。
- **拖拽是否生效取决于会话行实际写入 `dataTransfer` 的负载**：插件会依次尝试 UUID、纯 id、JSON 里的 `sessionId`；优先采信 UUID 和非 `text/plain` 的私有类型，避免把会话标题误当 id。识别不到时不会报错，也不会误删。识别不到就退回用悬停按钮。
- **底部投放块只在拖动会话时出现**：拖动文本或系统文件（`Files` 类型）不会弹出，也不会被拦截。

## 排查：重启后侧边栏图标消失

`package.json` 的 `exports` 必须包含 `"./package.json": "./package.json"`。客户端模块扫描会在冷启动时通过包的导出表解析清单文件；缺这一条时，Host 半照常加载（路由可用、删除照常工作），但客户端半会被**静默跳过**，表现就是“重启后图标不见了、界面里没有任何入口”。这类“热装能用、重启就没”的现象，先查导出表。

同一条冷启动链路上还有第二个陷阱：`dsh.client.immediately`。声明了它，这个客户端半就被编进「首屏批次」，而首屏批次是在应用自己的静态清单里算好的——用户后装的插件挤不进去，于是静默丢失，只有开关一次插件（走重新扫描）才会出现。对照两个能稳定冷启动的第三方插件（`dshmarket`、`dsh-context`）都没有声明它，所以本插件也移除了这项声明，改为普通按需批次加载。

## 安装与验证

已通过 `plugin_manager` 安装为 profile bundle，Loader 条目为 `include:dsh-recycle-bin`。

- 重新启用：`plugin_manager` `set_plugin`，target `include:dsh-recycle-bin`。
- Host 逻辑自测：`node test/harness.mjs`（在临时 `DSH_HOME` 里跑真实的 route handler，覆盖 list/trash/restore/delete/sweep/鉴权与错误路径）。
- 客户端结构自测：`node test/client-smoke.mjs`（用假 `window.__ModuleLoader__` / React 执行 `lib/client.js`，断言模块契约与 4 个槽位注册）。
- 线上自检：`GET http://127.0.0.1:<当前 GUI 端口>/dsh-recycle-bin/list`，带请求头 `x-dsh-recycle-bin: 1`，应返回 `{"ok":true,"retentionDays":14,"items":[...]}`；不带该头会返回 403（路由挂在鉴权之前，这个头用来挡跨站伪造请求）。GUI 端口每次启动可能不同，以运行时上下文里的 URL 为准。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the agent eyes: capture a screen, measure drift, and check written expectations against the image with an embedding score.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-olhos

Eyes for an agent inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
capture a URL or a local HTML file, measure how much the screen drifted, and test
written expectations against the image in the same 768-dimensional embedding space.

Every verdict comes with its score. "The screen is fine" without a number is the
sentence this plugin exists to prevent.

One plugin line, two surfaces:

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `olhos_verificar` tool | for each expectation: cosine score, confirmed or not, the capture path, and (opt-in) drift against the last reference |
| you, in the chat | `/olhos ...` | capture and compare, keep a good reference, or find an old capture by meaning |

## Install

```sh
npm install -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-olhos
```

Restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot. Then check the loaded line:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 olhos
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: olhos
  name: dsh-olhos
  config:
    capturas: temporarios/olhos
    limiar: 0.7344
    navegador: casa
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends `dsh-olhos`
to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. That line is the only
activation.

Update: re-run the add command and restart. Uninstall:
`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-olhos`, then restart.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH`; the harness uses it to manage profile plugins.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, for example `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- **Python 3** on `PATH`, with **`websocket-client`** for the capture script:
  `python3 -m pip install websocket-client`.
- **Chrome or Chromium** listening on CDP. The default (`navegador: casa`)
  attaches to `http://127.0.0.1:9222`, so start the browser with
  `--remote-debugging-port=9222`. With `navegador: proprio` the plugin launches
  its own disposable headless browser (`OLHOS_CHROME`, default `google-chrome`)
  instead.
- **An EmbeddingGemma engine checkout**, which produces the scores. Point
  `OLHOS_GEMMA_RAIZ` at it (default `~/workspaces/tools/embeddinggemma`). The
  directory must contain `venv/bin/python`, `src/embeddinggemma.py`,
  `src/vetores.py`, and the model cache under `modelos/`. Its own install script
  builds the CPU environment (torch, sentence-transformers) and downloads the
  1.5 GB model.

The plugin does **not** bundle the embedding engine. Without that checkout a
capture still works, but no score can be produced, and `olhos_verificar` fails
with a message naming `OLHOS_GEMMA_RAIZ`.

The shell scripts (`.sh`) and Python companions run on Linux and macOS. On
Windows, use WSL or Git Bash with Python 3 available.

## Usage

Ask the agent to check something visible. It calls the tool with a target and one
expectation per line:

```text
Use olhos_verificar on http://127.0.0.1:3080/ with the expectations
"the panel shows three session cards" and "the error message is visible".
```

The tool answers with a score per expectation and a verdict:

```text
limiar 0.7344
| expectation                         | score  | verdict   |
| the panel shows three session cards | 0.7225 | not found |
| the error message is visible        | 0.6254 | not found |
0/2 confirmed. Lowest score 0.6254. Capture: temporarios/olhos/.../20261013-163453.png
```

The threshold is strict: a score must be **greater than** the threshold to
confirm. Scores below it are reported as not found, which is the deliberate
precision-over-recall bias described under [Limits](#limits).

In the chat:

```sh
/olhos http://127.0.0.1:3080/                       # capture and drift against the last reference
/olhos http://127.0.0.1:3080/ "three cards" "error"  # also test these expectations
/olhos marcar http://127.0.0.1:3080/                # capture now and store it as the good reference
/olhos ultima http://127.0.0.1:3080/                # drift only, no new capture
/olhos achar "login screen with an error"           # find an old capture by meaning
/olhos ajuda
```

Expectations should be short, concrete and visible. "The panel shows three
session cards" works; "the layout is nice" does not.

A threshold passed to the tool (`limiar`) is stored for that target in
`limiar.json` and used on the following calls.

## Configuration

Every path is configurable and the defaults derive from your home directory, so
nothing is tied to a specific machine. Override by environment variable or by the
config of the `olhos` line in your profile patch. A patch replaces the whole
config of the line, so restate every key you want to keep.

| Config key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `capturas` | `temporarios/olhos` inside the package | where captures, references and per-target `limiar.json` live. A relative path resolves inside the package; use an absolute path to keep captures across plugin updates |
| `limiar` | `0.7344` | cosine threshold for written expectations. Calibrated, not portable |
| `navegador` | `casa` | `casa` attaches to Chrome on CDP 9222; `proprio` launches a disposable headless browser |

| Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `OLHOS_GEMMA_RAIZ` | `~/workspaces/tools/embeddinggemma` | engine checkout used by `olhos.py` |
| `OLHOS_CDP` | `http://127.0.0.1:9222` | CDP endpoint |
| `OLHOS_CHROME` | `google-chrome` | browser binary for `navegador: proprio` |
| `OLHOS_PERFIL` | `<package>/temporarios/<date>-olhos/chrome-perfil` | profile directory for the disposable browser |
| `OLHOS_LIMIAR` | `0.7344` | default when the engine scripts are called directly |
| `OLHOS_LARGURA`, `OLHOS_ALTURA` | `1440`, `900` | capture viewport |

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: olhos
  config:
    capturas: '/home/you/.dsh/olhos'
    limiar: 0.7344
    navegador: casa
```

## Verification

From a clone of the repository:

```sh
node --test tests/
scripts/olhos.sh selftest
```

`node --test` needs only Node.js: 20 tests covering the tool and command
registration, the bundle contract, the strict threshold decision and the
per-target key.

`scripts/olhos.sh selftest` needs the engine virtualenv installed (not the model
weights) and checks the threshold math without loading the model.

To verify the install, check the `--dump-config` output above and ask the agent
to run `olhos_verificar` against a page that is open in your browser.

## Measured results

The default threshold and the warnings below come from a calibration run on this
plugin: 20 written expectations, 22 captures, 440 labeled pairs, EmbeddingGemma,
768 dimensions.

| Measure | Result |
|---|---|
| expectations, all pairs | **390/440 = 88.6%** agreement at `0.7344` |
| calibration split (12 expectations) | 224/264 = 84.9%, 0 false positives, 40 false negatives |
| validation split (8 expectations) | 166/176 = 94.3%, 0 false positives, 10 false negatives |
| whole-screen drift, 10 meaningful changes | **1/10 caught** |
| whole-screen drift, 3 deliberate breakages | **1/3 caught** |
| whole-screen drift, 10 cosmetic changes | 1/10 flagged |
| pixel-difference baseline, same set | 10/10 and 3/3 caught, but 7/10 cosmetics flagged |

The threshold is the highest negative score (`max(negativos)`): no false
expectation passes it, which is why false positives are zero. The price is false
negatives: true statements whose score falls below the threshold are reported as
not found. In a live verification on the calibration page, the panel really had the
three cards and scored `0.7225`, below `0.7344`.

The drift margin on that set is negative: the two groups overlap. A whole-screen
cosine flagged a header path change and missed the three cards disappearing.
That is why drift is opt-in and never a verdict on its own.

## Limits

- **The threshold is calibrated, not portable.** It belongs to the
  EmbeddingGemma space and to a calibration set. Do not reuse a threshold
  measured for another model: the cosine range is different. Calibrate with
  `scripts/olhos.sh calibrar --positivos <file
