中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 性能 Benchmark | 指标 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 热查询延迟 | ~2000ms | ~1500ms | ~800ms | **~10ms** | | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 缓存 | 无 | 页面缓存 | 页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite）** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 架构 ### 主流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[用户查询] --> B[语言检测] B --> C[引擎分诊] C --> D[并行搜索] D --> E[结果聚合] E --> F[可信度评分] F --> G[JSON 输出] H[双层缓存] -.-> D I[预算控制] -.-> C ``` ### 引擎分诊流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[用户查询] --> B{语言检测} B -->|中文| C[中文引擎组] B -->|英文| D[英文引擎组] B -->|日韩| E[日韩引擎组] B -->|其他| F[通用引擎组] C --> G{领域判断} D --> G E --> G F --> G G -->|学术| H[学术引擎] G -->|代码| I[代码引擎] G -->|购物| J[购物引擎] G -->|金融| K[金融引擎] G -->|新闻| L[新闻引擎] G -->|通用| M[网页引擎] H --> N[并行搜索] I --> N J --> N K --> N L --> N M --> N ``` ### 缓存机制 ```mermaid graph LR A[查询请求] --> B{内存缓存} B -->|命中| C[直接返回] B -->|未命中| D{SQLite 缓存} D -->|命中| E[返回并更新内存] D -->|未命中| F[执行搜索] F --> G[结果写入 SQLite] G --> H[结果写入内存] H --> I[返回结果] ``` ### 可信度评分流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[搜索结果] --> B[Selection 评分] A --> C[Absorption 评分] A --> D[Freshness 评分] A --> E[共识评分] B --> F[综合可信度] C --> F D --> F E --> F F --> G{阈值判断} G -->|高于阈值| H[保留] G -->|低于阈值| I[丢弃] H --> J[JSON 输出] ``` ### 预算控制流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[搜索请求] --> B{预算检查} B -->|预算充足| C[免费引擎优先] B -->|预算紧张| D[仅免费引擎] B -->|预算耗尽| E[返回缓存] C --> F{免费引擎有结果?} D --> F F -->|有| G[返回结果] F -->|无| H{有 Key?} H -->|有| I[付费引擎搜索] H -->|无| J[返回空结果] I --> G ``` ### 整体架构 ```mermaid graph TB subgraph 用户层 A[Agent / 用户] end subgraph 接入层 B[CLI] C[MCP Server] D[Python SDK] end subgraph 核心层 E[语言检测] F[引擎分诊] G[并行搜索] H[结果聚合] I[可信度评分] end subgraph 数据层 J[内存缓存] K[SQLite 缓存] L[265+ 搜索引擎] end subgraph 控制层 M[预算控制] N[多语言支持] end A --> B A --> C A --> D B --> E C --> E D --> E E --> F F --> G G --> H H --> I J -.-> G K -.-> G L --> G M -.-> F N -.-> E I --> A ``` > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查

plugins.description: Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-annotations

[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.1.7--rc.2-4D6BFE)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: select any text in the conversation,
write a note about it, and let the whole batch ride along with your next message
— for that one round only.

This repository carries the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic, which the DeepSeek Harness documentation requires of plugin repositories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that requirement.

## What it does

1. **Select → annotate.** Select text anywhere in the conversation (a reply, a
   tool card, your own message), and a floating **注释** button appears beside the
   selection. Click it, type the note, press **Enter**. Shift+Enter breaks the
   line, Escape cancels.
2. **Collect several.** Every saved note becomes a numbered marker at the left
   edge of the passage it is about — **hovering a marker shows that note** — and a
   **N 条注释** strip appears above the composer. Click the strip to open the
   pending batch, where each annotation shows its quoted passage and note with
   edit and delete actions. Clicking a marker opens that note's editor, with a
   delete button.
3. **Send together.** Your message gains one short **“💬 N 条注释”** bubble; the
   annotation text never appears in the conversation. **Hover that bubble** to see
   exactly which passages the batch quoted and what each note says. The list
   reaches the model as a system-prompt section, so the request still carries
   every quoted passage and note. The batch is consumed once and its markers stay
   in the transcript, dimmed.
4. **Send alone.** With an empty composer, the strip's send button starts a round
   from the annotations alone.

## How it works

The browser half owns the editing UI; the Host half owns delivery.

- The browser posts the complete batch to `/api/dsh-context-annotations`
  (a route registered through `ctx.connection.fetch`, behind the carrier's trust
  fence). It never writes into the draft.
- The Host keeps that batch per Session and listens on the `agent/pre-step`
  waterfall. `pre-step` hands over exactly the messages the step claimed — never
  replayed history — so a batch can only ride one round. When the step carries a
  `source.kind === "user"` message, the Host appends one extra message that holds
  only the marker (`💬 N 条注释`) and leaves the human message byte-for-byte
  unchanged.
- The annotation text does not travel in a message: `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`
  contributes it to the prompt, and the rendered prompt is logged as a hidden
  `system/message` node. The conversation therefore shows one short bubble while
  the request carries the full list; both are reconstructable from the log, and
  no plugin event type is invented.
- The marker message is written before the step records its messages, so it is
  part of an ordinary `user/message` record, and the prompt is likewise
  reconstructable from the log. By design, fork, resume and replay should
  reproduce the conversation the model saw; no plugin event type is invented.
- An empty composer cannot submit on its own, so the strip's send button writes a
  zero-width draft; that round is one empty human message plus the marker.
- The batch outlives only the turn it rode: `pre-step` marks it consumed (the
  browser then clears the strip) and that turn's `turn/end` retires it from the
  prompt, so a later round never inherits it. A batch that no round consumed is
  left pending instead — a note written while the model is still answering waits
  for your next message rather than vanishing with that turn.
- After a send the browser reconciles with one cheap request: the Host states
  `consumed` explicitly, which marks the local annotations sent (the strip
  collapses and the markers stay, dimmed). The same request adopts a still-pending
  batch after a page reload.

## What the conversation shows vs what the model receives

The conversation gains exactly one short message:

```
💬 2 条注释
```

The model receives the list as a system-prompt section:

```
1. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>

2. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>
```

## Files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: batch store, `/api/dsh-context-annotations`, `agent/pre-step` fold |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: selection button, note editor, numbered markers, composer strip and panel |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Insert the plugin row into the profile |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Dependency-free test of the fold semantics and the browser bundle's registration |
| `test/client.mjs` | Regression test for the browser store: per-Session push, explicit consumption, editor identity, composer exclusion |

## Configuration

The bundle currently reads no configuration. The folded list carries no marker
line, so it reads as the user's own numbered notes rather than a plugin block.

## Install

Installed from this repository:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target="github:YubaiLoving/dsh-context-annotations"
```

Or from a local checkout of this directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  (target: this directory)
```

## Limits

- Markers key on character offsets into the flattened conversation text and are
  validated against the recorded passage; when that offset no longer matches (the
  content above the passage changed), a whitespace-insensitive passage search
  takes over, disambiguated by the passage's occurrence ordinal. There is no DOM
  path fallback. A passage that is re-rendered with different wording loses its
  marker; the note itself stays in the strip and is still sent. Markers that
  would land on the same box are nudged upwards so they do not stack.
- Annotations live in Host memory per Session. A Host restart drops a pending
  batch (the browser adopts only what the Host still holds).
- The float, strip, and panel read documented `data-*` markers of the shipped
  conversation shell (`[data-conversation-content]`, `[data-composer-seat]`,
  `[data-composer-card]`) and the browser's own selection. No other plugin's DOM
  is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ZCode: a per-workspace Markdown memory directory injected into every main session, refreshed by background extraction after completed turns.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-memory — 工作区记忆（移植 ZCode）

把 ZCode 的 **Project / Workspace Memory** 移植到 DeepSeek Harness：每个工作区一份持久 Markdown
记忆，主会话开始时自动进入模型上下文，每轮成功对话后由后台提取补充；另有一个只读页面浏览记忆。

- 上游依据：ZCode `apps/zcode-cli/docs/design/v2/memory/README.md`（Memory 设计 v4）+
  `packages/core/src/memory/*`、`packages/core/src/context/sections/memory.ts`。
- 本插件是 **Host + Client** 两半，纯 JS、无构建步骤；`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装好，
  也可用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 从本地目录装。

## 它做什么

1. **持久记忆目录**：每个工作区 `<workspaceRoot>/.dsh/memory/`，内含 `MEMORY.md` 索引与
   「一事实一文件」的 `<fact-name>.md`（YAML frontmatter + Markdown 正文）。
2. **会话开始注入**：主会话创建/恢复时，把 ZCode 同源的 `# Memory` 使用规则 + 当前
   `MEMORY.md` 索引注入 system prompt（每个 Agent 只读一次，会话中途不重读）。
3. **模型自己写**：你对助手说「记住…」，它按规则用现有 `write` / `edit` 工具把事实写进记忆目录，
   并同步 `MEMORY.md` 指针行（`- [Title](fact.md) — hook`）。
4. **后台自动提取**：每轮**成功**对话后（回复已经产出、不阻塞），后台发一个一次性模型请求，
   从本轮对话里挑出值得长期记住的事实，写成事实文件并维护索引。
5. **只读浏览**：左栏「工作区记忆」图标 → 整页列出所有有记忆的工作区与文件，查看原文（等宽原文，
   不渲染 Markdown）。

## 生效范围

| 维度 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 开关粒度 | `enabled` 是**插件级（profile 级）**配置；开启后该 profile 下所有工作区的主会话都生效（与 ZCode 的全局开关一致） |
| 内容隔离 | **按工作区隔离**：记忆根 = 会话不可变的 `session.header.cwd`；工作区之间互不可见，同一工作区的多个会话共享一份 |
| 落盘时机 | **惰性**：只有真的开过主会话的工作区才会 best-effort 创建 `.dsh/memory/` |
| 子 Agent | **不生效**：`session.header.origin === 'subagent'`（subagent / workflow child / 队友）不注入、不提取 |
| read-only 会话 | 半生效：规则段照常注入，但**不建目录、不提取**；模型写记忆按沙箱正常被拒（无绕过） |
| 计划模式 | 记忆写入沿用宿主工具策略，会被拦（与 ZCode 有意不同，见下） |
| 其它 profile | 不装不生效；安装是 profile 级动作 |

## 数据布局

```text
<workspaceRoot>/.dsh/memory/
  MEMORY.md              # 索引；无 frontmatter；一行一条 `- [Title](fact-name.md) — hook`
  <fact-name>.md         # 一事实一文件
```

事实文件格式（与 ZCode 一致）：

```markdown
---
name: concise-memory-name
description: one-line recall description
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: user | feedback | project | reference
  originSessionId: sess_…
---
One durable fact.
```

- `type`：`user`（用户角色/背景/偏好）、`feedback`（协作方式的确认或纠正，正文带 `**Why:**` /
  `**How to apply:**`）、`project`（代码里推不出的项目原因/约束/决策）、`reference`（外部资源指针）。
- `name` 为小写 kebab-case（1–48 字符），正文可用 `[[other-name]]` 关联其它事实。
- `metadata.node_type` 与 `originSessionId` 由插件维护（新建时填当前会话，更新时保留原值）；
  其余约束与 ZCode 一样是提示词级约束，不做写后 schema 校验。
- 建议把记忆目录加进 `.gitignore`（插件自身绝不改 `.gitignore` 或其它仓库文件）：

  ```bash
  echo '.dsh/memory' >> .gitignore
  ```

## 配置（插件设置页 / cordis.patch.yml）

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关：注入规则与索引、创建记忆目录、后台提取、页面数据 |
| `autoExtract` | `true` | 每轮成功对话后自动提取长期记忆（会产生额外模型请求与 token 成本） |
| `maxIndexChars` | `25000` | 注入的 `MEMORY.md` 块字符上限（另有 200 行上限） |
| `debugLog` | `false` | 追加更细的诊断（索引读取、跳过原因、写盘细节）到 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` |

> 宿主日志 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` 里，**每轮结束都会有一行提取结论**
> （`extraction done …` / `extraction skipped … (原因)` / `extraction request failed …`），
> 因为后台提取是一次真实计费请求、不会进入会话日志；`debugLog` 只增加更啰嗦的过程细节。

> 用量提示：开启 `autoExtract` 后，系统可能发起额外的模型请求来提取长期记忆，从而增加 Token
> 用量与使用成本。关掉它仍然可以手动让助手「记住…」。

## 后台提取（autoExtract）细节

- **触发**：`turn/end` 且 `reason.kind === 'completed'`；每个 Agent 单槽排队（正在跑时只保留最新一次）。
- **跳过规则**（ZCode 同款）：本轮里模型自己写过记忆（写工具参数命中记忆根）→ 跳过；
  本轮没有「独立文本块且词数 ≥ 3」的用户发言 → 跳过。中文按 CJK 字符折半计词
  （否则纯中文发言的词数永远算 1，自动提取再也不会触发）。
- **模型请求**：复用会话当前路由（`session.requestContext()` → 请求头 → Agent 选项 → 默认模型），
  `maxTokens = 1200`，只喂本轮的 user/assistant 文本（尾部截断 24,000 字符）与现有记忆清单；
  要求回复固定 JSON（`{"memories":[…],"forget":[…]}`），失败/非法 JSON/非 `stop` 结束 → 整轮放弃，不重试、不部分写入。
- **写入**：每轮最多 5 条事实；沿用会话自己的沙箱策略写入本工作区，`forget` 删除文件并移除指针。
- 关闭宿主/会话结束时中断在飞的提取，丢弃迟到结果。

## 与 ZCode 的差异（有意为之）

| 项 | ZCode | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 存储根 | CLI 私有存储 `memories/projects/<key>/memory/`（仓库外） | 工作区内 `<cwd>/.dsh/memory/` —— DSH 沙箱默认 workspace-write，工作区外写会被拒；放工作区内可全程不绕过沙箱、模型用原生工具维护 |
| 写入方式 | 模型用 Write/Edit 写；提取是受限的 5 轮 Memory Agent（Read/Grep/Glob/只读 Bash/记忆目录内 Write/Edit） | 模型用 `write`/`edit`；提取是一次性 JSON 请求 + Host 写盘（DSH 不允许插件注册新工具策略/追加事件类型） |
| 注入位置 | system 段（规则）+ 首条 user message（索引） | 单个 per-agent system section（规则 + 索引），语义等价、KV 前缀更稳 |
| 索引刷新 | 每会话初始化读一次 | 同（中途不重读；提取的新记忆下个会话可见） |
| Plan 模式 | 允许写记忆 | 沿用宿主工具策略（会被拦） |
| 提取资格 | 「独立文本块 ≥ 3 个空白分隔词」 | 同样阈值，但 CJK 字符折半计词（中文发言才能合格） |
| 语义召回 / Dream | 代码保留但当前产品链路不启用 | 不做（与上游当前行为一致） |
| custom-agent 记忆 / 全局 kill switch 分层 / `-p` headless 门控 | 有 | 不做 |

## 安装 / 更新 / 卸载

从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:moondrop12138/dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
```

本地开发目录安装：`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，target 为本目录绝对路径。

- 更新：**Client 半改动刷新页面即可；Host 半改动必须 `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` 重装。**
- 卸载：`remove_bundle`（或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-workspace-memory`），
  左栏图标与页面随之消失（监听/定时器都由 `ctx.effect` 接管）。

## 测试

```bash
cd dsh-zcode-workspace-memory && node --test
```

覆盖：路径与文件名安全、索引 frontmatter/注释剥离与双上限截断、指针 upsert/remove、
事实文件生成与 frontmatter 解析、origin 保留、提取资格判定（direct-write / 词数）、
转录尾部截断、提取提示词、JSON 解析（围栏/前后废话/字符串内花括号/非法条目整轮放弃/5 条上限）、
路由回退顺序。

## 验收实测（2026-10-18，本机 Desktop profile）

| 验收项 | 结果 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| A1 安装 | ✅ | `install_bundle` → `application: applied`、`warnings: []`；`Config.listConfigs` 返回 `enabled/autoExtract/maxIndexChars/debugLog` 四个 `x-cordis.volatile` 字段与默认值 |
| A2 会话注入 | ✅（活会话） | 安装后同一个正在运行的会话，最新 `system/message` 含 `# Memory`，且带绝对记忆根 `<workspace>\.dsh\memory/`；`.dsh/memory/` 已被创建 |
| A2' 插件热生效 | ✅ | 删除记忆目录后 `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle`，目录被重新创建，宿主日志无 `systemPrompt is unavailable`（`systemPrompt` 已声明为硬依赖） |
| A4' 提取落盘（宿主侧） | ✅ | Lead 独立 E2E（`scripts/verify-host-e2e.mjs`）：14/14 通过 —— 事实文件 + `originSessionId` + `MEMORY.md` 指针、请求带 route/system/1200 maxTokens、direct-write 跳过、read-only 不建目录不提取、subagent 不注入不提取 |
| A5 read-only | ✅ | 同上（不建目录、不提取、仍注入规则段） |
| A6 子 Agent | ✅ | 同上（无 `# Memory`、不提取） |
| A7 UI 注册 | ✅（live 槽位） | `Slots.listSubTree('sidebar.panellist')` 出现 `workspace-memory`（order 30，active）；`main` 出现 key `workspace-memory` |
| A8 单元测试 | ✅ | `node --test` 37/37 通过 |
| A4 触发与判定（live） | ✅ | 宿主日志每个 `turn/end` 一行结论：本会话 3 个完成的 turn 都在判定范围内；定时提醒那轮判为 `extraction skipped … (no-user-prose)`——正确，因为提醒消息的 `source.kind` 是 `schedule` 而不是 `user`（会话日志实测 `userMessageSources = {user:2, runtime-context:1, skill-catalog:1, time-context:5, agent-message:5, subagent-settled:5, schedule:2}`） |
| A4' 真实模型提取 | ⏳ | 尚未发生：装好之后的所有 turn 的用户发言要么是 `schedule` 来源、要么在 journaling 之前结束。**发一句真实中文（≥3 字单位，如「记住：这个项目用 tabs」）**即可触发，届时日志出现 `extraction done … memories=N` |
| A3 记忆协议落盘（live） | ✅（协议） | 按协议写入示例事实 `workspace-memory-port.md` + `MEMORY.md`，用插件自己的纯函数回读校验：文件名被接受、frontmatter 解析出 `type: project` 与 `originSessionId`、`buildManifest` 正常、下一会话的注入块含该指针行 |
| A3' 模型自主写入 | ⏳ | 提示词与文件协议已就绪并已注入；是否照做取决于模型，需一次真实「记住…」指令才能作为证据 |
| 设置表单可见性 | ⏳（待目视） | schema 已确认；请在「插件」页确认 Configure 表单 |

复现命令：

```bash
cd dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
node --test                        # 37 项纯函数/集成用例
node scripts/verify-host-e2e.mjs   # 14 项宿主侧端到端断言
node scripts/inspect-session.mjs <session.v4.jsonl.zstd>   # 检查某会话最新 system 段是否含 # Memory
node scripts/verify-memory-dir.mjs "<工作区绝对路径>"        # 用插件自己的纯函数校验记忆目录与注入块
```

## 已知限制

- **提取请求不可回放**：DSH 不允许插件追加新的事件类型，提取的请求/响应不会写进会话日志；
  只有 `%TEMP%\workspace-memory-host.log` 里的每轮结论行（成功了什么、为什么跳过、是否失败）。
- **中途不刷新索引**：会话中途模型或提取写入的新记忆，要到下一个会话才进入上下文（ZCode 同语义）。
- **索引指针可能悬空**：记忆文件被外部删除/改名后，插件不做修复器（与 ZCode 一致）；页面会显示实际存在的文件。
- **记忆可见性**：`.dsh/memory/` 在仓库里，是否提交由你决定。
- **UI 是只读的**：页面不提供编辑/删除；开关在插件设置里，记忆内容由模型或提取写入。

## 许可证与上游

- **本仓库第一方代码：MIT**（见 `LICENSE`）。
- 记忆的提示词文本（`memoryRulesText` / `buildExtractionPrompt`）与记忆设计移植自
  **ZCode**（[zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode)，Apache-2.0，Copyright 2026 Z.AI Co., Ltd）：
  改了什么、没移植什么、哪些是重写而非照抄，见 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md)；该许可的副本是
  [`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`](LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt)。

## 结构

```text
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client{platform:web, immediately, inject:[…]}
cordis.patch.yml    # insert: id: workspace-memory, name: dsh-workspace-memory
INTERFACES.md       # 冻结的跨半契约（RPC 信封/端点/数据形状/座位/config 语义）
lib/memory-core.js  # 纯函数：路径、索引、指针、事实文件、提取提示与解析、路由（零依赖）
lib/host.js         # Host 半：Config、system section、会话监听、后台提取、ctx.fs 写盘、RPC
lib/client.js       # Client 半：左栏图标 + 整页（纯浏览器 JS，只 require('react')）
locale/{zh,en}.json # 插件管理页元数据
icon.svg            # 原创图标
test/               # node --test 用例
```

plugins.description: 给 DSH 小鲸鱼挂件加一层装饭喂鱼：装饭 → 每轮吃 → 报账 → 讨饭
plugins.readme_text:
# 白饭预言家 · dsh-whale-ricebowl

给 **DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件**（`dsh-whale-widget`）加一层「装饭喂鱼」的独立附加插件。

> **先给大肥鱼装饭（1 碗 = 100 万 token），每轮对话按真实消耗吃掉米饭；吃完它会自己讨饭。**

不改挂件本体、不做饱食度养成、不自动装饭。**没装宿主挂件时本插件不显示任何东西。**

![装好 3 碗饭的鲸鱼](docs/screenshot-idle.png)

吃饭动作特写（鲸鱼立绘 = 宿主默认角色图）：咧嘴笑 + 一颗小虎牙，木勺舀饭 → 饭团飞进嘴 → 合嘴咀嚼：

![吃饭动作特写](docs/screenshot-eat.png)

| 装饭菜单 | 每轮报账 |
| --- | --- |
| ![装饭菜单](docs/screenshot-menu.png) | ![每轮报账](docs/screenshot-report.png) |

| 没饭了会讨饭 | 饿久了会「饿坏了」 | 设置里的「本对话饭账」 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![讨饭](docs/screenshot-beg.png) | ![饿坏了](docs/screenshot-starving.png) | ![饭账](docs/screenshot-settings.png) |

> 截图为本地 `npm run demo` 预览，鲸鱼立绘直接取自宿主插件 `dsh-whale-widget` 的默认角色图（仅用于演示，本包不打包任何上游素材）。真实使用时叠加在「小鲸鱼记账挂件」旁。

---

## 它是什么 / 不是什么

| | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主 | 「DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件」`dsh-whale-widget`（右下角余额鲸鱼）。本插件是它的附加层，不是替代品。 |
| 玩法 | 每个对话有自己的一锅饭：点碗装小碗（20 万 token）/ 半碗（50 万）/ 一碗（100 万）；每轮对话按真实 token 消耗吃米饭；每轮结束气泡报账「这轮吃了多少 · 还剩多少」；没饭了先讨饭 10 次，再等 10 分钟会变成「饿坏了」（不喂就一直灰着，补饭才恢复）。 |
| 画面 | 透明玻璃碗装着**一整块煮熟的米饭**（米粒只是表面纹理）；主碗 + 最多 4 个碗位显示总库存（最多 5 碗，超过继续记账、UI 不变；装饭菜单：小碗 20 万 token = 1/5 碗、半碗 50 万 = 0.5 碗、一碗 100 万）。吃饭时鲸鱼**咧嘴（一颗小虎牙）**、木勺舀饭、饭团飞进嘴里、嚼两下，配更可爱的舀饭 / 碰碗 / 咀嚼音效（WebAudio 现场合成）。 |
| 记录 | 每个对话（DSH session）独立记账：已装 / 已吃 / 剩余；切换对话各吃各的；刷新页面保留。 |
| 不是 | 不是饱食度养成、不做等级/记忆、不自动估算、不读对话内容、不联网上传。 |

和已有的同类插件 `dsh-whale-food-expack`（喂饭 + 饱食度养成）相比：它做「养宠物」，本插件做「装饭—吃饭—报账—讨饭」。**两者都会在鲸鱼旁摆碗，建议只装一个**；同时装了会检测并提示。

## 依赖与安装

**前置**：DSH 0.2.x（在 0.2.0-rc.2 实测）与「DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件」`dsh-whale-widget@^0.4.2`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-whale-widget
```

### 从 GitHub 安装（当前推荐，npm 还没发）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LuChen0820/dsh-whale-ricebowl
```

### 从 npm 安装（发布后）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-whale-ricebowl
```

### 从本地目录安装（开发版）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-whale-ricebowl
```

### 官方桌面端（Electron）

桌面端的 index.html 由安装包静态直出，`tapIndex` 不生效；本插件已额外注册 `webserver/index-inject` 结构化注入行。装法与鲸鱼挂件一致：在桌面端会话里让 DSH 自己装，或使用桌面端自带的 `dsh` 命令安装到 `desktop` profile。**宿主改动要完全重启桌面应用；只改样式/动画（`assets/`）刷新页面即可。**

## 使用

1. **装饭**：点饭碗 → 装小碗（20 万 token）/ 半碗（50 万）/ 一碗（100 万）。对话开始前也可以先装：这时饭先存在「待装饭」里，第一轮对话开始时自动倒进这个对话的锅。
2. **每轮**：DSH `turn/start` 后鲸鱼开始干活；真实 token 到账时它张嘴吃饭，米饭一点点变少。
3. **每轮结束**：`turn/end` 后气泡报账，例如「这轮吃了 5.4K · 剩 3 碗」；短回合也会补演至少一口再报账。
4. **多碗**：1 碗 = 100 万 token；主碗 + 最多 4 个碗位 = 最多显示 5 碗（碗位和主碗**放在同一条桌面水平线上**，排在主碗**左侧**、向左延伸；打开装饭菜单时会自动隐藏）；超过 5 碗继续记账但 UI 不变；下方标签显示剩余碗数。
5. **讨饭 → 饿坏了**：剩 0 时自动讨饭——先讨饭 **10 次**（立绘上浮 / 歪头、张嘴「啊——」、气泡间隔出现 / 消失，文案随机且不连续两次相同）；之后安静等 **10 分钟**，自然过渡成「**饿坏了**」：立绘发灰耷拉、慢悠悠地晃，标签变成「饿坏了…」，气泡也变得有气无力；随时点碗加饭，喂饭就立刻恢复正常。**只要不喂，它就一直是灰的**：跑回合、点界面、刷新页面都不会自己恢复（0.5.8 起，「饿坏了」会按对话存下来）。
6. **设置**：右键饭碗 → 开关「没饭时讨饭 / 吃饭动作（嘴 / 嚼）/ 吃饭音效 / 米粒特效 / 数字标签」，查看「本对话饭账」（已装 / 已吃 / 剩），或「清空饭账」。
7. **刷新 / 重启**：饭账存在浏览器 localStorage；资源都是 `no-store`，改样式刷新页面即可。

> 嘴的位置按宿主默认立绘 `DSniang1.png` 标定好（`mouth.x=0.555 / y=0.735`、嘴宽 ≈ 立绘宽的 8%），嘴型是咧嘴笑 + 一颗小虎牙（柔粉口腔 + 深蓝细描边），开箱即用、不需要手动校准。换自定义立绘时若嘴对不上，改 `assets/config.json` 的 `mouth.x / mouth.y / mouth.size`（相对立绘宽高的 0~1 与嘴宽比例），或关掉「吃饭动作」。

## 吃饭动作与「动画一致」

v0.5.0 把吃饭动画改成了**串行咀嚼队列**：

* **同一时刻只有一口**：张嘴 → 木勺舀饭 → 饭团飞 0.2s → 到嘴边再咬合 → 收尾；下一口等这一口演完才排队。
* **每口和米饭严格同步**：一口吃掉一份，主碗米面按口数离散下降，不会出现「碗在滑、鲸鱼没嚼」。
* **每轮必演**：短回合（1 秒轮询来不及看到增量的那种）也会在回合结束后补演，漏掉的口快速补齐后才出报账气泡。
* **轮询自适应**：干活中 500ms、空闲 1600ms；页面隐藏时暂停，回来补演。
* **口数**：大约每 1800 token 一口，单轮最多 6 口（`assets/config.json` 的 `biteTokens`）。

## 计费口径

* 实际 = 本轮 `assistant/message` 事件里 `usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens` 的累计值。
* `inputTokens` 是**非缓存输入**（Anthropic 口径），`outputTokens` 已包含 reasoning；不把 `cacheReadTokens` 算进去，和常见「每轮消耗」口径一致。
* 需要改口径：`lib/state.js` 顶部的 `COUNT_CACHE_READ`。
* 实际值由宿主半端从 DSH 会话事件折叠，浏览器轮询 `/dsh-whale-rice/turn.json`；饭账只存在浏览器本地。

## 配置

| 文件 | 改什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `assets/config.json` | `tokensPerBowl`（1 碗 = 多少 token，默认 100 万）、`maxBowls`（最多显示几碗，默认 5）、`feedOptions`（装饭菜单档位：小碗 20 万 / 半碗 50 万 / 一碗 100 万）、`biteTokens`（每口 token 粒度）、`begTimes`（讨饭次数，默认 10）、`starveDelayMs`（讨饭完到「饿坏了」的等待，默认 10 分钟）、`starveIntervalMs`（饿坏了之后的气泡间隔）、轮询 / 报账时长、嘴部锚点 `mouth` |
| `assets/lines.json` | 台词池（讨饭 / 装饭 / 首次引导） |
| `lib/state.js` | 计费口径 `COUNT_CACHE_READ` |

例：想让每轮肉眼更容易看到米饭减少，把 `tokensPerBowl` 从 `1000000` 改成 `100000`（10 万 token 一碗），5 万 token 的长轮就能吃掉半碗。

改完刷新页面即可；宿主半端改动需要重启 DSH。

## 隐私

* 只订阅 DSH 的会话状态事件（turn、assistant usage、工具调用），**不读对话内容**。
* 饭账、设置都只存在你自己的浏览器 `localStorage`（键前缀 `dshwr-`）。
* 不向任何服务器发送数据；`/dsh-whale-rice/*` 是 DSH 本机 web server 上的只读路由。

## 兼容性与已知限制

* 实测：DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` + `dsh-whale-widget@0.4.2`；Web 端已在真实 DSH 页面验证（插件注入、宿主锚点、饭碗挂载、无 console 报错）。桌面端走同一套 `webserver/index-inject` 结构化注入通道（与宿主插件同款）。
* **默认 1 碗 = 100 万 token，普通一轮 5K token 只占 0.5%**，碗面变化很小，主要靠标签和每轮报账看数字；想让变化更直观就把 `tokensPerBowl` 调小。
* 叠加层只依赖宿主公开 DOM 锚点（`window.__dshWhaleRoot` / `.dshwv-root` / `.dshwv-img`）。**上游改 DOM 可能导致错位**：本插件找不到锚点时会静默隐藏并输出 console 提示，不会白屏；`docs/tech-notes.md` 记了锚点清单。
* **吃饭动作的嘴部叠加层按默认立绘 `DSniang1.png` 标定**（默认 `mouth.x=0.555 / y=0.735`、宽 ≈ 立绘宽 8%，落在双眼中间偏下）；换自定义角色图会错位，改 `assets/config.json` 里的 `mouth` 即可，或关掉「吃饭动作」。宿主既没有嘴、也不暴露嘴部锚点，本插件只是把一张小嘴叠在立绘上，不修改、不替换宿主图片。
* 文档截图里的鲸鱼立绘来自宿主插件 `dsh-whale-widget`（`DSniang1.png`），仅用于演示本插件的挂载效果；本包不打包任何宿主美术素材。
* 多会话并行时跟随「最近有事件的会话」，每个对话各自一口锅，不做多会话聚合。
* 刷新页面：饭账从 `localStorage` 恢复；跨对话不串。

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm test          # node --test：21 条测试（事件折叠 / 资产路由 / 注入契约 / 配置与玩法契约）
npm run demo      # 本地预览：http://127.0.0.1:19480/（模拟宿主 DOM，左侧按钮模拟装饭/每轮消耗）
```

demo 页面左侧按钮：装小碗 / 装半碗 / 装一碗、开始一轮、吃 2.6K、吃 5.4K、结束本轮、一键跑完一轮、**试听音效（舀饭 / 碰碗 / 咀嚼 / 讨饭）**、空碗讨饭演示、清空饭账。

目录：

```text
lib/index.js      宿主：事件折叠、turn.json、资源路由、web/桌面注入
lib/state.js      纯函数：usage 口径、事件折叠、快照（单测覆盖）
assets/client.js  浏览器：找宿主锚点、饭碗/米面/多碗、串行吃饭、报账、讨饭、本地饭账
assets/client.css 叠加层样式（dshwr- 前缀，不碰宿主 dshwv-）
assets/config.json / lines.json 可调配置与台词
demo/             本地预览服务与页面
test/             node:test 测试
docs/             技术细节、v0.5.0 设计草案与截图
```

## 发布清单（npm + GitHub + dshbase）

* GitHub 仓库：<https://github.com/LuChen0820/dsh-whale-ricebowl>（topic `dsh-plugin`）；`package.json` 已补 `repository` / `homepage` / `bugs` / `author`。
* npm 包名 `dsh-whale-ricebowl` 已确认未被占用；发布 `npm publish --access public`（`files` 白名单不含 demo/ 与测试）。
* GitHub：新建仓库 + topic `dsh-plugin` + Release `v0.5.0`；仓库根有 `LICENSE` / `NOTICE.md` / `CHANGELOG.md`；`dsh.bundle` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`。
* dshbase / DSH 插件市场：npm 发布后按收录模板提交，分类选「UI & Skins」，注明依赖宿主插件 `dsh-whale-widget`；插件市场按 `dsh-plugin` topic 发现。
* 发版前：`npm test` 全绿 + `npm pack --dry-run` 清单核对 + 干净 profile 用 tarball 安装验证 + Web/桌面各手动跑一遍「装饭 → 吃 → 报账 → 讨饭 → 加饭」。

## 许可与致谢

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

* 宿主挂件「DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件」由 [@MeteorNOX](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget) 开发（MIT），本插件与作者无隶属关系，不含其任何代码或素材。
* 工程思路（宿主折叠 + 注入 + 前缀路由 + 桌面结构化注入行）参考了 [dsh-whale-food-expack](https://github.com/Mynaniao/dsh-whale-food-expack)（MIT）与鲸鱼挂件本身的实现，特此致谢；本插件没有复制其代码或台词。
* 非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

plugins.description: Registers the github-push skill, so every DSH session follows one fixed GitHub commit, push and release procedure.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-flow

把「提交 → 推送 → 校验 → 发 Release」固化成**所有会话共用**的 DSH skill：`github-push`。

> Registers the `github-push` skill (plus its script) into the global skill layer, so every DeepSeek Harness session follows one fixed GitHub procedure instead of ad-hoc commands.

## 它解决什么

推 GitHub 每次都会踩同样的坑：网络时通时断、代理是死的、凭据没缓存、推完没校验、tag 指错提交。这个插件把这些判断写成一份 skill，任何会话说「推到 GitHub」都会加载它，按同一套步骤执行。

## 装了什么

| 内容 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `github-push` skill | 全局层注册，所有会话可见，`catalog` 实时刷新 |
| `scripts/gh-push.ps1` | 一键执行：探测网络 → 提交 → 推送（带重试）→ 校验 sha → 打 tag → 发 Release |

## 安装

```text
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本仓库绝对路径>
```

插件行 id：`github-flow`。

## 用法

任何会话里说「推到 GitHub」，模型会加载 `github-push` 并执行：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "<本仓库>\scripts\gh-push.ps1" `
  -RepoPath "<repo path>" `
  -Message "feat: ..." `
  -Tag "v1.2.3" `
  -ReleaseName "v1.2.3 - ..."
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `-RepoPath` | 仓库路径，默认当前目录 |
| `-Message` | 有未提交改动时必填 |
| `-Tag` | 可选，推送后在 HEAD 上打 tag |
| `-ReleaseName` | 可选，配合 `-Tag` 创建/更新 GitHub Release |
| `-DryRun` | 只探测与打印，不提交、不推送 |

## 流程要点

1. **推完必须校验** `remote refs/heads/<branch> == local HEAD`；
2. **不猜网络**：直连与 `127.0.0.1:7890` 交替失效时，先探测再选路；
3. **凭据不落库**：token 只从 Git Credential Manager 取，不写进仓库、不回显。

## 依赖

- Windows PowerShell 5.1+（脚本保持纯 ASCII，避免无 BOM UTF-8 被按 ANSI 解析）
- `git`、`curl.exe`（Windows 10+ 自带）
- DSH 的 `skills` 服务（Host 内置）

## License

MIT © 2026 extremity2740938284-create

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live DeepSeek API peak/off-peak tariff state and spend tracking, for the agent, the chat, a sidebar chip and Settings (Windows, Linux, macOS).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pico-detector

DeepSeek sells its API at two rates: **PEAK** (full price) and **OFF-PEAK** (half
price). This plugin tells you which one is in effect right now, and how much the
API has cost you, inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

One plugin line, four surfaces:

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `pico_status` and `deepseek_spend` tools | the state now and the next transition, so it can decide to defer heavy work; the spend of the window |
| you, in the chat | `/pico` and `/gasto` commands | the same texts, read-only |
| you, in the GUI | chip in the sidebar footer | colored dot with the rate in effect, short label, countdown inside the approach window, spend of the window |
| you, in the GUI | **Settings → Pico Detector** | spend breakdown, FX rate, currency and window, next transitions, policy in effect |

**Peak rules are always evaluated in Beijing time** (the official rule). Times are
shown in **your** zone, taken from your machine; pin another zone with
`displayTimezone` (see [Configuration](#configuration)).

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — the harness manages profile plugins with it.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.

## Install

Works the same on **Linux, macOS and Windows**. Open a terminal (PowerShell is
fine on Windows) and run:

```sh
# 1. pnpm (needed by `dsh plugin`)
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-pico-detector

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-pico-detector`.

After the restart: the chip is at the bottom of the sidebar, the tools and the
`/pico`, `/gasto` commands are live, and **Settings → Pico Detector** has the
currency and window switches.

### What the install does

`dsh plugin add` runs pnpm in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/` (on Windows,
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\`), so the spec can be a GitHub repo, a tarball,
a local path or a registry name. Because this package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`,
the harness then appends `dsh-pico-detector` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the
profile manifest — that line in the profile is the only activation, and it is
applied at every boot. Nothing else to configure.

The package has **no build step and no native dependencies**: plain ESM using only
Node built-ins (`node:zlib`, `node:fs`, `node:os`). Nothing to compile on any OS.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command above (it resolves the repo again), then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pico-detector   # uninstall, then restart
```

## Peak policy (official)

Source: [api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing),
checked on 2026-08-23 and again on 2026-09-10 (no rule change).

The official wording is in UTC: *"Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00
UTC, Monday through Friday (all other hours are off-peak)."* Converted to Beijing
time:

| Window | Beijing (UTC+8) |
|---|---|
| PEAK, morning (Mon–Fri) | 09:00 – 12:00 |
| PEAK, afternoon (Mon–Fri) | 14:00 – 18:00 |
| OFF-PEAK | every other hour |
| Weekend (Sat–Sun in Beijing) | all day OFF-PEAK |

The week boundary follows the **Beijing calendar**, which matters at the edges of
the day for anyone not in Beijing: the plugin computes it that way.

## States

The state names are DeepSeek's own (`peak` / `off-peak`). The UI labels are in
Portuguese.

| State | Label | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `off_peak` | `OFF-PEAK (metade do preço)` | green | OFF-PEAK active, half price |
| `peak` | `PEAK (preço cheio)` | red | PEAK active, full price |
| `approaching_peak` | `PEAK EM BREVE` | amber | PEAK starts within `approachMinutes` |
| `approaching_off_peak` | `OFF-PEAK EM BREVE` | amber | PEAK ends within `approachMinutes` |

The color always means **the rate in effect**, never the incoming one: green only
while OFF-PEAK is active, red only while PEAK is active. Amber is the current rate
changing within the approach window, and then the label says which way. Default
approach window: 30 minutes (`approachMinutes`).

## Where the money number comes from

The DeepSeek API has **no usage endpoint**: `GET /user/balance` exists, and balance
is not spend (it moves with top-ups, promo credits and any other client using the
same key). What the invoice uses is the published rule `tokens × price`, and the
tokens are recorded, per model step, with the instant and the model, in the
harness's durable session ledger:

```
~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd (v3 on older harnesses)
```

Each step is priced by **the model in that event** and by **the tariff in effect
at that event's instant** (not at query time, which would be wrong on every day
that crosses a window boundary), with the three buckets priced differently: input
without cache, cache read and output.

| Model | Input (1M) | Cache read (1M) | Output (1M) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-flash` | US$ 0.15 / 0.30 | US$ 0.003 / 0.006 | US$ 0.60 / 1.20 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | US$ 0.66 / 1.32 | US$ 0.022 / 0.044 | US$ 1.98 / 3.96 |

(off-peak / peak; off-peak is half price. Source:
[api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing),
checked 2026-10-07.)

**What the number does not cover, and the UI says so:** LLM calls outside the agent
loop (session titles, web search) record the request but not tokens, so the total
is a **floor**. A model missing from the price table is priced as Flash and
**flagged as such**. An unreadable session log is counted as an error and shown,
never summed as zero.

**Exchange rate:** a chain of keyless public sources (awesomeapi → frankfurter →
open.er-api), first one to answer wins and is named in the result; 30-minute cache.
If all fail, the last reading is shown marked stale with its age and the reason; if
there was never a reading, the total stays in USD instead of inventing a number.

**Refresh cadence:** the rate is checked every 10 s (pure computation) and the
spend every 60 s (incremental disk read; ~1.3 ms in the steady state).

## Configuration

Everything falls back to a sane default: a wrong config never breaks the detector.
Override by `id` in your profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). A
patch **replaces the whole config of the line**, so restate every key you want to
keep:

```yaml
- id: pico-detector
  config:
    policy:
      timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai'
      peakWindows: [['09:00', '12:00'], ['14:00', '18:00']]
      weekendOffpeak: true
    displayTimezone: 'Europe/Lisbon'        # omit to use your machine's zone
    approachMinutes: 30
    spend:
      interval: 'today'                     # today | 24h | 7d | 30d | month
      currency: 'BRL'                       # any ISO-4217 code
```

## Troubleshooting

- **`pnpm not found on PATH`** — `npm install -g pnpm`, then re-run the command.
- **Plugin installed but nothing appears** — restart the harness; the bundle layer
  is read at boot, not at install time.
- **Spend shows 0 while sessions exist** — the ledger lives under `$DSH_HOME`
  (default `~/.dsh`). If you moved it, set `DSH_HOME` or the `spend.home` config.
- **pnpm blocks a build script** — it does not for this package: there is no
  `prepare`/build script. (A git-hosted dependency with one would need an
  `allowBuilds` entry.)
- **Wrong time zone** — the default is your machine's zone; pin another with
  `displayTimezone` (see above).

## Verification

The package ships its own check suite. Run it on the installed copy, which has the
harness packages around it:

```sh
node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-pico-detector/lib/selfcheck.mjs
# on Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-pico-detector\lib\selfcheck.mjs
```

It covers the peak policy (windows, exact boundaries, weeke

plugins.description: Manage MCP servers and skills, and budget DeepSeek Harness context without a restart
plugins.readme_text:
# 上下文预算

管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，控制下一轮 prompt 的工具成本。

[English](README.en.md)

每个 MCP 工具都会带完整 JSON Schema 进入请求。服务器一多，schema 会比对话更占地方。

![工具 schema 数量示意](assets/readme-schema-v2.svg)

这个插件把配置和暴露分开。配置负责服务器和 Skill，暴露负责这一轮到底带哪些 schema。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:jidekaixin2dian/dsh-context-budget
```

桌面端由应用管理 profile 时，请在插件管理器里安装。安装或更新 host 半后，退出并重新打开 DSH；桌面端没有浏览器式 `Ctrl+R` 硬刷新。

## 使用

打开 **设置 -> 上下文预算**。

**上下文预算** 按 MCP 服务器分组，隐藏这一轮不需要的整组 schema，随时恢复。MCP 进程继续运行。全部显示、关闭全部 MCP、关闭最大组、精简模式都在这一页。

**MCP 服务器** 新增、编辑、删除、启停，写 profile 或 global 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，HMR 生效。stdio 用 command/args/env，streamable-http 用 url/headers。

**Skills** 搜索、新建、删除、单 Skill 启停。新建可写用户或项目目录，删除移到 `.trash`。

模型工具：

```text
context_budget action=status
context_budget action=session disabled=["mcp:github", "skills"]
context_budget action=reset
```

`mcp` 是全部 MCP 的通配，`mcp:<server>` 只针对一台服务器。设置页的全局预算作用于所有会话和子代理，`action=session` 只覆盖当前会话。

## 原理

预算部分在 `agent/pre-step` 里调用 `ctx.tools.restrict({ deny })`，工具 schema 在 prompt 组装前被移除。MCP 部分按行编辑 `cordis.patch.yml`，保留无关行和注释，由 HMR 应用。Skill 部分用 rank-0 override provider 把停用项设为 `modelInvocable:false`。

token 数按序列化 schema 和 Skill 描述估算，不是模型分词器的精确值。

## 边界

- 动态 MCP 管理器把工具注册在 agent 作用域时，`ctx.tools.restrict` 隐藏不了，请用对应管理器的 unload。
- MCP CRUD 会写 `cordis.patch.yml`；手工改过该文件时，保存前先看 diff。
- Skill 的 ZIP 或文件夹导入暂未实现；只在 scoped provider 出现的 Skill 可能无法隐藏。
- host 半和 client 半更新都需要重开 DSH。

## 开发

```sh
npm test
```

9 个单元测试覆盖分组规则、MCP 行编辑和 Skill 文件操作。

[GitHub](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-context-budget) · [Releases](https://github.com/jidekaixin2dian/dsh-context-budget/releases) · MIT

plugins.description: VSCode 式 SSH 远程资源管理器 · DSH 侧栏插件：双向拖拽传文件、就地编辑保存、右键新建/改名/删除、远端终端与 AI 对话
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-explorer

> VSCode 式的 **SSH 远程资源管理器**，作为 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 桌面版（Web GUI）的侧栏插件运行：
> 侧栏一个面板就能浏览远端文件、双击预览、就地编辑保存、**双向拖拽传文件**、右键新建/改名/删除，
> 再挂一个远端终端和 AI 对话。

**插件名**：`dsh-ssh-explorer`　**版本**：`1.7.0`　**许可证**：MIT　**零第三方依赖**

```
侧栏「SSH 远程资源管理器」 → 选连接 → 浏览远端目录 → 拖出去 = 下载 / 拖进来 = 上传
```

---

## 目录

- [特性](#特性)
- [环境要求](#环境要求)
- [安装](#安装)
- [快速上手](#快速上手)
- [使用手册](#使用手册)
- [它是怎么实现的](#它是怎么实现的)
- [HTTP API](#http-api)
- [配置文件与状态目录](#配置文件与状态目录)
- [跑测试](#跑测试)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [排错](#排错)
- [目录结构](#目录结构)
- [更新日志与许可](#更新日志与许可)

---

## 特性

| 分类 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| **连接** | 自动读取 Windows 的 `~/.ssh/config`（含 `HostName` / `User` / `Port` / `IdentityFile`）并导入；也能在面板里新建连接；`auto` / `key` / `password` / `agent` 四种认证方式 |
| **口令** | 每台主机一条独立口令，用 **Windows DPAPI（CurrentUser 作用域）** 加密存在本机，只有你这台机器这个账户能解开 |
| **浏览** | 远端目录树、面包屑、`↑` 上级、`⌂` 家目录、点文件即在右侧预览、目录与文件大小和 mtime 一起显示 |
| **预览 / 编辑** | 文本直接预览（上限 512 KB），点「编辑」就地改，`Ctrl+S` 存回远端：**先写临时文件再原子替换**，覆盖前自动留 `.re-bak`，`0o777` 权限位保住 |
| **传文件** | **双向拖拽**：远端文件/文件夹拖出窗口 = 下载到桌面（落的是**真实文件夹**，不是压缩包）；从资源管理器拖进来 = 上传到当前目录或某个目录行；批量拖动多选项 = 批量传输；右下角有进度抽屉，可取消 |
| **选中 / 删除** | 单击选中、`Ctrl`+单击多选、`Delete` 键或右键菜单删除（**二次确认**，拒绝删 `/` 和家目录） |
| **新建 / 改名** | 列表空白处右键新建文件或文件夹；选中一条右键重命名（内容、权限、mtime 都跟着走） |
| **终端** | 底部远端终端（`POST /exec`），高度可拖，退出码与 cwd 真实回传 |
| **AI 对话** | 右侧可拉伸停靠栏，**流式**（SSE）输出思考过程 / 工具调用 / 正文，支持 markdown；模型下拉按你配置的提供商分组；AI 可以借远端终端真跑命令 |

> 截图请自行放进 `docs/images/` 并在下面补图（本仓库没有预置截图）。
>
> ```markdown
> ![浏览与预览](docs/images/main.png)
> ![拖拽传文件](docs/images/transfer.png)
> ```

---

## 环境要求

| 角色 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 本机 | Windows 10 / 11 + DSH 桌面版；`ssh.exe`（Windows 自带 `C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe` 即可，也认 PATH 里的） |
| 远端 | `python3`（Ubuntu 20.04+/Debian 11+ 自带）；传文件夹额外需要 **GNU tar 1.29+** |
| 开发 | Node.js 18+（跑测试用；DSH 自带运行时也行） |

插件本体**零第三方依赖**：宿主半边只用 Node 内建模块，客户端半边只用 `react`（由 DSH 注入）。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：一键脚本（推荐）

```powershell
# 解压后进入目录
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8"   # Windows 控制台是 GBK，中文输出可能花屏
python install.py                 # 安装（幂等）
python install.py --verify        # 只读校验，不改任何东西
python install.py --rollback      # 卸载（删补丁块 + 删部署目录，改动前先备份）
```

脚本做两件事：把 `plugin\` 复制到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-ssh-explorer\`，
再往 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一段装载块：

```yaml
# [ssh-explorer] begin
# SSH 远程资源管理器：宿主路由 /x-ssh-explorer/* + 侧栏面板 ssh-explorer。
- insert:
    - id: ssh-explorer
      name: './plugins/dsh-ssh-explorer/lib/index.js'
      config:
        rev: 11
# [ssh-explorer] end
```

> `rev` 是**客户端 bundle 的缓存破坏号**：只要改了 `plugin/lib/client.js` 就必须 +1，
> 否则浏览器可能继续用旧前端。它和 `package.json` 的 `version` 无关，但要一起往前走。

### 方式 B：手动

1. 把 `plugin\` 整个目录拷到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-ssh-explorer\`
2. 在上面那个 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加上面那段装载块（`rev` 用当前值）
3. **完全退出 DSH** 再打开

> ⚠️ **改完必须完全退出 DSH 再开**：宿主半边（路由）只在启动时加载一次。
> 只改客户端半边（`client.js`）时，刷新页面即可生效。
> ⚠️ 别用记事本另存 YAML/JSON——它可能加 BOM，解析会失败；用 VSCode / Notepad++ 存 UTF-8 无 BOM。

装好后侧栏活动栏会出现 **SSH 远程资源管理器** 图标。

---

## 快速上手

1. 点侧栏图标打开面板，左上角下拉里选一台主机（来自 `~/.ssh/config`，或点「＋ 新建连接」自己填）
2. 第一次连某台机器要输口令，填完勾上记住即用 DPAPI 加密存本机
3. 浏览器览远端目录：点目录进去、点面包屑回退、`↑` 上级、`⌂` 家目录
4. **要下载**：把文件/文件夹从列表里**拖出窗口**松手（落点是桌面），行尾也有 `⬇`
5. **要上传**：从资源管理器把文件/文件夹**拖进列表**（空白处 = 当前目录，拖到某目录行 = 那个目录）
6. 右下角 `⇅ 传输` 抽屉里看进度，传输中可取消，完成后可「在资源管理器中显示」

---

## 使用手册

完整版（含每个端点、每个边界情况、28 条踩坑记录）见 **[docs/使用说明.md](docs/使用说明.md)**。下面是速查。

### 连接

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 选连接 | 顶部下拉；`~/.ssh/config` 里的主机会自动带上（标「来自 ~/.ssh/config」） |
| ＋ 新建连接 | 自己填名称 / 主机 / 端口 / 用户名 / 私钥路径 / 认证方式 |
| 🔑 设密码 / 改密码 | 给这一台单独存一条口令（DPAPI 加密） |
| 🗑 管理连接 | 浮层里删设备：自建连接**真删**（口令一起删），`~/.ssh/config` 里的只**隐藏**（配置文件不动），进了「已删除」分组还能一键恢复 |

### 浏览与预览

| 操作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 单击一行 | 选中；文件顺带在右侧预览 |
| 双击目录 | 进入该目录 |
| 双击文件 | 重开预览 |
| 面包屑 / `↑` / `⌂` | 跳转 / 上级 / 家目录 |
| 拖中间那条分隔条 | 调整列表与预览的宽度（记在 localStorage） |
| 预览页「编辑」 | 进入编辑态，`Ctrl+S` 存回远端（先写 `.re-tmp` 再原子替换，原文件留 `.re-bak`） |

### 传文件（拖拽）

| 方向 | 做法 | 落地 |
|---|---|---|
| 远端 → 本机 | 把行（或多选的一批）**拖出窗口**松手；或点行尾 `⬇`；或右键「⬇ 下载到桌面」 | 真实文件 / 真实文件夹写到**桌面**（可配置），中文名与 mtime 原样保留 |
| 本机 → 远端 | 从资源管理器把文件/文件夹拖进列表空白处（=当前目录）或某个目录行 | 传到对应远端目录；同名默认**不覆盖** |

- 多选后拖动 = **批量传输**，每一条在抽屉里各占一行，独立显示成功/失败。
- 传输跑在宿主侧（不是浏览器下载），所以被壳的下载限制影响不到；进度按字节实时更新，可随时取消（取消不留半成品）。

### 选中 / 删除 / 新建 / 改名

| 操作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl`（macOS 上 `⌘`）+ 单击 | 加选 / 取消这一条；选多条时浏览区左下角浮出「已选 N 项」浮条 |
| `Delete` | 删选中的一批（先弹确认框） |
| 右键选中项 | 菜单：`⬇ 下载到桌面` / `🗑 删除` / `取消选择`（多选时作用于整批） |
| 右键选中**一条** | 多一项 `✏️ 重命名…`（预填旧名并全选，`Enter` 提交、`Esc` 取消） |
| 右键**空白处** | `📄 新建文件…` / `📁 新建文件夹…`（建在当前目录，建完自动选中） |

安全阀：拒绝删 `/` 与家目录本身、拒绝在 `/` 下新建、拒绝把 `/` 或家目录改名；重名回 409 并把原因显示在浮层里。

### 远端终端 / AI 对话

- **终端**：工具栏「⌨ 终端」开关底部终端，高度可拖，`↑`/`↓` 翻历史，退出码与 cwd 真实回传。
- **AI 对话**：工具栏「✦ AI 对话」打开右侧停靠栏，可拖宽；**流式**输出，思考过程可折叠，工具调用是卡片；模型下拉按提供商分组，`/chat-models` 拉清单。
  - 默认复用 DSH 自己的模型配置（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里的 key）；想换模型或换网关就写 `~/.dsh/ssh-explorer/chat.json`。

---

## 它是怎么实现的

两半 + 一条同源 HTTP 通道：

```
┌──────────────────────────── DSH 桌面版（Electron） ────────────────────────────┐
│  renderer（浏览器侧）                        host（Node 子进程 / Cordis 插件）  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┐   fetch()   ┌──────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │ client.js                │ ──────────► │ index.js                          │ │
│  │  侧栏面板 / 拖拽 / 键盘   │ ◄────────── │  /x-ssh-explorer/* 19 条路由      │ │
│  └──────────────────────────┘   JSON/SSE  │    ├─ ssh.exe（execFile / spawn） │ │
│                                            │    ├─ tar 读/写（纯 JS 实现）     │ │
│                                            │    └─ 任务队列（进度/取消）       │ │
│                                            └──────────────────────────────────┘ │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │ ssh
                             ▼
                    远端 Linux（python3 + GNU tar）
```

几个刻意的选择，都有实测依据：

1. **零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖**：本地 `plugins/` 挂载的插件不会被 pnpm 装依赖，所以宿主半边只 `import` Node 内建模块，能力全部从 Cordis 的 `ctx` 拿（`ctx.get("webServer").register(...)`、`ctx.effect(...)`）。
2. **远端命令一律走 `python3`**：把脚本 base64 后交给远端 `python3` 执行、结果回 JSON，绕开 Windows → SSH → 远端 shell 三层引号问题，还天然可结构化。
3. **`tar` 只当传输管，不用 Windows 的 `tar.exe`**：Windows 自带的 `tar.exe` 是精简版 bsdtar，既不支持 `--hdrcharset=UTF-8`，解 UTF-8 中文名还会按 GBK 误解成乱码（`中文 目录` → `涓枃 鐩綍`）。所以远端出 `tar -cf -`、本机用**自己写的 tar 读/写器**落地，中文名与 mtime 原样保留。往远端推目录同理。
4. **拖出窗口 = 宿主侧后台拷贝，不是系统级拖放**：Electron 壳里 `will-download` 被 `preventDefault()`（浏览器下载全灭），`startDrag` 也没暴露给页面，所以页面上能"拖出去"的最多是一次浏览器下载。于是做成「发现你把行拖出了窗口 → 在宿主侧替你拷贝到桌面 → `explorer /select` 定位」。**好处**是能落成真实文件夹、能保留 mtime、能显示进度；**代价**是不能把文件丢进别的应用窗口。
5. **长任务不占请求**：传输/删除走「起任务 + 轮询快照」，请求立刻返回 `{ok, job}`，前端 700ms 拉一次 `/job?id=`。

安全模型：

- 所有路由都过**同源栅栏**（`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 直接拒；带 `Origin` 的必须与 `Host` 同 authority），避免被任意网页调用。
- 口令不落明文：`SSH_ASKPASS` + DPAPI 加密文件，进程内只在需要时解密给 `ssh.exe`。
- 破坏性操作（删、改名、新建、覆盖）都在宿主侧做存在性与越界校验，拒绝 `/` 与家目录本身。

---

## HTTP API

全部挂在 `/x-ssh-explorer/` 下，共 19 条。GET：`connections` `ping` `info` `list` `read` `chat-models` `locals` `job`；其余是 POST。

| 端点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `GET/POST /connections` | 列连接（含 `readOnly`、`hasPassword`、`hidden`）；POST 支持 `save` / `delete` / `restore` |
| `GET /ping` | 连通性 + 认证探测 |
| `GET /info` | 主机名 / 内核 / glibc 等 |
| `GET /list?path=` | 列目录（名字、类型、大小、mtime） |
| `GET /read?path=` | 读文件（上限 512 KB，返回 base64） |
| `POST /write` | 写文件（原子替换 + `.re-bak`） |
| `POST /chat` | AI 对话（SSE 流式） |
| `GET /chat-models` | 可用模型（按提供商分组） |
| `POST /chat-config` | 读写对话默认模型 |
| `POST /exec` | 远端执行一条命令（带退出码与 cwd） |
| `GET /locals` | 本机桌面 / 下载 / 用户目录 |
| `POST /pull` | 远端 → 本机（起任务），`{connection, paths[], target}` |
| `POST /push` | 本机 → 远端（起任务），`{connection, dir, paths[]}` |
| `POST /upload` | 单文件字节流兜底上传（请求体就是文件内容） |
| `GET/POST /job` | 任务快照 / 取消 |
| `POST /reveal` | 在资源管理器中定位文件 |
| `POST /delete` | 删远端文件/文件夹（逐条返回结果） |
| `POST /create` | 新建空文件/空目录 |
| `POST /rename` | 重命名（原子、保元数据） |

---

## 配置文件与状态目录

运行时状态都在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\ssh-explorer\`：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `connections.json` | 你自建的连接（`~/.ssh/config` 的不在此列） |
| `secrets.json` | 每台主机的口令，**DPAPI 加密**（换机器/换账户解不开） |
| `hidden.json` | 从清单里隐藏掉的 `~/.ssh/config` 主机 |
| `chat.json` | AI 对话默认用哪个模型 / 网关（可选） |
| `askpass.cjs` `askpass.cmd` `dpapi.ps1` | 首次使用时自动生成的帮手脚本 |

> 从旧名

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: semantic recall of what you already said in earlier sessions of the same workspace, appended to the conversation and available as an on-demand tool.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lembrar

Semantic recall of what you already said, inside
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

An agent starts every session knowing nothing that happened in the previous
ones. `dsh-lembrar` indexes your own messages (`user/message` events) from earlier
sessions of the same workspace and puts the matching ones back in front of the
agent: once automatically before each turn, and on demand through a tool. Matching
is by meaning, not by exact words.

It is recall, not a diary or a summary: the indexed text is your raw message, and
what comes back is the excerpt plus the session id and event sequence number, so
the agent can open the original event with the harness session tools.

## Install

```sh
# 1. pnpm — the harness manages profile plugins with it
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-lembrar

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-lembrar`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends the plugin
row to the profile bundle list. That row is the only activation, and it is
applied at every boot.

Check the loaded line:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A10 lembrar
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: lembrar
  name: dsh-lembrar
  config:
    colecao: sessoes-bgem3-v1
    injetar: true
    ...
```

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command, then restart the harness
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-lembrar

# uninstall
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lembrar
# then restart the harness
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — the harness uses it to manage profile plugins.
- **DeepSeek Harness** with session history indexed. The `web` profile mounts
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite`, which maintains
  `~/.dsh/storages/session-search.db`; `dsh-lembrar` reads that database for the
  session list. Without it there is no past to search, and the plugin stays
  silent.
- **memsearch** with local ONNX embeddings for the vector index:
  `uv tool install "memsearch[onnx]"` (or `pipx install "memsearch[onnx]"`).
  Point the plugin at the binary when it is not named `memsearch` on `PATH`
  (`LEMBRAR_MEMSEARCH` or the `memsearch` config key).
- **sqlite3** CLI on `PATH` (the plugin reads the session list with it).
- **Python 3** to export the corpus (standard library only; `exportar.py`).
- Optional: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-session-query` for the `session_event_read`
  tool the skill mentions when an excerpt is not enough.

The plugin itself is plain ESM using only Node built-ins: no build step and no
native dependency.

## Build the index

`dsh-lembrar` reads an existing memsearch collection; it does not embed anything
itself. The package ships the two commands that turn the harness session database
into that collection:

```sh
# where the installed package lives (adjust if your profile has another name)
PKG="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lembrar"
STATE="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dsh-lembrar"

# 1. one markdown file per user message, from session-search.db
python3 "$PKG/scripts/exportar.py" --destino "$STATE/corpus"

# 2. embed them (only new or changed text is embedded; `--force` redoes all)
memsearch index "$STATE/corpus" -c sessoes-bgem3-v1

# 3. write the marker the plugin checks before it searches
"$PKG/scripts/marcar-indice.sh"
```

The three lines are idempotent. After the first full run, a refresh takes
seconds when little has changed, so it is reasonable to run them from cron or a
systemd timer (for example, once a day):

```sh
0 3 * * * PKG="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lembrar" STATE="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dsh-lembrar"; python3 "$PKG/scripts/exportar.py" --destino "$STATE/corpus" && memsearch index "$STATE/corpus" -c sessoes-bgem3-v1 && "$PKG/scripts/marcar-indice.sh"
```

The marker is a small JSON file in `<estadoDir>/<colecao>.json`. It exists so the
hook never pays a failed search for an index that was never built: run the
indexer without step 3 and the plugin keeps quiet.

The collection name is the contract between the index and the plugin: it
defaults to `sessoes-bgem3-v1` on both sides and is configurable.

## Configuration

Every path is configurable and the defaults derive from your home directory, so
nothing is tied to a specific machine. Override by environment variable, or by
the config of the `lembrar` line in your profile patch. A patch replaces the
whole config of the line, so restate every key you want to keep.

| Config key | Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colecao` | — | `sessoes-bgem3-v1` | memsearch collection |
| `injetar` | — | `true` | append memories to each turn via `agent/pre-step` |
| `maxTokens` | — | `800` | token cap for the appended block (~4 characters per token) |
| `k` | — | `8` | events returned by one search, before the token cut |
| `scoreMinimo` | — | `0.55` | similarity floor; below it the hook stays silent |
| `buscarHabilitado` | — | `true` | register the on-demand `lembrar` tool |
| `buscarTimeoutMs` | — | `30000` | engine timeout per search |
| `exigirMesmoCwd` | — | `true` | only sessions with the caller's exact `cwd` are authorized |
| `estadoDir` | `LEMBRAR_ESTADO_DIR` | `$XDG_STATE_HOME/dsh-lembrar/.estado`, or `<package>/.lembrar/.estado` for a local `link:` install | where the index marker lives |
| `banco` | `LEMBRAR_BANCO` | `~/.dsh/storages/session-search.db` | session database |
| `memsearch` | `LEMBRAR_MEMSEARCH` | `memsearch` on `PATH` | search engine binary |

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: lembrar
  config:
    colecao: sessoes-bgem3-v1
    estadoDir: '/home/you/.local/state/dsh-lembrar/.estado'
```

## Usage

You do not call anything. On the first step of each turn the hook searches your
current message against the index, keeps the hits above the floor, and appends a
short block at the **end** of the message list. Appending (never rewriting an
earlier message) is what preserves the prompt prefix cache: only the new suffix
is paid for. When nothing matches, the decision comes back untouched and the turn
costs zero extra tokens.

The agent can also search on demand with the `lembrar` tool:

```text
lembrar { "consulta": "what did we decide about the backup schedule" }
```

Each hit returns `session_id`, `seq` and the excerpt. The `lembrar-recall` skill
describes the follow-up: open the original event with `session_event_read` when
the excerpt is not enough.

## Privacy and authorization

- **Same workspace only.** A session only sees sessions whose `cwd` matches its
  own exactly, read from `persisted_sessions`. If that list cannot be read, no
  hit is authorized: the failure is closed, not open.
- **No `cwd`, no memory.** Headless, CLI and subagent sessions without a `cwd`
  receive nothing; with `exigirMesmoCwd: false` you can disable the gate
  explicitly.
- **Secret directories stay out.** A session whose `cwd` is inside a `segredos/`
  or `vault/` directory is excluded from the corpus and cannot be a caller.
- **Your words only.** The corpus is limited to `user/message` events from the
  `current` surface. Assistant messages and tool payloads are never indexed, and
  messages injected by plugins or by the host are filtered out.
- **Local by default.** The index is a local Milvus Lite database
  (`~/.memsearch/milvus.db`); the embeddings run locally.

## Verification

From a clone of the repository (tests are not part of the installed tarball):

```sh
node --test tests/*.test.js
```

The suite covers authorization by `cwd`, secret-path exclusion, appending without
rewriting, silence when there is no signal, the token budget, one excerpt per
session, engine failure handling and the tool/

plugins.description: Plugin market index for weft-audit's DeepSeek Harness plugins.
Cursor plugin and DeepSeek Harness bundle that connect your AI to Local Commander (https://localcmd.app/mcp) on your Windows computers.
plugins.readme_text:
# Local Commander for Cursor and DeepSeek Harness

Connects Cursor and DeepSeek Harness to [Local Commander](https://localcmd.app) at `https://localcmd.app/mcp`. Your AI can inspect approved project files and Git state, run the checks and commands you authorize, and diagnose approved localhost services on Windows 11 computers you own. Your workspace at localcmd.app shows which computer ran each request and how it ended.

This repository holds configuration only: a Cursor plugin and a DeepSeek Harness bundle. The service runs at localcmd.app.

## Requirements

- A Local Commander account at [localcmd.app](https://localcmd.app).
- A Windows 11 x64 computer with Node.js 20 or later and the paired agent: run `npx local-commander-agent@latest` on it, then choose full access or selected folders.
- The computer must be online for work and for reading results.

Once you approve a computer and connect your AI, it can do what your Windows account can do, just like you at the keyboard. You can limit it to certain folders, block commands, stop running work, or switch a computer off from the site at any time. Every run shows which computer did it. Whatever the AI asks for goes back to the AI.

## Cursor

1. Install the plugin, or add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "local-commander": { "url": "https://localcmd.app/mcp" }
     }
   }
   ```

2. Cursor opens localcmd.app to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0). Sign-in happens on localcmd.app; Cursor never sees your password.
3. Ask the agent to list your computers, then work on an approved project.

Troubleshooting:

- **The agent reports no computers:** start the agent on the Windows computer and check that it shows as online at localcmd.app.
- **Sign-in loops or fails:** open Output, choose "MCP Logs", and check the OAuth error; then remove and re-add the server.
- **A result is unknown:** the computer dropped during the task. The work is not re-run automatically; check the computer and ask again.

## DeepSeek Harness

A configuration-only [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle. The tools appear as `mcp__local-commander__<tool>`.

The harness MCP client sends static headers only, so the bundle starts [`mcp-remote`](https://github.com/punkpeye/mcp-remote) over stdio. On first use it opens localcmd.app in your browser to sign in and approve access (OAuth 2.0), then keeps the token refreshed. In your localcmd.app workspace these requests show the client name "MCP CLI Proxy", the name mcp-remote registers.

DeepSeek Harness asks for Node.js 22.19 or later on the machine where you chat.

Install: download `local-commander-dsh-1.0.0.tgz` from the [latest release](https://github.com/netbka/local-commander-plugins/releases/latest), then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./local-commander-dsh-1.0.0.tgz
dsh web
```

You can also build the tarball from this repository with `npm pack`.

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove local-commander-dsh
```

## Links

Privacy: https://localcmd.app/privacy. Terms: https://localcmd.app/terms. Support: peter.mamrukov@localcmd.app (https://localcmd.app/support).

## License

MIT, for the files in this repository.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: one on-demand tool that finds tools and skills outside the agent schema by meaning and registers the found tool in the requesting scope.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-alfandega

On-demand tool catalog for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

A profile with many plugins and MCP servers sends hundreds of tool definitions on
every request. Every definition costs schema tokens for every turn, and a tool
list that large is well past the point where model accuracy starts to drop.
`dsh-alfandega` adds **one** tool, `achar_ferramenta` ("find tool" in
Portuguese), that finds the tool or skill missing from the agent schema by
meaning and registers the found tool in the requesting agent's scope. The agent
discovers the capability as content, when it needs it, instead of carrying every
schema all the time.

| Who | Surface | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `achar_ferramenta` tool | the full schema of the matching tool, plus registration in its scope |
| you, in the chat | `/alfandega <what you want to do>` | the same search, as text |

## Install

```sh
# 1. pnpm (needed by `dsh plugin`)
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-alfandega
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, step 2 is:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-alfandega
```

Restart the harness after installing: the bundle layer is read at boot.

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Check that the line was loaded:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 alfandega
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: alfandega
  name: dsh-alfandega
  config:
    colecao: ferramentas-bgem3-v1
    topK: 5
    buscaTimeoutMs: 20000
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends
`dsh-alfandega` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. That line is
the only activation.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command, then restart the harness
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-alfandega

# uninstall, then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-alfandega
```

## What the plugin does

```
the model needs a capability that is not in its schema
        │
        ▼
achar_ferramenta(consulta)                ← one tool, always in the schema
        │
        ├─ 1. optional vector search in a memsearch collection, by MEANING
        ├─ 2. completed by local lexical ranking (name > description > keyword)
        │
        ▼
returns the FULL schema as CONTENT (the prompt prefix is not rewritten)
and registers the tool in the scope of the agent that asked
        │
        ▼
the tool is callable from the NEXT request on — one cache re-warm, not one
per request
```

- **One tool.** `achar_ferramenta({ consulta, quantas? })`.
- **One command.** `/alfandega <what you want to do>`; `/alfandega` alone
  reports the catalog size and path.
- **One hook.** `tools/change` clears the in-memory catalog cache.
- **No UI, no client bundle, no network service.** `client.js` does not exist
  on purpose.

Registration is agent-scoped (`exec.agent.ctx.tools.register`), never global:
the tool array of the prompt prefix is extended once, when the model asks, so
the prompt cache survives.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH`; the harness manages profile plugins with it.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- **memsearch** is optional. With it, the first ranking stage is vector search
  over a collection whose item ids follow `ferramenta-<name>` /
  `skill-<name>`. Without it (or with the index busy/unavailable), the plugin
  falls back to local lexical ranking and says so in the result. Nothing breaks.

## The catalog is generated on your machine

The package deliberately ships **no catalog**. A catalog is a dump of the tool
and skill registry of one machine; shipping it would leak that machine's paths
and internal descriptions, and it would be stale for everyone else.

On the first call (`achar_ferramenta` or `/alfandega`), if there is no catalog
at the configured path, the plugin:

1. reads the live tool registry (`tools.schemas()`),
2. lists the skills visible to the calling agent,
3. writes the catalog to the configured path and answers from it.

Default path: `~/.dsh/alfandega/catalogo.json`. If the directory is not
writable, the plugin keeps the catalog in memory for the session and logs a
warning instead of failing.

To refresh the catalog (for example after installing a new plugin), delete the
file and call the tool again:

```sh
rm ~/.dsh/alfandega/catalogo.json
```

The search also merges what the calling agent already sees, so a tool that is in
the schema never appears twice or gets registered again. The hook
`tools/change` clears the in-memory cache, so a regenerated file is picked up
without a restart.

## Configuration

All keys live on the `alfandega` line of the profile patch. A patch replaces the
whole config of the line, so restate every key you want to keep.

| Key | Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalogo` | `DSH_ALFANDEGA_CATALOGO` | `~/.dsh/alfandega/catalogo.json` | catalog path; `~/` is expanded |
| `colecao` | — | `ferramentas-bgem3-v1` | memsearch collection queried for vector search |
| `topK` | — | `5` | how many items a call returns (capped at 20) |
| `buscaTimeoutMs` | — | `20000` | vector search ceiling; on timeout the lexical ranking answers |

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: alfandega
  config:
    colecao: 'ferramentas-bgem3-v1'
    catalogo: '/home/you/.dsh/alfandega/catalogo.json'
    topK: 5
    buscaTimeoutMs: 20000
```

When developing the plugin from a directory, a `catalogo.json` next to
`index.js` takes precedence over the home default; that is how a checkout can
keep a pre-generated catalog while a package install generates its own.

## Usage

Ask the agent for a capability it does not seem to have ("run a long command in
the background", "search the web", "start a workflow"). It calls
`achar_ferramenta` and receives the full schema of the match.

In the chat:

```sh
/alfandega list background jobs      # find and show the matching tool
/alfandega                           # catalog size, path and state
```

What a result looks like:

```
[alfandega] 1 de 42 itens para "list background jobs" (lexical + registro sob demanda).

FERRAMENTA job_list
  List background jobs started by this session
  parâmetros:
    { ... }

registradas agora no seu escopo: job_list. Elas ficam disponíveis a partir da
PRÓXIMA requisição.
```

## Verification

From a clone of the repository:

```sh
node --test tests/
```

The suite covers the lexical ranking, vector-first ordering, scoped
registration (never twice, never global), the frame-format JSON Schema,
catalog read errors, catalog generation at the destination, and the package
contract. It needs no harness install and no index; when
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is resolvable (or `DSH_TOOLS_ENTRY` points at its
entrypoint), it also validates the registered schema with the harness compiler.

To verify the install: check the `dump-config` line above, restart the harness,
then run `/alfandega web search`. The first call reports
`catálogo gerado agora a partir do host`.

## Limits, stated

- **The catalog is a snapshot.** It is written on first use and does not update
  itself when a new tool appears. Delete the file to regenerate it. The
  `tools/change` hook only invalidates the in-memory cache.
- **Registration is not instantaneous for the model.** The tool becomes callable
  from the next request; in the current step the model already has the full
  schema as text, which is enough to decide.
- **Vector search is an accelerator, not a requirement.** Missing memsearch,
  missing collection, or a busy database means lexical ranking, which can order
  results worse but still returns them.
- **Skills do not become tools.** A found skill is returned with a pointer and is
  loaded through the harness `skill` tool, which owns the skill catalog.
- **One tool, on purpose.** The plugin does not add a second model-facing tool;
